izzyondroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.name: Karui ToDo
izzyondroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.summary: 200kB aesthetic notes app with pomodoro, calendar, reminders and widgets
izzyondroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.description:
An open source, privacy focussed, 145kB aesthetic Google Tasks alternative todo list app to quickly jot down things to do.
 This app cannot connect to the internet, doesn't have internet permissions. Secure by design.
 Inspired by the discord system-24 theme and the Windows Mobile design system with a mash up of retro terminalesque design inspired by Unix customizations found online.
 Inspired by orgzly and colornote, it supports sync and QR sharing of notes between devices.
 Typical uses and what makes it special
 Daily quick notetaking, pomodoro, making shopping lists, bucket lists, calendar event marking, reminders and recurring notes.
 Tasks list with percentage remaining metrics, notemenu shows word count, useful when you are writing prose.
 Taking notes from status bar or other app, taking design ideas when on youtube, instagram, snapchat, whatsapp, tiktok without the need to switch to a notes app.
 Capture passing thoughts when on a jog.
 Journal events of your daily life on a separate tab or in the calendar, a daily log of activities.
 Playing quick mobile games (easter eggs).
 Use it like a password manager, save your passwords for quick access with copy paste at one place.
 Features
 Simple note taking and shopping list making with home screen widgets, status bar input, calendar, recurring reminders, offline sync, recycle bin, drag and drop sorting.
 To add a new note tab: use the /TabName format. Bringing some Linux Terminal vibes.
 Long-press any tab to rename, delete or add new tab (has a shadow that kinda brings back MS-DOS vibes).
 Support for dynamic custom themes and fonts, so pick and select any .ttf files you like from your files system.
 Add a % symbol on any tabname and it automatically counts percentage of tasks completed. Use %s term syntax to search and find a note.
 Encrypt tabs or disable screenshots for privacy when screensharing, toggle celebration mode with confetti.
 Homescreen widgets for notes, Karui also has a floating pomodoro timer.
 Easter egg games like Flappy Bird, Snake and Moon lander. Use the codes FLAPTHEBIRD, SLITHER, MOONMAN to test them out, share your highscores on our telegram, discord server and reddit, good place for more details on features or for casual notetaking discussions. Links in github readme. Github issues are the fastest way to reach out.

izzyondroid:ru.wohlsoft.opnmidiplayer.name: OPN2 MIDI Player
izzyondroid:ru.wohlsoft.opnmidiplayer.summary: Simple MIDI-player for Android based on libOPNMIDI library
izzyondroid:ru.wohlsoft.opnmidiplayer.description:
OPN2 MIDI Player is an implementation of OPNMIDI based MIDI-player for Android. It’s a MIDI-player based on emulator of a Frequency Modulation chip Yamaha OPN2 (YM2612). This small MIDI-player made with using of libOPNMIDI library.
 Key Features: 
 OPN2 emulation
 Customizable bank of FM patches (You have to use the bank editor to create own sound bank)
 Stereo sound
 Number of simulated OPN2 chips can be specified as 1-100 (maximum channels 600!)
 Pan (binary panning, i.e. left/right side on/off)
 Pitch-bender with adjustable range
 Vibrato that responds to RPN/NRPN parameters
 Sustain (a.k.a. Pedal hold) and Sostenuto enable/disable
 MIDI and RMI file support
 Real-Time MIDI API suppor
 MIDI and RMI file support
 loopStart / loopEnd tag support (Final Fantasy VII)
 111-th controller based loop start (RPG-Maker)
 Use automatic arpeggio with chords to relieve channel pressure
 Support for multiple concurrent MIDI synthesizers (per-track device/port select FF 09 message), can be used to overcome 16 channel limit
 Partial support for GS and XG standards (having more instruments than in one 128:128 GM set and ability to use multiple channels for percussion purposes, and a support for some GS/XG exclusive controllers)
 CC74 "Brightness" affects a modulator scale (to simulate frequency cut-off on WT synths)
 Portamento support (CC5, CC37, and CC65)
 SysEx support that supports some generic, GS, and XG features
 Full-panning stereo option (works for emulators only)

fdroid:com.katoaapps.openminilaunch.name: MinkLauncher OpenSource
fdroid:com.katoaapps.openminilaunch.summary: A minimal, keyboard-first Android home-screen launcher
fdroid:com.katoaapps.openminilaunch.description:
MinkLauncher OpenSource is a keyboard-first Android launcher built for fast input and low visual noise.
HOME THAT FITS YOUR PHONE
MinkSpace Mini-Apps and the eight-position App Grid share one responsive Home panel. Seven slots can hold an app, app shortcut, or folder. The eighth opens Quick Drawer for MinkPad Lite, All Apps, Private Space, and Work Space. Its saved Quick Apps appear when Mink Assistant opens.
Swipe through enabled To-dos, Calculator, Memories, Music, Quick Widget, and your Virtual Contact Card. The Widgets page supports up to 64 Android widgets with responsive sizing, drag reordering, and portable restore placeholders.
TYPE TO ACT
On a physical-keyboard phone, start typing from Home. Magic Box opens with the first character preserved. Touch-only phones can use MinkLauncher’s native Home keyboard with eight layouts, six visual styles, adjustable height, optional haptics, and split mode on wide screens.
Magic Box hot keys:
• @: message a contact
• #: call a contact
• -: add a to-do
• /: create a note
• +: create a calendar event
• ?: find and launch an app
• *: send a prompt to your selected AI app
• Plain text: search files, search the web, or use a compatible AI app
PEOPLE AND CONVERSATIONS
Conversations groups active Android message and email notifications into compact threads. Inline reply appears only when the originating app supplies Android’s reply action.
Favorites combines starred Android Contacts with Mink-created integrated contacts. Reorder your people and choose a messaging or calling route for each one. If a provider is unavailable, MinkLauncher offers a clear reinstall or reconnect path.
MORE BUILT IN
• To-dos support editing, confirmation before deletion, and drag reordering.
• File search groups photos, videos, documents, and audio from folders you explicitly select through Android’s system picker.
• Mink’s Day measures foreground time for selected apps and can add a launcher-level pause after a collective daily limit.
• Memories displays files selected through Android’s picker without copying or uploading them.
• Music reads Android’s active media session through optional Notification access and sends only the controls supplied by the provider.
• Work Apps use a separate badged drawer. Android 15 Private Space apps remain in Android’s locked container.
• Add to Home requests use a full-page picker that can create or extend an App Grid folder or add the item to Quick Drawer.
MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a Mink theme or customize your wallpaper, colors, icons, font, and layout. Use Mink icons, original app icons, or an installed Nova/ADW-compatible icon pack.
BACKUP AND RESTORE
Export a versioned local JSON backup with launcher settings, folders, app choices, appearance, keyboard preferences, MinkSpace, Mink’s Day, to-dos, your Virtual Contact Card, Mink-created Favorites, and widget restore recipes.
Readable exports may contain names, phone numbers, usernames, provider routes, and vCard details. Android Contacts, photos, live widget data, selected media, permissions, roles, and document-folder grants stay device-bound. Importing a backup preserves widgets already configured on the receiving device.
PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
• No accounts, ads, analytics, trackers, or application server
• Android cloud backup is disabled
• Queries, to-dos, settings, calculator history, media references, conversations, usage analysis, and filename indexing stay on the device
• Portable backups are created only when requested and remain in the location you select
• Optional Notification, Usage, Accessibility, and Assistant access is explained before Android Settings opens
• The lock Accessibility Service performs only Android’s Lock screen action and cannot inspect window content
• An optional GitHub version check sends no launcher content and never downloads or installs APKs
MinkLauncher OpenSource is released under the Apache License 2.0.

fdroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.summary: Create reusable cards for quick access when non-verbal communication is needed.
fdroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.description:
Aucards is a free and open-source app where you can create colorful communication cards to help you communicate with others.
 App is based on the concept of "autistic cards", which people with special needs use to quickly communicate their feelings, their requests or inform others of their conditions.
 If you've ever experienced the need to say something when you couldn't, for example, in a moment of autistic shutdown, when you are too overwhelmed to speak, then this app is for you.
It is designed to be as frictionless as possible to minimize the effort needed to express what you feel right now.
 Highlights: 
 Create an endless amount of cards with unique messages
 Choose any color from a rich palette – or create your own!
 Organize your cards however you like: drag them around or add to favourites
 Easy to use: just tap on the card to open it in fullscreen!
 Bring your cards to any device: easily export and transfer them wherever you like
 Play a sound to let others know you want to say something
 Completely free, open source and no ads – ever!
 Who can benefit from this app: 
 People with autism/adhd
 Children who have difficulties with verbal communication
 Elderly people who need assistance
 Or anyone in a situation where you can't speak: on a loud concert or a lecture!

fdroid:xyz.waozi.pass.name: Werkzeug
fdroid:xyz.waozi.pass.summary: Private tools: deterministic passwords, 2FA codes, calculator and clock.
fdroid:xyz.waozi.pass.description:
Werkzeug holds small private tools in one app. Everything is computed on your device and nothing is tracked. It makes no network requests unless you turn on sync.
• Pass derives strong, repeatable passwords. The same site, login, master password, and settings always produce the same result, so there is no password database to back up, sync, or lose. It is LessPass-compatible, with configurable length, counter, character classes and excluded characters, and an optional master password kept behind device authentication.
• Auth shows two-factor sign-in codes (TOTP with SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512). Add accounts by secret key or from otpauth links, Google Authenticator export links, unencrypted Aegis exports or Ente Auth's plain-text export. Rename an account or note the websites where it signs in. Copied codes are cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds. Optional sync keeps them on all your devices, encrypted on the device so the server never sees them.
• Calculator handles everyday arithmetic with brackets, powers and percent, and has a Scientific mode with trigonometry, logarithms, roots, factorials, π and e.
• Clock shows the local time and date and has a stopwatch.
• Workbook edits spreadsheets with formulas, multiple sheets and automatic saving. Import or export a Gnumeric workbook through Android's file chooser, and use the same document on the desktop or web.
A profile with your name and picture sets the appearance every tool shares.
Every tool works without a Daochi account. In Profile → Sync you can choose your own node before connecting an account, or pause sync without forgetting your keys and local records. Sync stays off after restarting until you turn it on again.
Pass is an independent implementation of the LessPass algorithm. Compatibility does not imply endorsement by or affiliation with the LessPass project.
Source code: https://github.com/waozixyz/werk
Website: https://werk.waozi.xyz
Licensed under BSD-3-Clause.

flathub:org.openmsx.openMSX.name: openMSX
flathub:org.openmsx.openMSX.summary: Emulate all aspects of the MSX with high accuracy
flathub:org.openmsx.openMSX.description:
openMSX is an emulator for the MSX home computer system. MSX was a standard for Z80-based home
 computers, and was a (largely) Japanese attempt to establish a single standard in home computing
 similar to VHS in video.
 The MSX standard was designed by ASCII Corporation in Japan, in cooperation with Microsoft Japan.
 The later of which provided the extended BASIC for the machine.
 In addition to emulating MSX, MSX2, MSX2+, MSX Turbo R and many of it's peripherals, openMSX
 also supports emulating the ColecoVision and Sega SG-1000 game consoles and the SpectraVideo SVI-318
 and SVI-328 home computer systems.
 Note: by default the openMSX emulator only ships with the C-BIOS open-source BIOS implementation.
 This BIOS is restricted to cartridge based MSX games. For a full MSX or SVI emulation it is necessary
 to provide your own MSX and/or SVI BIOS ROMs, which must be placed in the ~/.openMSX/share/systemroms
 directory.

fedora-packages:ghdl/ghdl.name: ghdl

fedora-packages:ghdl/ghdl.description: GHDL is the open-source analyzer, compiler, simulator and (experimental) synthesizer for VHDL, a Hardware Description Language (HDL). GHDL implements the VHDL language according to the 1987, 1993 and 2002 versions of the IEEE 1076 VHDL standard, and partial for 2008. It compiles VHDL files and creates a binary that simulates (or executes) your design. GHDL can also translate a design into a VHDL 1993 netlist, or it can be plugged into Yosys for open-source synthesis. Since GHDL is a compiler (i.e., it generates object files), you can call functions or procedures written in a foreign language, such as C, C++, Ada95 or Python.

fedora-packages:golang-etcd-bbolt/golang.summary: An embedded key/value database for Go
fedora-packages:golang-etcd-bbolt/golang.description: Package Bbolt implements a low-level key/value store in pure Go. It supports fully serializable transactions, ACID semantics, and lock-free MVCC with multiple readers and a single writer. Bolt can be used for projects that want a simple data store without the need to add large dependencies such as Postgres or MySQL. Bolt is a single-level, zero-copy, B+tree data store. This means that Bolt is optimized for fast read access and does not require recovery in the event of a system crash. Transactions which have not finished committing will simply be rolled back in the event of a crash. The design of Bolt is based on Howard Chu's LMDB database project. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – go.etcd.io/bbolt

fedora-packages:python-pyscf/python3-pys.name: python3-pyscf
fedora-packages:python-pyscf/python3-pys.description: Python‐based simulations of chemistry framework (PySCF) is a general‐purpose electronic structure platform designed from the ground up to emphasize code simplicity, so as to facilitate new method development and enable flexible computational workflows. The package provides a wide range of tools to support simulations of finite‐size systems, extended systems with periodic boundary conditions, low‐dimensional periodic systems, and custom Hamiltonians, using mean‐field and post‐mean‐field methods with standard Gaussian basis functions. To ensure ease of extensibility, PySCF uses the Python language to implement almost all of its features, while computationally critical paths are implemented with heavily optimized C routines. Using this combined Python/C implementation, the package is as efficient as the best existing C or Fortran‐based quantum chemistry programs.

fedora-packages:python-shortuuid/python3.description: shortuuid is a simple python library that generates concise, unambiguous, URL-safe UUIDs. Often, one needs to use non-sequential IDs in places where users will see them, but the IDs must be as concise and easy to use as possible. shortuuid solves this problem by generating uuids using Python's built-in uuid module and then translating them to base57 using lowercase and uppercase letters and digits, and removing similar-looking characters such as l, 1, I, O and 0.

fedora-packages:python-xarray/python3-xa.name: python3-xarray

fedora-packages:python-xarray/python3-xa.description: Xarray (formerly xray) is an open source project and Python package that makes working with labelled multi-dimensional arrays simple, efficient, and fun! Xarray introduces labels in the form of dimensions, coordinates and attributes on top of raw NumPy-like arrays, which allows for a more intuitive, more concise, and less error-prone developer experience. The package includes a large and growing library of domain-agnostic functions for advanced analytics and visualization with these data structures. Xarray was inspired by and borrows heavily from pandas, the popular data analysis package focused on labelled tabular data. It is particularly tailored to working with netCDF files, which were the source of xarray’s data model, and integrates tightly with dask for parallel computing.

fedora-packages:redir/redir.description: This is a TCP port redirector for UNIX. It can be run under inetd or as standalone (in which case it handles multiple connections). It is 8 bit clean, not limited to line mode, is small and lightweight. If you want access control, run it under xinetd, or inetd with TCP wrappers. fedora-packages:rust-python-launcher/rus.name: rust-python-launcher-devel
fedora-packages:rust-python-launcher/rus.description: The Python Launcher for Unix. Launch your Python interpreter the lazy/smart way! This launcher is an implementation of the py command for Unix-based platforms. The goal is to have py become the cross-platform command that Python users typically use to launch an interpreter while doing development. By having a command that is version-agnostic when it comes to Python, it side-steps the "what should the python command point to?" debate by clearly specifying that upfront (i.e. the newest version of Python that can be found). This also unifies the suggested command to document for launching Python on both Windows as Unix as py has existed as the preferred command on Windows since 2012 with the release of Python 3.3. Typical usage would be: py -m venv .venv py ... # Whatever you would normally use `python` for during development. This creates a virtual environment in a .venv directory using the latest version of Python installed. Subsequent uses of py will then use that virtual environment as long as it is in the current (or higher) directory; no environment activation required (although the Python Launcher supports activated environments as well)! A non-goal of this launcher is to become the way to launch the Python interpreter all the time. If you know the exact interpreter you want to launch then you should launch it directly; same goes for when you have requirements on the type of interpreter you want. The Python Launcher should be viewed as a tool of convenience, not necessity. This package contains library source intended for building other packages which use the "python-launcher" crate.

firefox-addons:3029492.name: Accesserty Signal: Search Accessibility Badges
firefox-addons:3029492.summary: See public accessibility clues from included sources in Google and Bing results, and report barriers from the page you're using.
firefox-addons:3029492.description:
Accesserty Signal helps you read public accessibility clues before opening a Google or Bing result. It shows matches from its included sources: certification, recognition, award or badge records, known accessibility statements, and Accesserty ALLY maintenance signals. If you encounter a barrier, you can report it from the page you are using.
READ PUBLIC CLUES IN SEARCH RESULTS
• Use search results on www.google.com , www.google.com.tw or www.bing.com . A small badge appears when Signal can match a result to information from its included sources. No particular search is guaranteed to show a match.
• Expand a badge with the keyboard or a pointer. Public record details show the source and recorded address or scope, with region, date and level where provided. Follow the source link to read the original context.
• The quick-filter shortlist groups matched results on the current search page so you can navigate to them. It is not a ranking of website quality and does not change search order.
• The popup describes the current tab, not all its search results. Open a result's page first, then reopen Signal to inspect that page or report a barrier. The popup's manual help link opens usage instructions; no onboarding tab opens automatically.
REPORT A BARRIER
• Report accessibility or usability barriers on the current page without creating an account or needing a matching badge. Choose the issue types, check the URL and tick the consent statement before submitting to Accesserty.
• Only a maintainer with current verified domain access can review reports associated with that verification. Submission does not guarantee that the website receives your report, responds or fixes the issue. For urgent or official help, use the website's own contact channel.
WHAT TO EXPECT
• Signal uses a limited set of sources. No badge does not establish whether a website has a public record or whether it is accessible; data availability can also affect what is shown.
• A record is a public signal, not an accessibility audit or a guarantee that every page or task is accessible. A certification may cover only some pages or services.
PRIVACY
Signal downloads public indexes and matches them locally in the browser. It does not send search-result links or background browsing activity to Accesserty. Feedback reports send the selected issue types, current page URL, browser user agent, optional contact email, and public accessibility signal context for that page, such as ALLY, certification, or statement information, to Accesserty. The optional contact email is visible only to Accesserty and is not shared with website maintainers.
Before a report is sent, the user must tick a consent statement, because a report can suggest how someone uses the web, for example with assistive technology. The form asks users not to include health details and explains how to have a report deleted.
To limit repeated submissions, the server separately stores an IP-derived keyed identifier (HMAC), request counts and timestamps. The raw IP is not stored in these counter records; they are not shared with maintainers or used for advertising. Unsuccessful requests may still leave a counter without saving report content. Retention and infrastructure-log details: https://accesserty.com/en/privacy/#data-retention 
The main page URL shown and sent in the report form retains its origin (scheme, host and port where needed) and path, and excludes query parameters and fragments. This URL is one field, not the only data in a report. Public evidence links in the signal context may retain parameters that identify their source records. Signals are not an accessibility audit or a guarantee that every page or task is accessible.
That report context can include multiple matching public records and their recorded scope URLs. Its snapshot is size-limited; omitted records are counted where retained, or the context is marked as omitted. It is sent only when you submit a report.
Only maintainers with current verified domain access can review reports associated with that verification in Console. If a domain has not been verified, Accesserty may not be able to make the report available to the website owner or resolve it. Signal reports are not formal legal complaints or official support requests to the website owner.
Learn more: https://accesserty.com/en/signal/ 
Privacy policy: https://accesserty.com/en/privacy/

bluejetty:00022486:ios.summary: Palm Reader helps you scan your palm, read your hand, and discover fascinating insights through clear, straightforward, and hand-specific personalized palmistry made for fun and curiosity. Take a photo of your palm and get a personalized ha
bluejetty:00022486:ios.description:
Palm Reader helps you scan your palm, read your hand, and discover fascinating insights through clear, straightforward, and hand-specific personalized palmistry made for fun and curiosity. Take a photo of your palm and get a personalized hand reading in seconds using this easy palm reader.
Instant palm reading made simple
This palm reader analyzes your Life Line, Heart Line, Head Line, and Fate Line to create a detailed palm reading. Each result explains how your palm lines connect and what they traditionally represent in hand reading and palmistry.
Many users search for “what will my future look like” or “how to read my palm in seconds.” Palm Reader makes palm reading fast, simple, and easy to try. 
Compare palm readings as your hand naturally changes 
Palm lines are not always the same forever. With Palm Reader, you can scan your palm again, compare palm readings, and see subtle changes over time. Some major lines change very slowly, while smaller details may shift sooner, making it interesting to revisit and explore new results. 
This makes Palm Reader ideal to:
* Try again after weeks or months
* Compare old and new palm scans
* See evolving patterns and insights
* Save readings and revisit them later 
Explore love, life, and personality insights
With each palm reading, you can:
* Get an instant palm reading
* See love and relationship insights
* Understand personality traits
* Explore life path meanings 
You can retry, compare, and see different outcomes, encouraging curiosity and discovery.
More reasons to come back
Palm Reader also lets you:
* Check daily, monthly, and yearly horoscopes
* Find your lucky number
* Revisit saved palm readings
* Compare insights over time 
These features encourage you to reopen the app, track changes, and discover new perspectives whenever curiosity strikes.
Designed for trust, privacy, and fun 
Palm Reader is made for entertainment purposes only.
* No login required
* Palm photos remain on your device
* Privacy-friendly and family-safe
* Simple US English explanations 
A fun experience worth revisiting 
Use Palm Reader to get insights, save readings, and share fun results with friends. Many users enjoy returning to explore how their palm readings evolve and to compare new scans with past results.
Palm Reader is free to download with optional auto-renewing subscriptions for unlimited access to all features.
Results are for entertainment and curiosity only. Accuracy is not guaranteed. 
Subscription & Premium Access 
Palm Reader is free to download and use with basic features. For an enhanced experience with unlimited readings and advanced tools, you can choose from our in-app subscription plans. 
Billing Details 
* Payment is billed to your Apple ID account once the purchase is confirmed.
* Your subscription automatically renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
* Within 24 hours before your subscription cycle ends, your account will be charged the renewal fee, and you’ll be informed of the renewal amount. 
Manage or Cancel 
* You can manage your subscription, or turn off auto-renewal, anytime through your Apple ID account settings after purchase.
* Disabling auto-renew stops future charges but doesn’t immediately cancel your current subscription.
Privacy & Terms 
We are committed to transparency and protecting your information. Your use of the app is governed by our privacy and terms policies: 
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/hanjadevi/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/hanjadevi/termsconditions

bluejetty:00089438:ios.name: Lively Health & Safety Service
bluejetty:00089438:ios.summary: With the Lively app, you can now access the Lively® Urgent Response Team right on your phone. In an emergency, tap the Urgent Response icon on your iPhone and you’ll be connected to a certified Urgent Response Agent who will get you the hel
bluejetty:00089438:ios.description:
With the Lively app, you can now access the Lively® Urgent Response Team right on your phone. In an emergency, tap the Urgent Response icon on your iPhone and you’ll be connected to a certified Urgent Response Agent who will get you the help you need no matter the situation. We’re highly trained in assisting you through situations where you may feel unsafe, aren’t sure who to call for help, or if you are experiencing a medical emergency. We will work with you, contact your family or friends if desired and stay on the line with you until help arrives.
You can even speak to a registered nurse or board-certified doctor with our Nurse On-Call service anytime, day or night (Premium Health and Safety subscription required; no additional costs or copays or insurance needed).
At Lively, we also provide a community of support for our products and services. Our U.S. based customer service team stands ready to assist you. From technical support professionals to customer service representatives, we always have the right person available when you need assistance of any kind.
The Lively app requires an active Lively Health & Safety Service subscription. Already a member? Simply download the app and sign in using your cell phone number.
Lively Health & Safety Service includes:
Lively Urgent Response:
Just tap Urgent Response to be connected to a certified Agent who will get you the help you need.
Urgent Response can help if you:
• Are locked out of your home
• Require roadside assistance
• Need directions in an unfamiliar area
• Are experiencing chest pain
Lively Nurse On-Call:
With Lively Nurse On-Call, you can consult with a registered nurse or board-certified doctor anytime.
• Get prescriptions or refills over the phone for common medications
• No insurance plan is necessary and there are no copays*
Lively Link® app:
Lively Link is a complementary smartphone app loved ones can download to stay updated on your health and safety. After they download the app — and with your permission — they can be alerted:
• If you call Urgent Response
• If your device is running low on battery
• About your daily activities and your location
*Service provided in partnership with Current Health and MDLIVE. Registered nurses evaluate medical urgency, provide symptom management or health information, transfer to a physician if appropriate and schedule appointments. Physician transfer subject to screening by Current Health (and subject to Doctor availability). Emergencies will be transferred to a 911 call center, or members may be directed to call 911.

bluejetty:00129411:ios.description:
You find yourself in rustic, pre-modern Tuscany, where you’ve inherited a meager vineyard. You own a few plots of land, an old crush pad, a tiny cellar, 3 workers…and the dream of owning the best winery in Italy.
Your job is to allocate your workers and helpful visitors to complete various tasks throughout the year. Each season is different on a vineyard, so the workers have different tasks they can take care of in the summer and winter. There’s competition over those tasks, and often the first worker to arrive at each one has an advantage over the rest.
Using those workers and visitors, you can expand your vineyard by building structures, planting vines, and filling wine orders as you work towards the goal of owning the most successful winery in Tuscany.
Features:
• 1 to 6 players
• Family friendly – non violent theme
• Cross Platform
• Easy tutorial to learn the game from scratch.
• Single-player mode with 3 challenging levels of computer opponents.
• Multiplayer games against your friends in friendly games. 
• Face players from all over the world in ranked multiplayer games online!
• Worlwide leaderboard
• Take your time in asynchronous game mode with push notifications and never miss a turn.
• Analyze your best games or learn tricks from the best with playback
• Uses the newest rules of the board game.

bluejetty:00119141:ios.summary:

Replace your Paper or Computer forms with similar forms that are available at your Fingertips.

bluejetty:00119141:ios.description:
Complete set of over 100 electronic forms for your business
Replace your Paper or Computer forms with similar forms that are available at your Fingertips. 
Store any form-based information directly on the iPhone, and access it anytime, anywhere. Your critical information won't get misplaced, misfiled, or become log-jammed. 
*** KEY FEATURES ***
- The app comes with over 100 business forms (quotations, invoices, purchase orders, work orders, service orders, meeting notes, memos, etc.). And we are constantly adding new forms;
- No Internet connection is required to work on the forms.
- Forms support all basic controls, including text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, drop downs.
- Many forms include spreadsheet-like formulas for auto-calculations;
- Forms can contain Signature panels, so you will capture customers signature directly on iPnone;
- Share Forms - start working on a form on one iPhone, or iPad, then use "Share via email" feature and the app will send form with all entered data to another iPhone, or iPad, for completion;
- Forms include popup Calendar control (supporting different date formats);
- Forms even support Drawing panels to make notes and do reviews.
- Completed forms can be Printed (on AirPrint-compatible printer), Emailed, or copied to a computer, for later printing (on any printer).
- Pre-build forms can be customized with your Company name, logo, address and contact information (requires in-app purchase).
- Forms, and their data, can be saved in several different formats: HTML (available for free), or PDF, CSV and XML (available after in-app purchase). 
- Forms-2-Go is an Open system - it allows users to add their own forms. Instructions are available on Support forum.
Don't see a form that your business depends on? Not a problem. 
If your form is already in electronic (HTML) format - you just need to package (see Support forum) and import it into the app. 
Otherwise, contact our Sales team for estimate.
*** iPad version is available under 'Forms-2-Go HD' name ***

bluejetty:00182864:ios.description:
Dreaming of Hollywood stardom? Hollywood Story offers you the chance to turn those dreams into reality! Step into the star-studded streets of Hollywood and carve your own path to fame. Dominate the red carpets, mingle with fans and celebrities, and build your fashion empire to become the ultimate Hollywood icon!
CREATE YOUR HOLLYWOOD STAR
Customize your avatar with an incredible selection of clothing options, fashion styles, hairstyles, and makeup choices. Leave your unique mark on the industry as you perfect your look, from glamorous gowns to chic streetwear!
SHOOT BLOCKBUSTERS
Land auditions, star in blockbuster films, and promote your movies to earn legions of devoted fans who will solidify your status as a megastar! From action-packed thrillers to heartwarming romances, your on-screen presence will captivate audiences worldwide!
DIVE INTO FASHION
Connect with renowned designers and flaunt exclusive couture made just for you! Experience the excitement of fashion showdowns as you take center stage, showcasing your impeccable style and trendsetting designs! Project your unique sense of style and become the ultimate fashionista!
BUILD YOUR FAN BASE
Launch your own fashion line, develop signature fragrances, and amass a dedicated fanbase! Leave an impression fit for royalty as you grace the covers of fashion magazines and inspire millions with your unparalleled elegance and charm!
DATE CELEBRITIES
Rub shoulders with Hollywood's elite at lavish parties and exclusive events—live the dream and mingle with the stars! From A-list actors to chart-topping musicians, your social circle will be brimming with excitement and glamour!
EXPLORE ICONIC LOCATIONS
Unlock new destinations like Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Manhattan, and Las Vegas as you progress! Immerse yourself in style games and explore glamorous locales, from luxurious penthouses to chic boutiques, as you soak in the glitz and glamour of the entertainment industry!
GRACE THE COVERS
With great fame comes great media frenzy! Paparazzi will be waiting outside your home, ready to snap your picture for tabloid covers. Embrace the spotlight and showcase your makeover skills to stun the world, dazzling on every magazine cover and red carpet event!
CONNECT AND SHARE
Meet new friends, visit their homes, and showcase your achievements to the world! Connect with fellow stylists and share your style tips, as you inspire and empower others to chase their dreams and conquer the world of fashion and entertainment!

bluejetty:00142572:ios.description:
The smart treatment for insect bites with heat
heat it® is a smartphone add-on for fast and effective treatment of itchy insect bites. The medical device heat it® is required to use this app: https://heatit.de.
Five good reasons for the insect bite healer heat it®
1) Medically confirmed working principle 
heat it® is a smart medical device for the treatment of insect bites. To relieve itching and pain, the affected skin area is briefly heated to around 51 °C. This working principle of local hyperthermia is based purely on concentrated heat and is medically confirmed.
2) Chemical-free & fast application 
Thanks to heat it®, you can treat mosquito, horsefly, bee and wasp bites within moments using your smartphone. The heat treatment works completely without chemicals and can be easily controlled via this app.
3) Always on your keychain 
heat it® is your ideal companion in everyday life, on trips and during sports. The compact design means you always have it on your keychain and are always armed against itchy stings.
4) For the whole family 
With our app you can adjust the treatment individually to your sensation. Therefore, heat it® is also suitable for children from 4 years (self-application from 12 years).
5) Made in Germany 
Thanks to a sophisticated safety concept, your smartphone and its battery are optimally protected. heat it® does not need its own batteries. So you can benefit from an innovative product without follow-up costs. Up to 1,000 uses are possible per cell phone charge.
Try it out: You will be thrilled - For a summer without itching and scratching!
We welcome any feedback, questions and comments.

heat it® is a smartphone add-on for fast and effective treatment of itchy insect bites. The medical device heat it® is required to use this app: https://heatit.de.

Five good reasons for the insect bite healer heat it®

1) Medically confirmed working principle 

heat it® is a smart medical device for the treatment of insect bites. To relieve itching and pain, the affected skin area is briefly heated to around 51 °C. This working principle of local hyperthermia is based purely on concentrated heat and is medically confirmed.

2) Chemical-free & fast application 

Thanks to heat it®, you can treat mosquito, horsefly, bee and wasp bites within moments using your smartphone. The heat treatment works completely without chemicals and can be easily controlled via this app.

3) Always on your keychain 

heat it® is your ideal companion in everyday life, on trips and during sports. The compact design means you always have it on your keychain and are always armed against itchy stings.

4) For the whole family 

With our app you can adjust the treatment individually to your sensation. Therefore, heat it® is also suitable for children from 4 years (self-application from 12 years).

5) Made in Germany 

Thanks to a sophisticated safety concept, your smartphone and its battery are optimally protected. heat it® does not need its own batteries. So you can benefit from an innovative product without follow-up costs. Up to 1,000 uses are possible per cell phone charge.

Try it out: You will be thrilled - For a summer without itching and scratching!

We welcome any feedback, questions and comments.

bluejetty:00073413:ios.description:
Leafly is the world's #1 cannabis resource and weed app. Use Leafly to find dispensaries near you, review strains, or order weed delivery.
Millions of people use Leafly's award-winning weed finder app to discover cannabis that's right for them based on reported effects, feelings, and reviews of thousands of marijuana strains. Find nearby legal weed for your medical or recreational needs with our dispensary finder.
Leafly App Features:
- Discover your ideal strains, tinctures, topicals, concentrates, or pot edibles based on thousands of user-submitted reviews.
- Browse strains by desired effects, aromas, flavors, recommended lists, and availability at nearby dispensaries or retail stores.
- Use our dispensary finder to find weed delivery services and pickup options in your area. Locate a doctor, clinic, THC or CBD products, or leave a review.
- Browse menus, view weed deals and specials and read the latest user reviews.
- Receive daily notifications from your favorite medical marijuana dispensaries, retail stores, or weed delivery services.
- Read the latest news and lifestyle information with Leafly News and Learn, where we bring you Cannabis 101 resources, the latest medical studies, legalization updates, and other compelling cannabis content. 
- Watch videos to learn how to use, grow, cook, and create with marijuana.
No matter your preference, the Leafly app will help you choose the right type of weed for you. Whether you're a medical marijuana patient or a recreational cannabis user, you'll love the Leafly app!

bluejetty:00127847:ios.name: SuperFast EV Chargers
bluejetty:00127847:ios.summary: Superchargers For Tesla & EVs is a comprehensive and dynamic database of Tesla Superchargers around the globe. It builds on top of SuperCharge.info, and adds several features including check-ins, photos, nearby points of interest, discussio
bluejetty:00127847:ios.description:
Superchargers For Tesla & EVs is a comprehensive and dynamic database of Tesla Superchargers around the globe. It builds on top of SuperCharge.info, and adds several features including check-ins, photos, nearby points of interest, discussion forum and user comments for each Supercharger. It also includes support for Range Circles. With Range Circles you can easily predict your distance from multiple Superchargers to anywhere along your route.
Ndili Technologies, Inc. has no affiliation to, and is not associated or sponsored by Tesla, Inc.
One goal of Superchargers For Tesla & EVs is to provide near-real-time status of each Supercharger. The app sources some of its information (such as check-in status) from its user-base, so its information potential grows with time.
Features include:
• Variable Range Circles: Range circles tell how far from each Supercharger you are.
• Nearby Points of Interest: View nearby points of interest, including restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and nearby tourist attractions.
• Latest Status: Recent check-ins have the option to display how many stalls are free/busy for each Supercharger.
• Forums and User Comments: Follow along on Forum Discussions for new, upcoming and existing Superchargers. Drop comments and read comments from other users.
• Photos: View rich photographs contributed by users.
• Latest Supercharger Network Updates: View a summarized list of the very latest updates and changes to the Tesla Supercharger network across the globe.
• Activity Alerts: Receive alerts and updates for Superchargers that you show recent interest in. Alerts include new user comments, photos, point-of-interest, and check-ins.
With Superchargers For Tesla & EVs you can be up to date with the very latest Supercharger plans and deployments.
Notes:
1. Superchargers For Tesla sources its core database information from Supercharge.info. In addition, several other streams of information are crowd-sourced, such as charge status, commentary, POIs, photos and check-in
2. Superchargers For Tesla uses Apple Push Notifications for alerting, and requires that you enable Notifications for this app if you wish to receive live updates on Superchargers of interest to you.
3. Based on its increasing user-base and active notification system, over time it may be possible to get live status updates on Superchargers, including up-to-the-minute charging stall occupancy/availability data.
Ndili Technologies, Inc. has no affiliation to, and is not associated or sponsored by Tesla, Inc.

bluejetty:00023210:ios.summary: Informieren Sie sich mit der SRF Meteo App schnell und verlässlich über das Wetter in der Schweiz und der ganzen Welt. Speichern Sie Ihre Lieblingsorte als Favoriten und behalten Sie das Wetter jederzeit im Überblick. Mit dem dreimal täglic
bluejetty:00023210:ios.description:
Informieren Sie sich mit der SRF Meteo App schnell und verlässlich über das Wetter in der Schweiz und der ganzen Welt. Speichern Sie Ihre Lieblingsorte als Favoriten und behalten Sie das Wetter jederzeit im Überblick. Mit dem dreimal täglich aktualisierten Wetterbericht der SRF Meteo Redaktion sind Sie stets auf dem Laufenden über die Wetterprognose für die Schweiz.
Interaktive Wetterkarten ermöglichen es Ihnen, die aktuellen Wetterbedingungen und Vorhersagen genauer zu analysieren. Der SRF Meteo Niederschlagsradar zeigt Ihnen die Entwicklung der letzten 24 Stunden sowie die Modellprognose der kommenden 48 Stunden. Unsere saisonalen Wetterkarten bieten Informationen zu Pollen, Badewetter, Surfwetter, Segelwetter und Blattverfärbungsprognose. Während den Wintermonaten finden Sie in der SRF Meteo App die Schneewetter-Karte mit aktueller Schneehöhe, Neuschneehöhe und Lawinengefahr.
Nutzen Sie dank unseren Widgets das aktuelle Wetter von SRF Meteo kompakt auf dem Startbildschirm Ihres Smartphones.
Im Bereich «Hintergrund» werden aktuelle Wetterphänomene durch Ihre SRF Meteo Expert:innen eingeordnet und erklärt. Zudem können Sie in unserer Meteo Galerie die schönsten Wetterbilder und Wettervideos unserer User entdecken.
Mit über 30 in der ganzen Schweiz verteilten Webcams machen Sie sich ein Bild über das aktuelle Wetter.
Bei Gewitter und anderen Unwettern an Ihren bevorzugten Schweizer Orten und Ihrem Standort werden Sie per Pushmeldungen und direkt in der App mithilfe der Wetterwarnungen alarmiert.
WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN:
• Alle relevanten Wetterinformationen auf einen Blick
• Vorhersage und Wetterbericht für die ganze Schweiz
• Lokale Prognosen im Tagesverlauf für nationale und internationale Orte
• Niederschlagsradar zeigt die Entwicklung der letzten 24h sowie der kommenden 48h
• Interaktive und zoombare Wetterkarten
• Widgets mit aktuellen Wetterinformationen zu Ihren Favoriten und Ihrem Standort
• Aktueller Schneebericht mit Schneehöhe, Neuschneehöhe und Lawinengefahr (saisonal)
• Informationen zur Gesamtbelastung durch Pollen (saisonal)
• Über 30 Webcams zeigen in Echtzeit das Wetter in der Schweiz
• Speichern Sie Ihre Lieblingsorte als Favoriten
• Wetterwarnungen per Push-Meldung und direkt in Ihrer App
• Hintergründe und Wissenswertes zur aktuellen Wetterlage
• Infos zu den SRF Meteo Expert:innen
• Darkmode passend zu Ihren Systemeinstellungen oder nach Ihren Bedürfnissen einstellbar
• Werbefrei
Gefällt Ihnen die SRF Meteo App? Dann nehmen Sie sich doch ein paar Minuten Zeit für eine Bewertung. Wir berücksichtigen Ihr Feedback bei der Weiterentwicklung.
Bei Problemen mit der SRF Meteo App wenden Sie sich bitte an den SRF Kundendienst via https://www.srf.ch/kontakt oder Telefon (+41 848 80 80 80).

bluejetty:00067792:ios.description:
Conoce la nueva forma de comprar tus boletos de autobús con la nueva aplicación de Autovías La Línea, planifica tus rutas de viaje consultando nuestros horarios de autobuses.
Ofrecemos servicios de transporte de envíos de Paquetería y Mensajería ligera con servicio a través de nuestras oficinas ubicadas a lo largo de nuestras rutas de transporte.
¿Quieres viajar con autobuses Autovías la Línea?
Autovías te permite planificar tus rutas de viaje y comprar tu boleto de autobus de forma rápida y sencilla. Contamos con descuentos y promociones para viajar en autobús.
Elige ciudad, elige los asientos de autobús y compra tu boleto de transporte público, tus viajes en Autovías son seguros y cómodos..
Planifica tus viajes y rutas en autobús. Los viajes en transporte público de Autovías te harán disfrutar de lo mejor de ir en autobús ofreciéndo:
- Tranquilidad en tus rutas de viaje 
- Comodidad en nuestros autobuses
- Horarios de autobuses actualizados y rutas
- Opción de comprar tu boleto de transporte público desde la app. 
Compra tus boletos de autobús y viaja con Autovías, La Línea, Pegasso y Sur de Jalisco, tu transporte público de confianza.
DESCUENTOS AUTOVÍAS LA LÍNEA
Viajar con nuestros autobuses desde cualquier ruta, te podrá beneficiar de descuentos y ofertas para lograr una mejor experiencia de viaje con tu boleto.
Si viajas con personas mayores o con menores de edad en nuestro autobús, obtendrán un 50% de descuento comprando tu boleto desde nuestra app.
También lanzamos descuentos temporales cada mes, para que puedas hacer viajes a ciudades de México en transporte público.
RENTA DE AUTOBUSES
Si estás buscando rentar un Autobús Cómodo, de Modelo Reciente, Unidades Seguras y Sanitizadas estás en el lugar correcto. Nuestras unidades son ideales para excursiones, viajes familiares, campamentos, viajes, así como tours a nivel nacional para el fin de semana o bien nos adaptamos a los que necesites y así, tú disfrutes tu viaje. 
COMPRA TUS BOLETOS DE AUTOBUS
Viajes y rutas a ciudades de México en autobús, selecciona el horario y compra el boleto, podrás ahorrar hasta un 15% en tus boletos comprando desde la app.
Garantizamos la compra segura de boletos de autobús, además contamos con diferentes métodos de pago, para que puedas comprar tu boleto a través de tu método favorito de pago.
GANA PUNTOS DOTERS CON AUTOVÍAS LA LÍNEA
Gana Puntos Doters con tus compras de boletos de autobuses de Autovías La Línea y disfruta de beneficios y recompensas. Todos tus viajes en transporte público te darán puntos que podrás canjear.
-  Boletos recompensa
 - Abordaje prioritario en nuestros autobuses
-  Descuentos en paquetería
ENVÍOS DE PAQUETERÍA Y MENSAJERÍA
Servicios de transporte para el envío de paquetería y mensajería ligera desde nuestra web. Envía de manera rápida, económica y segura, con Bus Envío obtienes servicios con garantía de seguridad y los mejores tiempos de entrega.
DESTINOS MÉXICO
Con Autovías podrás viajar a ciudades de México como: Ciudad de México, Morelia, Guadalajara y Colima. Compra tus boletos de autobús desde la app para viajar por MX. Contamos con una gran cantidad de horarios de autobús para que puedas elegir las rutas que más te gusten. Además podrás viajar en cualquiera de nuestros 10 tipos de autobuses. Elige con cuál de ellos harás tu viaje. 
Podrás viajar con tranquilidad en tus rutas de viaje y comodidad en nuestros autobuses. También contamos con horarios de autobuses actualizados de todas nuestras rutas. Compra tu boleto o boletos de transporte público si viajas en grupo desde nuestra app.
Descarga la app y compra tu boleto para viajar en autobús. ¡Podrás disfrutar de promociones y ver todas nuestras rutas y horarios de autobuses!

bluejetty:00091746:ios.description:
Save time and hassles while making the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA health benefit accounts by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
 • Simply login to the intuitive app using your same health benefits website username and password (or follow alternative instructions if provided to you) 
Connects You with the Details 
 • Quickly check available balances 24/7 
 • Access account details 
 • View charts summarizing account(s) 
 • Click to call or email Customer Service
Provides Additional Time-Saving Options (if supported or applicable to your account(s)) 
 • View claims requiring receipts 
 • Submit medical FSA and HRA claims
 • Take a picture of a receipt and submit for a new or existing claim
 • View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
 • Using Dashboard, enter medical expense information and supporting documentation to store for later use in paying claims via your health benefits website
 • Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX Health®

bluejetty:00083846:ios.description:

Key features:
- Easily identify thousands of rocks
- Record identification accuracy
- A huge amount of information about each stone, as well as interesting facts collected from the most popular sites
- User-friendly and beautiful interface
- Easy create your own collection
- Share your discoveries with friends and save to the gallery
Create rock collection
Display your properties and treasures of rock hunting, create your personal museum of rock identifications. Now you can record your stories with stones & minerals, easily mark down the stone id, locations, dates, purchase price and other features of rock observations.
Explore trendy stones
Interested in raw stone, natural gemstones, or crystal clusters? Download this rock scanner app to figure out the mysteries of rocks all around the world. Discover fun facts about stones, such as Healing crystals, Tumbled Stones, Birthstones, Zodiac Gemstones and more.

bluejetty:00158152:android.description:
Wood Block Jam - A Fun and Addictive Puzzle Challenge!
Welcome to Wood Block Jam, the color-matching puzzle game that will test your logic, strategy, and problem-solving skills! 
Get ready to immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors, challenging levels, and brain-teasing obstacles. 
Wood Block Jam features an intuitive yet challenging puzzle mechanic where players must move colored blocks to their respective doors to clear them from the board. Each level presents a unique layout with various obstacles, requiring players to think strategically before making a move. The goal is simple: move all the blocks to their designated areas using the fewest moves possible.
How to Play Wood Block Jam 
✅ Swipe & Slide – Move blocks in any direction.
🎨 Match Colors – Guide each block to its matching exit.
🚧 Avoid Obstacles – Navigate barriers and tricky layouts.
🧠 Plan Your Moves – Think ahead to clear the board efficiently.
🏆 Complete Levels – Solve puzzles and advance to new challenges!
As you progress, the levels become more intricate, featuring special mechanics such as: arrow block, layer block, freeze block, lock block, ...
Key Features:
🔥 Hundreds of unique levels – From easy to mind-twisting puzzles.
🧩 Special blocks & mechanics – Arrow blocks, lock blocks, freeze blocks & more!
🎮 Intuitive & addictive gameplay – Easy to learn, challenging to master.
🌟 Visually stunning design – Bright colors and smooth animations.
Join and challenge Wood Block Jam!
Are you ready to dive into the colorful world of Wood Block Jam: Block Away? Play now and start solving puzzles today!
Challenge yourself and become a Wood Block Jam master!

bluejetty:00134501:ios.name: REC - Pro Video Camera
bluejetty:00134501:ios.summary: Elevate your video capturing with REC! Tailored for creators, it provides extensive video and audio options for professional-quality production effortlessly. Choose from a range of camera settings, stabilization options, resolutions, frame
bluejetty:00134501:ios.description:
Elevate your video capturing with REC! Tailored for creators, it provides extensive video and audio options for professional-quality production effortlessly. Choose from a range of camera settings, stabilization options, resolutions, frame rates, and more to capture the perfect video every time. And with intuitive controls and an easy-to-read heads-up display, you can adjust focus, exposure, and more with just a tap.
Plus, with REC's timecode feature, you can easily synchronize footage from multiple devices for seamless, multi-angle videos. Choose from "Time of Day" timecode or use Bluetooth sync with Tentacle Sync devices for precise, one-frame resolution synchronization. And with seamless management options, including preview, watch, and send directly to your photo library or favorite editing app, you can create and share professional-quality videos with ease.
Here's a quick summary of REC's plethora of video options:
- Camera: Front, Telephoto, Wide, Ultra-Wide (As available on your device.)
- Camera Stabilization (As available by device and camera selection.)
- Resolution: Open Gate, 4K, 1080p, 720p (As available by device.)
- FPS: 240, 120, 60, 50, 48, 30, 29.97, 25, 24, 23.98 (As available by device and camera selection.)
- Bit Rate: Normal, High, Max
- Dynamic Range: 8 Bit, 10 Bit, 10 Bit HDR (As available by device and other selections.)
- Format: HEVC, H.264, ProRes 422 HQ, ProRes RAW HQ (As available by device and other selections.)
- Lock Exposure and White Balance when recording begins.
- Apple Log and Apple Log 2 support when recording in ProRes.
- External storage support for iPhone 15 to 17 Pro using USB-C,
Audio
Here's a quick summary of REC's extensive audio options:
- Microphone: Front, Back, Bottom, External (As available on your device.)
- Microphone Gain control
- Microphone Polar Pattern control: Choose omni, subcardioid, cardioid or stereo pickup depending on what best fits your usage. (As available by device and microphone.)
- Sample Rate: 24Khz, 44.1Khz, 48Khz
- Format: AAC, PCM
Lot of options! But REC gives you simplicity along with flexibility, you'll never be able to select a combination that doesn't work with your device.
Captivating Controls
REC's floating buttons put pro level controls at your fingertips, and keeps them out of the way while you're focusing on what's important, shooting your video! A single tap brings up any of the control menus where you can adjust the white balance, shutter speed, ISO, EV, and focus manually. Or, use our intuitive touch controls to specify precisely where in your frame focus on and expose to. Quickly swap between the Wide, Ultra-Wide, Telephoto, or Front cameras and different formats with a flick of your finger, and your selection is always available at a glance. Optionally overlay a grid, and zoom in or out to help you frame the perfect shot every time.
Terrific Timecodes
REC provides two Timecode methods. The first one is "Time of Day", which simply records your device's clock information alongside the video. In order for it to work, just make sure all your devices are set to the same time. For really accurate and extremely simple synchronization, REC also provides Bluetooth sync using Tentacle Sync devices. Using Tentacle Timecode, REC is able to synchronize your iPhone footage with high accuracy. You can find more about the Tentacle Sync solutions at https://tentaclesync.com.
Marvelous Management
REC saves all of your videos seamlessly to the built-in manager that lets you quickly and easily preview your creations. Watch your shots at different speeds, and preview them without sound if you're trying to find the right shot to share in a sensitive environment. Sending a video to your photo library or favorite editor is just a tap away. Or if you'd prefer, send videos directly to the Photo Library and enjoy its seamless integration with any app that supports video.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023884:ios.description:
Instantly remove background from images and create transparent or colorful backgrounds on your iPhone. Background Eraser lets you apply colors, filters, borders, and even add text to change background in your photos and save as high-quality PNG or JPEG.
Looking for the best background removal app for iPhone? Use our AI-infused tool to automatically cut out objects or people in the background. Simply select your image from the library, and the app will do the rest!
Key Features of Background Eraser:
• One tap to remove background from photos automatically
• Crop, rotate, and flip images for adjustment
• Manual background remover to erase or restore any objects
• Add custom text and emojis to a photo background
• Add border outline to a photo with different colors
• Inbuilt image background color changer
• Apply amazing photo filters from 100+ presets
• Change resolution before saving your edited photos in PNG or JPEG format
• Instantly share your creation on multiple platforms like Facebook, Instagram, etc.
Remove Background with AI
The built-in automatic background remover works like a charm – needing you to only select an image from the gallery. After the AI background removal, you can use the Eraser tool to manually delete background from images and achieve perfection.
Change Background Color
Wondering how to change the background of a photo to a different color? Choose your pick from the palette and change background color of any photo on your iPhone. You can add white background to a photo or make the background transparent as well.
Text, Emojis, Filters – You name it
Add text and emojis to images to personalize your captures the way you want. You can also apply photo effects and filters to enhance the appearance, add border frame to change the outlook, and so on.
How to remove background from a picture on iPhone?
Using the Background Eraser app to crop out or remove people and objects from photo backgrounds is easy – 
- Launch the app and tap on the Plus (+) button.
- Choose an image from your iPhone Library.
- Crop or rotate if needed. Then hit Next.
- It will automatically remove the background for you. To further refine the edges, use the Eraser tool for adjustments.

DoorDash is available in over 7,000 cities in all 50 U.S. states, including Washington, D.C. and Puerto Rico; over 80 cities in Canada; and Melbourne, Australia, with more coming soon.

bluejetty:00095928:android.description:
Build your dream house, start a family, raise kids, and live a true virtual life in the unique Happy Family Simulator!
In this family game and life simulator, you’ll experience all stages of adult life — from finding a partner and building a home to raising children, managing a family budget, and solving psychological challenges.
Your story in Happy Family Simulator begins with your choices:
 • 🏡 Build and furnish your home — choose layouts, furniture, and interior design.
 • ❤️ Find a partner for a serious relationship, fall in love, get married, and enjoy family life.
 • 👶 Have and raise children — care for them, educate, and develop their talents.
 • 💼 Find a job, grow your career, and achieve financial stability.
 • 💰 Manage your family budget — expenses, savings, and investments.
 • 🤝 Build relationships with friends and relatives — support, conflicts, and reconciliation.

In this decision-making game, every choice you make will shape your future. Decide how to spend your time and money: focus on your career or family, invest or relax, help friends or pursue personal goals.
Why you’ll love it:
 • A realistic real-life simulator with dozens of scenarios.
 • Freedom of choice and non-linear story progression.
 • The atmosphere of a true virtual family with emotions and events.
 • Experience different roles: parent, spouse, friend, and professional.
Happy Family Simulator — your chance to create the life of your dreams!
Download this free family game now, live through decades of virtual life, and see if you can handle all the challenges of real adult life.

It’s just like having a Jack in the Box in your pocket, only it doesn’t weigh 350 tons and have people that work inside it. Then there’s the offers and deals you can’t find anywhere else. Like The Jack Pack. It’s like a secret VIP club of rewards. Only it’s not really secret. In fact, please don’t keep it a secret. Tell everyone.

App Features:
· Order food for pick-up or delivery through the app
· Browse the all food, all day Jack in the Box menu
· Find your nearest Jack location
· Earn points, and redeem rewards with The Jack Pack loyalty program
· Special mobile app-only Offers, Deals and App Exclusives
· Enable push notifications and never miss a great deal
· App will read your mind and tell you what you want – just kidding! Or are we…*

*We are. For now.

bluejetty:00096339:ios.description:
"المغاربية" قناة تلفزيونية فضائية مغاربية مستقلة.
"المغاربية" قناة فضائية حوارية وإخبارية تعمل على تسليط الضوء على القضايا السياسية والإقتصادية والإجتماعية التي تهم المواطنين في المنطقة المغاربية.
تهدف قناة "المغاربية" من خلال مختلف موادها الإعلامية إلى مدّ جسور التواصل بين شعوب المنطقة المغاربية والمساهمة في تكريس حق المواطنين في الوصول إلى المعلومة الصحيحة ومتابعة خدمة إعلامية تعتمد الرصانة والموضوعية وترتكزعلى المهنية والحرفية وتضمن حرية التعبير وتُبرز الرأي والرأي الآخر.
- قناة "المغاربية" وهي تقدم خدمتها الإعلامية للجمهورالمغاربي تسعى لأن تكون فضاءً لتواصل شعوب المنطقة، يطَّلعون من خلاله على واقعهم دون تعتيم أو تزييف، ويُطلون منه على العالم وتطورات شعوبه، كما تفتح المجال أمام جمهورها للمساهمة بحركيته في نصرة القيم الإنسانية وتعزيزها، وعلى رأسها قيم الحرية والمساواة والتسامح وحقوق الإنسان.

bluejetty:00063616:ios.summary: Zombie Tower Defense: Join the ongoing war, in an open world, against the zombie horde, scavenging raiders and other threats roaming the wasteland! Choose between multiple powerful heroes all with unique epic gear and skills! With the wide
bluejetty:00063616:ios.description:
Zombie Tower Defense: Join the ongoing war, in an open world, against the zombie horde, scavenging raiders and other threats roaming the wasteland! Choose between multiple powerful heroes all with unique epic gear and skills! With the wide variety of towers you can create your own perfect strategy. Enjoy a visually stunning tower defense game in full 3D!
Game Features
- Over 140 levels which will challenge your defense and strategy. Find the reason behind the zombie invasion, take out the raider leader scavenging the land or fight in the arena for coins and glory!
- 8 Special Heroes to choose between, the precious Princess, mighty Barbarian, mysterious Scout, gun crazy Mechanic, support Soldier, Mech warrior, experimenting Scientist or the righteous Sheriff. 
- 12 Different Towers to defend yourself with, each with a unique research tree to make them even more powerful! Pierce the zombies with arrows from an Arrow Tower, blow them to pieces with a Mortar Tower or electrify them with a Tesla Tower.
- Explore the wasteland and encounter over 50 types of enemies. If that's not enough, go up against 5 Boss monsters that are scattered across the map waiting to rush you!
- Mighty Hero skills and Epic god skills, destroy the undead with one heavenly strike or shake the zombies by moving the earth.
- Monster Tome, useful for finding your enemies weaknesses!
- Many hours of gameplay including ingame Achievements with rewards and also unique rewards for completing levels and different challenges.
- Three different difficulty settings: Normal, Hard & Nightmare! Challenge yourself and earn extra coins and XP by doing so! Good Luck!
- Endless mode, Time to show the world who is the greatest!
Download this fun free game now and get ready for some intense battlefields and epic boss battles!

bluejetty:00019072:ios.name: Dunidle: Auto Battler RPG Game
bluejetty:00019072:ios.summary: Introducing Dunidle, an immersive idle RPG adventure that combines classic 8-bit aesthetics with addictive gameplay. Embark on an epic journey in a pixelated realm filled with legendary heroes, monstrous creatures, and treacherous dungeons.
bluejetty:00019072:ios.description:
Introducing Dunidle, an immersive idle RPG adventure that combines classic 8-bit aesthetics with addictive gameplay. Embark on an epic journey in a pixelated realm filled with legendary heroes, monstrous creatures, and treacherous dungeons. With its offline capabilities, you can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.
In Dunidle, you assume the role of a group of mighty heroes destined to save the realm from darkness of the dark lord. Upgrade your hero's abilities, acquire powerful equipment, and collect rare loot to enhance your combat prowess. Engage in intense team fights and tactical battles against formidable bosses and monsters, employing clever strategies and tactics to emerge victorious.
The game features an incremental progression system that rewards you for your dedication. As you grind your way through battles, your hero and their team will gradually grow stronger, allowing you to conquer even more challenging raids and dungeons. The auto-battle feature lets you sit back and watch your heroes battle on their own, making it perfect for players who prefer a more relaxed experience.
Explore the vast 2D realm, uncovering hidden secrets, and encountering AI-controlled characters who will aid or hinder you in your quest. Delve into dungeons filled with perilous traps and valuable treasures as you traverse the realm as a brave dungeon crawler. Unleash devastating skills and unlock unique abilities as you become a legendary hero in your own right.
Key Features:
 - Classic 8-bit pixel art style that captures the essence of retro RPGs.
 - Engaging offline idle RPG gameplay, allowing you to enjoy the adventure anytime, anywhere.
 - Upgrade your hero and equip them with legendary gear to maximize their potential.
 - Collect rare loot and equipment to enhance your hero's abilities.
 - Strategic team fights and tactical battles that require clever planning and execution.
 - Face off against powerful bosses and terrifying monsters.
 - Grow your hero and team through incremental progression and dedicated grinding.
 - Raid dungeons filled with traps, treasures, and epic encounters.
 - Auto-battle feature lets your heroes fight for you while you sit back and relax.
 - Encounter AI-controlled characters with their own agendas and storylines.
 - Immerse yourself in a vast 2D realm filled with adventure and mystery.
Embark on an unforgettable journey as a Realm Hero and save the pixelated realm from impending doom! Download Dunidle: now and become the legendary heroes you were born to be.

bluejetty:00093302:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate tool for trading card game collectors.
Take your trading card game collecting experience to the next level with TCGDex, an AI-powered trading card scanner built for collectors and players. Whether you manage a growing trading card collection, compete in organized play, or want to track card values and TCG prices, TCGDex helps you stay organized, informed, and in control of your collection.
TCGDex is designed for serious TCG collectors who want fast scanning, accurate data, and powerful collection insights in one easy-to-use app.
Main Features
• AI Card Scanner
Instantly identify trading cards using your phone’s camera. Our advanced AI-powered card scanner is trained on thousands of real-world TCG card images, delivering high accuracy even in low light or imperfect angles. Scan any trading card to see its name, rarity, expansion, and current card market value.
• Real-Time Price Tracking
Stay on top of the TCG market with real-time card price tracking from trusted third-party marketplaces. Track trading card prices over time, explore historical price trends, and understand how your card collection value evolves.
• Collection Management
Organize your entire trading card collection in one place. Create custom lists by expansion, rarity, condition, or any category you choose. Track quantities, add personal notes, and highlight your most valuable TCG cards. Your collection is securely backed up and synchronized across all your devices.
• Expansion and Set Progress
Browse complete trading card game expansions and track your progress toward finishing sets. Instantly see which TCG cards you already own and which ones are missing, making it easier to grow and complete your card collection.
• Investment Insights
Analyze your trading card collection value with detailed charts, top movers, and long-term price insights. See which TCG cards are gaining value, which are declining, and how your collection portfolio performs over time.
• Trade and Value Check
Make smarter trading card trades with real-time card value comparisons. Quickly check TCG card prices, identify good trade opportunities, and avoid unfavorable trades at events, card shops, or online marketplaces.
• Advanced Search and Filters
Find any trading card instantly using powerful TCG search tools. Filter and sort by value, rarity, condition, expansion, or your own custom tags.
• Wishlist and Duplicates
Keep track of trading cards you want and duplicates you own. Perfect for managing trades, planning purchases, and growing your TCG collection efficiently.
Why Choose TCGDex
• Accurate and reliable AI-powered trading card scanner
• Real-time TCG price tracking and historical market data
• Clean and intuitive interface built for collectors
• Designed specifically for trading card game collectors
Subscription Information
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store account settings
Disclaimer

TCGDex is an independent application and is not produced, endorsed, supported, or affiliated with The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, GAME FREAK, or Creatures Inc. All card images, names, and related data displayed in this application are the property of their respective owners.

MANUAL CONTROL

Make your every photo exposure perfectly.

bluejetty:00131358:ios.description:
Trailforks is a trail database & map with over 650,000 trails. Users can contribute data and then local trail associations have the control to approve & curate the data. 
Get 14 days of free app use, then upgrade to Trailforks Pro to unlock the map world-wide. Otherwise continue to use the map in your local area for free.
App Features:
- The largest database of mountain bike trails in the world, including thousands of biking related POI's
- Offline trail maps and info. Region updates are incremental and fast
- See your GPS location on the map, for trail navigation
- Record your GPS location during ride creating a track
- Display trail & route elevation profiles and 'scrub' along them to see the location on the map
- View local routes that users have created
- View trail logs from users and discover how to explore a new trail
- Automatic trail routing from your location (or nearest parking lot), to the trailhead of your choosing
- Sync and view your saved plans from the Trailforks website
- Follow race course routes including colored stages and checkpoints
- Lookup region & trail info including routes, photos, videos & more
- Use your phone’s compass to orientate the map in the direction you’re facing
- View trail status & reports! Always be informed of up-to-date trail conditions & closures
- Submit trail reports & conditions from the app, including taking photos of trail issues
- Support the areas you ride, by donating 'Trail Karma'
- View nearby bike shops on the map, quick links for directions or phoning the shop
- View trails on map color coded by popularity
- Mountain biking heatmap!
- View custom worldwide topo maps designed for outdoor trail activities
The Trailforks app is your mobile companion to the Trailforks website. It allows you to download offline trail maps for use on your rides!
Terms of Use: https://www.trailforks.com/about/tou/?source=tfapp&app=1 and https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00126988:ios.description:
Students, upload your assignments to Gradescope more easily than ever before! If your instructor uses Gradescope for your assignments, you can now upload your submission with our mobile app.
After installing and opening the app, login to see your Gradescope courses and assignments. To upload a submission, click on the assignment in the “Not Submitted” tab and either “Select File” to select an existing file from your device or “Scan” all pages of your completed work using your iPhone’s camera. Once you submit your file(s), for templated assignments, you’re all set. For variable-length assignments, “Assign pages” to indicate where your answer for each question appears within your submission. It’s that easy! After confirming, your assignment then moves to the “Submitted” tab. If needed, you can resubmit your assignment until the due date your instructor set has passed. Once it is graded and grades are published for the assignment, it then moves to the “Graded” tab.
Note: For V1 of the app, you will be directed to our mobile website for any advanced functionality, including viewing feedback and submitting timed, programming, or online assignments. Stay tuned for future updates that will allow you to do even more with our mobile app!

Welcome to a better sleep experience! 
FRENZ® Brainband is the world's first AI-powered wearable designed to track and stimulate your brain activities with personalized audio content for improved sleep. The FRENZ® app serves as the companion to the FRENZ® Brainband.
Key features:
Fast Sleep: Help you fall asleep faster with personalized soothing contents.
Deep Sleep: Deepen your deep sleep with science-backed deep sleep boosting function.
Back to Sleep: Soothe and assist you back to sleep with audio contents in case of unwanted midnight wakeups.
Fresh Morning: Wake you up gradually and smoothly at the optimal time during your sleep cycle.
Power Nap: Help you have restorative power naps and wake up refreshed.
Sleep Portrait: Record and display details of your sleep data.
FRENZ® Brainband is an invention by Earable® Neuroscience, a deep tech company dedicated to integrating the latest breakthroughs in neuroscience into daily lives. The development of FRENZ® spanned 9 years with collaborations of scientists from the University of Colorado and the University of Oxford, resulting in 15 global patents and patent-pendings for its core technologies.
Disclaimer: FRENZ® Brainband is a wellness device and not a medical device. It is intended for aiding sleep quality and cognitive functions through personalized audio content. If you have any medical concerns, please consult with your healthcare provider before using this device. The device should not be used as a substitute for medical advice or treatment.
