bluejetty:00119427:ios.summary: Getting started is simple! You just head to stores, snap some photos, and answer a couple of questions. Every now and then, you’ll also speak to a store associate. That’s it! Gigs pay between 6 and 25 dollars, and you’ll usually get paid wi
bluejetty:00119427:ios.description:
Getting started is simple! You just head to stores, snap some photos, and answer a couple of questions. Every now and then, you’ll also speak to a store associate. That’s it! Gigs pay between 6 and 25 dollars, and you’ll usually get paid within 5 days. This side hustle is a great way to earn money for dinner dates, movie nights, and other special occasions!
FAST FACTS
Observa has paid out more than $500,000 to Observers.
Gigs take 30 minutes on average.
You’ll be notified when there are new opportunities near you.
There are more than 700,000 Observers.
Opportunities are available in the United States and Canada.
You’ll usually get paid within 5 days. Please note: this process may take longer over weekends and holidays.
Gigs pay $6-25.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is this a legit way to make PayPal money?
Yes! Observa has been in business since 2016. Today, we work with leading brands like KIND and Beyond Meat. Observers complete opportunities at well-known retailers like Safeway, 7-Eleven, and Walmart.
Do you have opportunities outside of the United States and Canada?
Right now, the vast majority of our opportunities are currently in the United States and Canada. Observa is always working to get additional clients, in order to provide more opportunities for you to earn money.
If you turn your notifications on, you'll be notified when there are new opportunities near you. In the meantime, check out our paid photo challenges, which run every few weeks and can be completed from anywhere.
If Observa rejects an observation, is the data still sent to the customer?
Never. At Observa, we only want to pass along high-quality data to our customers, so we discard data from rejected observations. We only reject an observation if the Observer didn’t follow the instructions correctly. Right now, more than 90% of observations are accepted.
PRESS
Observa has been featured in Mystery Shopper Forum, Gotta Be Mobile, GeekWire, and more!
Mystery Shopper Forum - bit.ly/observamysteryshopperforum
Gotta Be Mobile - bit.ly/observagottabemobile
GeekWire - bit.ly/observageekwire
MORE INFO
Privacy Policy - bit.ly/observaprivacy
Terms of Service - bit.ly/observaterms 
Support - support@observanow.com

• In your voice

Have an idea? Ghost writes a custom post instantly.

Edit, tweak, or rewrite anything before posting. You’re always in control.
• Better every day
Every edit and bit of feedback helps Ghost improve over time.
• Works everywhere

You don’t need viral ideas — you need something smart to say, every day. Ghost helps you show up without the pressure.

bluejetty:00026615:ios.description:
Kardia works with the FDA-cleared KardiaMobile, KardiaMobile 6L, or KardiaBand personal EKG devices, which can detect the most common arrhythmias in just 30 seconds. The Kardia app is designed to make managing heart care from home easier than ever, giving you the ability to seamlessly record EKGs, share heart data with your doctor remotely, keep track of your health history, and more.
Capture a medical-grade EKG with your Kardia device anytime, anywhere—no patches, wires, or gels required. Get an immediate result from Kardia's Instant Analysis of normal, possible atrial fibrillation, bradycardia, or tachycardia. For additional analysis, you can choose to send the recording to your physician or to one of our partners for a Clinician Review by a cardiologist (US, Australia only) or cardiac care physiologist (UK, Ireland only).
The Kardia system is recommended by leading cardiologists and used by people around the world for accurate EKG recordings. Track your heart health data from home with the medical accuracy your doctor can trust.
NOTE: This app requires KardiaMobile, KardiaMobile 6L, or KardiaBand hardware to record an EKG. Get your Kardia device now at alivecor.com.
Kardia integrates with Apple Health to create a combined view of your health metrics.
NOTE: Requires KardiaMobile or KardiaBand hardware to record an EKG
FDA 510(k) numbers: K191406, K181823, K171816, K183319

bluejetty:00165918:ios.name: Memory Lane Games
bluejetty:00165918:ios.summary: Memory Lane Games is the app that is being used by families and professional caregivers across the world for engagement with those living with Alzheimer’s and all other kinds of dementia or cognitive decline, because it makes a difference.
bluejetty:00165918:ios.description:
Memory Lane Games is the app that is being used by families and professional caregivers across the world for engagement with those living with Alzheimer’s and all other kinds of dementia or cognitive decline, because it makes a difference. 
So how does it work? 
Through repetitive stimulation of the visual, reasoning, memory and speech areas of the brain, our simple and frustration-free quizzes;
- Encourage reminiscence, conversation and engagement
- Connect people across generations and cultures
- Calm, settles and reassures people
- Re-directs from sundowning and wandering behaviors 
Designed to help our own Moms and endorsed by caregivers across the world.
WINNER at Mayo Clinic and Arizona State University MedTech Accelerator.
FINALIST in the Longitude prize for dementia
In randomized controlled trial (RCT) people with dementia and their care partners who used the app regularly experienced significant benefits:
- 92% of caregivers felt the app made them more relaxed.
- 67% of caregivers felt the app made them happier.
- 58% of caregivers believed the app helped the person with dementia to communicate more.
- 33% of caregivers reported the app had a positive impact on the person with dementia’s thinking abilities.
- 66% of carers believed that time spent using the app was worthwhile.
Our library of thousands of simple, frustration-free trivia games is professionally curated to create opportunities for reminiscence on topics such as music, food, history, pets and places. You may even find a game about your local area or town! Our games are not brain training nor are they designed to test. Our games gently spark nostalgia, happy memories and start wonderful conversations. 
Features:
- 14 day FREE trial
- Access to searchable games library with 1000s of games on 100s of topics
- Easy touch-screen interface designed for those with dementia 
- Once downloaded the app can be played offline
- No time limits
- No wrong answers
- Dynamic recommendations for the player based on their likes and interests
- Access to caregiver resources including tips on how best to use the app and support and guidance on caring, from professional dementia clinicians.
- ORCHA Certified
Memory Lane Games is recommended by the Alzheimer’s Disease Association of the Philippines and Uganda Alzheimer’s Association as well as many independent therapists and carers in the UK, US, Philippines and India. 
“At Hospice we love the simplicity of the Memory Lane Games’ front-end designs and are absolutely delighted to be part of this POTENTIALLY LIFE-CHANGING PROJECT.” Anne Mills – CEO, Hospice Isle of Man. 
“This is going to make a tremendous difference to anyone who uses it. You’re not just playing a game, it is part of the management of your patient.” Dr Paul Kiwanuka-Mukiibi – Executive Director of Alzheimer’s Uganda.
“This app develops social interaction between carers and patients with dementia, elicits positive impact for both and improves mood of the patient, making taking care of them easier. It’s a good conversation starter.” Dr Jemellee Cano - Board member Alzheimer’s disease association of the Philippines.
We love to hear user stories and suggestions, please get in touch heretohelp@memorylanegames.com
Download now to see for yourself how Memory Lane Games makes a difference to your loved one living with dementia.
Terms of Use: https://www.memorylanegames.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.memorylanegames.com/privacy-policy-gdpr

bluejetty:00071077:ios.name: Kids Behavior Tracker
bluejetty:00071077:ios.summary:
Helping kids build good habits doesn’t have to be a struggle.
This app helps you motivate your kids to show positive behavior and complete daily tasks and routines — with rewards that actually work.
Kids love challenges, competition, and e
bluejetty:00071077:ios.description:
Helping kids build good habits doesn’t have to be a struggle.
This app helps you motivate your kids to show positive behavior and complete daily tasks and routines — with rewards that actually work.
Kids love challenges, competition, and earning rewards.
Parents love seeing their kids motivated, responsible, and proud of their progress.
This app turns everyday routines into a fun, goal-based system that works for the whole family.
SIMPLE TO USE
● Enter your child’s name
● Assign behaviors and routines from the built-in list or create your own
● Reward good behavior with stars and stickers and track progress toward goals
● Kids collect stars, completions, and stickers that can be exchanged for real rewards
● Once a goal or time period is completed, start a new cycle and keep the motivation going
FEATURES
● Create profiles for multiple kids with names and photos
● Visually track progress for each behavior or routine
● Collect stars (for single accomplishments) and completions (for completing goals over time)
● Exchange stars and completions for real-life rewards you define
● 25+ predefined behaviors and routines
● 150+ stickers (available via in-app purchase)
● Create custom behaviors and routines with names and photos
● Create your own reward list with photos
● Protect the app with a passcode so kids can’t reward themselves
● Daily reminder notifications to assign stars at a chosen time
● Record voice agreements with your kids to document promises and contracts and review them later
— — —
How does this app motivate kids to behave better?
Kids earn stars, stickers, and completions for positive behavior and completed routines, which they can exchange for real rewards agreed upon with parents.
Is this suitable for daily routines like homework or chores?
Yes. You can create routines for chores, homework, bedtime, morning tasks, and any daily habit you want to encourage.
Can I use this for more than one child?
Yes. You can create individual profiles for each child and track their progress separately.
Do parents control the rewards?
Absolutely. Parents define the rules, rewards, and goals — and a passcode prevents kids from assigning rewards themselves.
What if kids forget what they agreed to?
You can record voice agreements with your kids, creating a clear record of what was promised and whether it was fulfilled.
Does this work for kids who need extra motivation or structure?
Yes. Clear goals, visual progress, and consistent rewards help children stay motivated and understand expectations.
Is the app free?
The app is free to download and use, with optional in-app purchases such as additional sticker packs.
— — —
If you enjoy the app, please leave a review on the App Store — it really helps.
Have questions or ideas? We’d love to hear from you.
Support Email: AppsForParents@gmail.com
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:
https://sites.google.com/site/appsforparentsprivacy/

bluejetty:00089313:ios.description:
Monitor your bowel movements with this straightforward poop log application. Have you ever wondered about the significance of your bowel movements and how they impact your health? Are you curious to learn how frequently you experience bowel conditions like constipation, diarrhea, or bloody stools? Do you know whether your diet is contributing to issues such as constipation or diarrhea? Well, tracking your bowel movements has never been easier.
Discover the implications of consistency, stool color, frequency, and urgency on your health by consistently tracking and analyzing these metrics over time. Then, use this data to assess the presence of bowel or diet-related issues, such as diarrhea, constipation, or Crohn's disease.
PCal features:
-Record every bowel movement.
-Supports daily bowel movement reminders and interval reminders
-With convenient default option settings for quick recording.
-Export log for Excel
-Track stool statistics such as stool color, stool type (Bristol Stool Scale), urgency, size, bloody stool, and more. These metrics are crucial for identifying potential bowel problems like -diarrhea, constipation, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), colitis, Crohn's disease, or other related issues.
-Add notes and photos to each stool entry, which can be helpful in determining if your diet is contributing to any bowel problems.
-View and modify previous entries in the poop log.
-Examine a breakdown and graphical representation of your stool statistics over time.

bluejetty:00022467:ios.summary:

The messages can be sent
bluejetty:00022467:ios.description:
SendHype allows you to send personalized text messages (iMessage or SMS) to custom contact groups. You can select contacts from your Address Book, create custom contacts or use your existing iCloud contact groups.
The messages can be sent individually but also as a group chat message.
SEND INDIVIDUAL MESSAGES
Even if you send a message to multiple contacts they won't be able to see each other's reply. Each message is sent as a private message and replies are sent back only to you (works like BCC for emails).
PERSONALIZE YOUR MESSAGE TEMPLATES
You can use placeholders in your message such as [FirstName], [LastName], etc. All these placeholders are replaced with real contact details when the final message is sent.
Example: "Hey [FirstName], let's meet tomorrow!" will be delivered as "Hey Kate, let's meet tomorrow!" for a contact named "Kate Johnson".
HOW TO USE SENDHYPE IN 4 EASY STEPS
1) Create your custom contact groups or use existing iCloud groups
2) Create a message template (you may include placeholders)
3) Attach photos or videos to your message (optional step)
4) Send the message!
DON'T TEXT PEOPLE WITHOUT THEIR CONSENT
Please make sure you read the Terms and Conditions before using our app: https://sendhype.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4403768520849
TRY THE FREE VERSION THEN UPGRADE TO PREMIUM
The FREE VERSION allows you to try the app features. You can create small contact groups and send a few messages. If you plan to send more messages and create more contact groups please consider upgrading in the app Settings tab.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
GET IN TOUCH WITH US
For more information, tutorials and help please visit: https://sendhype.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/4403736357777 or email us at: support@sendhype.net

【新股神贏家】：短線多頭、多頭回檔、風險警示股與接單強勁股，透過趨勢與財務統計挑好股。
●雲端系統監控 最豐富警示條件
【多項條件設定】：從即時價量，到當日行情與關鍵價位的變動，超過30種的條件類別可選擇，輕鬆掌握個股動態。

bluejetty:00077091:ios.description:

HopSkipDrive CareDrivers provide rides to children ages 6+. CareDrivers say they love the flexibility, the kids they drive, and the chance to make extra money.
Choose rides in your area on our easy-to-use app, and set your own schedule up to 7 days in advance. The app shows you where you’re driving, information about your rider, and an estimate of how much you’ll earn — you can also easily track your earnings.

Have caregiving experience with children
Be at least 21 years of age
Have a good driving record
Have a 4-door vehicle no more than 15 years old (In some states vehicle must be no more than 10 years old)
Download the CareDriver app and start your application today!

bluejetty:00132570:ios.description:
Remoboard turns your computer browser into a keyboard for your iPhone or iPad. Type in a text field on your device from a Mac, Windows, or Linux computer on the same Wi-Fi network. No desktop app or account is required.
Getting started
1. Add the Remoboard keyboard in iOS or iPadOS Settings and allow Full Access for local network access.
2. Switch to the Remoboard keyboard in any text field. Open the URL shown on the keyboard in your computer browser.

• Smoother Chinese and other composed text input.
• Automatic reconnection and clear connection status.
• Reusable phrases for text you type often.
• Browser controls for text entry and clipboard actions.
• Light and dark appearance, with support for 10 languages.
Both devices must be on the same local network. Full Access lets the keyboard serve its local page.

Do you want to convert AVI to MP4 videos format? Are you looking for different ways to play your AVI files on different devices without losing quality?
AVI is one of the most used video formats but not supported by all devices. You may want to convert them to MP4, a compatible video format for watching or sharing videos on your desktop, laptop, iPhone, iPad or mobile phones etc.

An easy-to-use multi-functional Avi to Mp4 converter is a commonly used video converter tool. It is safe and quick to convert AVI videos to MP4 format.
Main features:
- App allows you to add single/multiple AVI video files for conversion at a single instance.
- Support multi output format : MP4, 3GP, MPEG, MKV, MP3, ...
- Maintaining the original video quality on conversion, it saves the converted videos to the location selected by you. 
- App is not just an adept AVI video converter but also changes the video to audio file file format.
Step 1: Run app AVI Video Converter on your Android phone
Step 2: On the main interface of software click on Add Files or Add Folder to select AVI files need to convert. You can add multiple AVI files to convert.
Step 3: Select ouput format video : MP4, 3GP, MPEG, MKV, MP3, ...
Step 4: Click on Convert button. Conversion process begins.
Convert AVI to MP4A progress bar indicates the conversion progress of the file
Step 5: List of Converted Files dialog appears. You can easily open, share or delete any converted files.

Besides China and areas with significant ethnic Chinese communities, xiangqi is also a popular pastime in Vietnam.
HangXun Chinese chess ( xiangqi ) absolutely is one of best one worldwide, and it has beautiful graphics and rich of useful features. Especially it contains many many endgames and game replays. In every day we will recommend one most interesting endgame and one best game replay for you.
Features:
1. Super AI ability, from easy to master.
2. Daily recommendation of endgame and game replay for you.
3. 4000 Endgame levels for your challenging.
4. New version of Endgame library, including over 10000 endgames.
5. Download the game replay of Newest Chinese Chess Match.
6. Many game replays from master’s contest, easy to study from master.
7. multi-playing-modes are designed,AI Mode, Endgame Mode, Study Mode.
8. Beautiful graphics and animations, wonderful finger battle
9. Sound background music.
More Features:
1. All endgame provide reference answer.
2. You can switch side when you challenge endgame.
3. You can design your own endgame and challenge it.
4. Massive functions: hint, undo, save, record, etc.
5. Many board and piece themes for you.
6. You can import your own endgame & game replay file into App.
Welcome to our Chinese chess world, enjoy the crazy of Chinese chess. You can get much of leisure time and valuable chess learning, we believe hangxun Chinese Chess will be your favorite game!

bluejetty:00166453:android.description:
The Summary App allows you to turn any long text or website into a short and simple summary. It lets you break down lengthy documents or web content into easily digestible summaries. Ideal for getting the main points without wading through a sea of words. With our accessible and user-friendly AI-powered tool, you'll turn 'tl;dr' (Too Long; Didn't Read) into 'brief but got it' in no time.
Life's fast-paced. Why spend time skimming excessive text when you can get a snapshot view? With The Summary App, you don't have to. Paste in your text or link, and a get a neat summary. It's great for everything from long-form news articles to detailed research papers.
And guess what? The app is not constrained by language. Choose from multiple languages to summarize your text. The app also lets you pick your summary style. Broken down bullet points? Check. Digestible dialogue? Yep, we got that too. Simple, straightforward paragraphs? Of course. Customize your summary the way you like it.
Key features of The Summary App:
* Powerful Text Summarizer: From elaborate articles to lengthy reports, transform any content into concise summaries.
* Efficient TL;DR Extracts: Get the essence of comprehensive texts in bite-sized 'tl;dr' summaries.
* Versatile Source Inputs: Summarize information directly from a URL or textual content.
* Multilingual Support: Access summaries in multiple languages, bridging the gap in your multilingual text comprehension needs.
* Variety of Summary Styles: Choose your preferred summary style - traditional, list format, dialogue style - you name it!
In short, The Summary App reshapes your reading experience by providing apt, easy-to-understand summaries. It's more than just a text summarizer. It's a time saver, a bridge to foreign content, and your personalized information tool.
Download The Summary App today and pave your way to easier, quicker information absorption!

bluejetty:00121740:ios.name: New Ludo
bluejetty:00121740:ios.summary:
New Ludo brings classic aeroplane chess to iPhone and iPad. Play with friends on one device or take on computer opponents. No account is needed, and matches work offline.
PLAY YOUR WAY
- Up to four players: free-for-all or teams, including
bluejetty:00121740:ios.description:
New Ludo brings classic aeroplane chess to iPhone and iPad. Play with friends on one device or take on computer opponents. No account is needed, and matches work offline.
PLAY YOUR WAY
- Up to four players: free-for-all or teams, including 2v2 and 1v3.
- Easy and Hard computer opponents.
- A spinning wheel picks who goes first.
- Sprint Race: a team wins as soon as one member brings all four pieces home.
ITEMS THAT CHANGE THE GAME
- Magic Dice: choose the exact roll when it matters.
- Mines: place one on an empty square. A piece that ends its move there goes back to base, and after three rounds the mine explodes and pushes nearby pieces.
- Turn Magic Dice and Mines on or off separately for players and AI.
WEATHER AND HOUSE RULES
- Rainstorms and tornadoes shake up the route. Switch each one on or off and set how often the weather changes.
- Adjust Take Off, Team Push, Bad Six and Bounce Back.
- Turn on move guides to see where each piece will land.
MAKE IT YOURS
- 34 built-in piece designs, or turn your own photos into piece icons.
- Colorful and dark boards, four built-in backgrounds, plus your own photo backgrounds.
COINS AND STORE
- Earn 100 coins from an optional rewarded video, and 10-60 more from the Lucky Draw after a win.
- Exchange coins for Magic Dice and Mines, or buy 500, 2,000 or 4,000 coin packs.
- A one-time Remove Ads purchase removes banner and interstitial ads. Rewarded videos stay optional.
MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
- Landscape play on iPhone and iPad, plus iPad multitasking windows.
- Matches save automatically, so you can pick up where you left off.
- Play at 1x, 2x or 3x speed and pause at any time.
- Track scores and wins with Game Center leaderboards.
Matches can be played offline; ads, in-app purchases and Game Center require an internet connection. Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Indonesian and Japanese.
Pick your team, roll the dice and race your pieces home!

bluejetty:00185925:ios.description:
Beautiful iPad instrument featuring classic famous 80s FM Synth, EP, and FM Tine sounds. Featured by Apple.
"BEST APPS OF 2017" - Electronic Musician Magazine
"BEST iOS APPS – 2017" - Audio News Room (ANR)
FM Player 2 is the secret weapon for major musicians and grammy-winning producers. Now, you can have all these award-winning sounds on your iPad.
AWESOME FEATURES:
- Faithful multi-sampled recordings of famous classic presets from original retro 80s FM Synthesizers
- Stand-alone iPad Synth, plus IAA & Audiobus
- Basic AUv3 Plugin support. We're working on upgrading Audio Unit support.
- Vintage Arp & 16-Step Sequencer
- 200+ presets and 150+ multi-sampled PCMs included!
- NEW Vintage Stereo Phaser Effect
- 1+ Gigabyte of sounds, compressed to under 300mb!
- Dual layers per voice. KeyboardSplits. Morph between sounds
- Full ADSR Envelopes for each Layer
- 3 LFOs. Fun Routings. LFOs can modify other LFOs.
- NEW FX: Vintage Chorus, Flanger, Amp Simulator, and more
- Beautiful Reverb, Auto Pan, Bit Crush, Stereo Fatten, and more!
- MIDI in (Play with a MIDI Keyboard)
- Analog Tape Style Ping-Pong Delay
- Mono glide & legato modes
- Dual Independent Filters per layer
- Tempo-sync controls & Ableton Link
- GREAT for playing Live with a Keyboard: MIDI Mod Wheel, Pitch Wheel, Program Change, Velocity sensitive sounds, and Sustain Pedal support already added
- All Knobs have MIDI Learn!
NOTE: This app is amazing as a live instrument controlled with a MIDI Keyboard. The main Electric Piano and Full Tines sounds have 20+ layers for maximum expressiveness.
Subscribe to access to premium app features; subscription details are the following:
- Length: weekly or yearly
- Free trial: only on selected subscriptions
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00175300:ios.description:
Burner gives you a second phone number for calling, texting, and keeping your personal number private. Create a number in seconds. Use it when you need it. Delete it when you don’t.
HOW BURNER WORKS
- Sign up and choose an area code
- Call and text from your second number (Wi-Fi or mobile data required)
- Delete your number anytime or create a new one 
CALLING & TEXTING
Get a second phone number that works like your main one. Make calls and send texts without sharing your personal number.
KEEP YOUR NUMBER PRIVATE
Use different phone numbers for different parts of your life. Share a number when it makes sense—keep your personal one to yourself. Delete or replace numbers anytime to stop unwanted contact.
STAY ORGANIZED
Keep conversations separate by number so nothing gets mixed up. Customize each number and find messages quickly in a simple inbox.
USE IT WHERE IT MAKES SENSE
Use a second number for online marketplaces, listings, or social media—without giving out your personal number.
BLOCK SPAM & UNWANTED CONTACT
Block calls, filter spam texts, and mute notifications when you need a break.
SET QUIET HOURS
Schedule do-not-disturb times that fit your routine. Choose who can reach you—and when.
PREMIUM FEATURES
- VPN: Browse securely and protect your data on public Wi-Fi
- Personal Info Protection: See where your info appears online and request removals
- Audio Messaging: Send voice messages
- Video Messaging: Share short video messages
- AI Voicemail: Voicemail with transcription
- Reverse Lookup: See available info about unknown numbers
RECOGNIZED & TRUSTED
Featured by TIME, The New York Times, WIRED, TechCrunch, Engadget, and more.
PLANS & PRICING
Free to download with a 3-day trial. Additional features available through subscription.
- Monthly: $9.99/month
- Annual: $59.99/year
- Premium: $89.99/year
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
IMPORTANT
Calls use your existing phone service provider minutes. Trial includes limited usage. Not compatible with SMS short code services or emergency (911) calls. Available in the US and Canada (excluding Puerto Rico).

bluejetty:00077421:ios.description:
Bubble Shooter Funny Pop Plus
Ready to pop, match, and blast your way through colorful bubble puzzles?
Bubble Shooter Funny Pop Plus is a fun and easy-to-play bubble shooting game for players who love classic matching puzzles and relaxing casual gameplay.
Aim carefully, match bubbles, create powerful combos, and clear the board one shot at a time!
POP, MATCH & BLAST
Shoot bubbles and match 3 or more of the same color to clear them. Plan your shots, make smart bank shots, and create satisfying bubble explosions.
EASY TO PLAY
Simple controls make it easy to pick up and play. Whether you have a few minutes or want to play through multiple levels, Bubble Shooter Funny Pop Plus is ready whenever you are.
MORE LEVELS TO ENJOY
Explore hundreds of colorful levels with different layouts and challenges. New levels are added regularly to keep the bubble-popping fun going.
FUN CHALLENGES
Every level gives you a new puzzle to solve. Think ahead, aim carefully, and use the bubbles around you to make the biggest possible combos.
A RELAXING CASUAL GAME
Enjoy colorful visuals, satisfying bubble pops, and simple gameplay that's easy to understand and fun to master.
Features
• Classic bubble shooter gameplay
• Match 3 or more bubbles
• Hundreds of challenging levels
• Colorful and satisfying bubble effects
• Simple tap-and-aim controls
• Fun puzzles for quick play sessions
• Easy to learn, challenging to master
• New levels and improvements regularly
• Play at your own pace
• Great for casual puzzle fans
Aim. Match. Pop. Blast!
Start popping bubbles and see how far you can go!

bluejetty:00138579:ios.description:
Unleash your inner artist with AR Draw Sketching: Trace Paint – where art meets augmented reality (AR)! This revolutionary app transforms your phone into a powerful drawing tool, allowing you to sketch, paint, and color stunning artworks directly onto paper. 
Explore the world of AR Drawing:
- Trace AR templates: Choose from a vast library of templates, including Anime, Tattoos, Cars, and unique designs. Simply position your phone and start tracing the projected lines onto your paper. 
- Upload & draw your own art: Express your creativity by uploading your own artwork and turning it into AR tracing templates. 
- Learn to Draw: Master drawing techniques with step-by-step tutorials for various skill levels and subjects. 
- Dot to Dot: Connect the dots and watch your artwork come to life! Perfect for beginners and kids. 
- Record your creative process: Capture time-lapse videos of your drawing journey to share with friends and the art community. 
- Advanced features: Edit photos, adjust opacity, and toggle the flashlight for an optimized drawing experience. 
- AR Draw Sketching: Trace Paint is perfect for everyone, from beginners to professional artists, kids, and parents. No matter your skill level, this app will help you improve your drawing abilities and discover the joy of creation. 
How to use:
1. Select your favorite template from the library or upload your own artwork. 
2. Place your phone in a stable position (e.g., using a cup or stand). 
3. Start tracing the projected lines onto your paper with our AR technology. It's that easy! 
Download AR Draw Sketching: Trace Paint and bring your artistic visions to life!

bluejetty:00066231:ios.summary:
Street Racing EVO: Car & Moto – The Ultimate Driving Experience
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on mobile? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine yo
bluejetty:00066231:ios.description:
Street Racing EVO: Car & Moto – The Ultimate Driving Experience
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on mobile? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine your expectations of car and motorcycle racing games. With its stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and endless customization options, this game is a must-play for any driving enthusiast.
What Makes Street Racing EVO Stand Out?
Unmatched Realism and Highly Detailed Vehicles
Every car and motorcycle is crafted with precision, featuring intricate interiors and exteriors that bring your ride to life.
Interior POV
Step into the driver’s seat with the first-person interior view, offering an unparalleled level of immersion. Feel like you’re actually behind the wheel as you navigate through diverse environments.
Handcrafted Details
From the roar of the engine to the sound of tires gripping the road, every detail is designed to enhance your driving experience.
Dual Thrills: Cars & Motorcycles
Whether you’re a fan of high-performance sports cars or the agility of motorcycles, Street Racing EVO has it all. Race through challenging terrains on two wheels or dominate the streets in your customized dream car.
Endless Customization
Make your vehicle truly yours with a wide range of customization options. From paint jobs to engine upgrades, you can tweak every aspect of your ride to match your style and performance preferences.
Open World Exploration
Explore a vast, detailed open world filled with diverse environments. Cruise through bustling city streets, race down highways, or tackle off-road trails—the choice is yours.
Buy and Own Houses 
Purchase apartments across the city to teleport between locations instantly and earn passive income while focusing on driving and racing.
Thrilling Challenges
Engage in high-speed races, evade police chases, and complete adrenaline-pumping challenges. Test your driving skills and prove you’re the best on the road.
Multiple Race Types to Choose From 
Compete in Sprint, Time Attack, Speed Camera, Average Speed Race, Drag Races, Drift, and Top Speed Races. Take your skills to the track for infinite racing excitement.
Stunning Graphics
Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the game’s world to life. From scenic rural roads to vibrant cityscapes, every environment is designed to immerse you in the ultimate driving adventure.
Why You’ll Love Street Racing EVO?
Immersive Gameplay 
The combination of realistic vehicle dynamics, first-person POV, and dynamic environments creates an experience that feels truly authentic.
Something for Everyone 
Whether you’re into street racing, police pursuits, or simply cruising through an open world, this game caters to all types of players.

bluejetty:00068166:ios.description:
Travel easily across Greece, Cyprus, and Albania with the iMove Ride App. Book your ride in seconds and move comfortably between cities, airports, ports, and top tourist destinations.
iMove is available across all of Greece, including Athens, Thessaloniki, and the Greek islands such as Mykonos, Santorini, Paros, Naxos, Milos, Zakynthos, Crete, Rhodes, Corfu, Kos, Skiathos, Skopelos, Lefkada, Kefalonia, Syros, Tinos, Andros, Lesvos, and many more destinations across the Aegean and Ionian seas.
With iMove, you can instantly book a ride, see the price upfront, track your driver in real time, and know exactly when your ride will arrive. The app uses smart technology to connect you with the nearest available driver, ensuring fast, reliable, and efficient transportation.
Whether you need a transfer from Athens International Airport, a ferry port, your hotel, or any other location, iMove provides safe and comfortable rides for tourists, travelers, and locals. All drivers are professional and certified, ensuring a high level of service and safety.
iMove offers a wide range of transportation options to suit every need and budget, including economy cars, premium vehicles, minivans, minibuses, high-speed boats, and helicopter transfers. It is the ideal solution for traveling between islands, tourist destinations, airports, and ports.
Simply choose your pickup location and destination, view your driver and vehicle details, track your ride in real time, and enjoy a smooth and stress-free travel experience.
Download the iMove Ride App today and discover a smarter way to travel across Greece, Cyprus, and Albania.

Phone: +30 210 2201999

Commands and
bluejetty:00023448:ios.description:
Voice Commands for Alexa is the complete phrasebook for your Echo. More than 2,000 voice commands in 51 categories, plus step-by-step guides for every Echo speaker, screen and wearable, all in one tidy app.
NOW IN 7 LANGUAGES
Commands and guides in English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português (Brasil) and 日本語. Each one is written the way Alexa understands it in that language, not translated word for word. The app follows your iPhone language, or pick one for this app in iOS Settings.
2,000+ VOICE COMMANDS IN 51 CATEGORIES
• Music, radio, podcasts and audiobooks
• Smart home: lights, plugs, thermostats, locks and cameras
• Echo Show: video calls, photos, recipes, Fire TV and display commands
• Timers, alarms, reminders, calendar, to-do and shopping lists
• Calls, messages, Drop In and announcements
• Weather, news, traffic, sports, math and translation
• Alexa+ and AI commands, routines and skills
• Kids and family, cooking, sleep, health, pets, travel and car
• Games, jokes, Easter eggs and fun questions
• Every command has a short label that says what it does
• Search everything, copy any phrase with one tap, save favorites
GUIDES FOR 18 ECHO DEVICES
Speakers (Echo, Echo Dot, Echo Dot Kids, Echo Dot Max, Echo Pop, Echo Studio), screens (Echo Show 5, 8, 10, 11, 15, 21, Echo Spot, Echo Hub) and on-the-go devices (Echo Auto, Echo Buds, Echo Frames), plus guides that apply to every Echo:
• Set up a new device, from the box to your first command
• What every light ring and light bar color means
• Connect to Wi-Fi, change networks, fix connection problems
• Video calls, camera privacy, photo frames and screen settings on Echo Show
• Pair Bluetooth speakers and phones
• Change the wake word, update software, restart or factory reset
• Speaker groups, multi-room music and stereo pairs
• Privacy, microphones and voice recordings
• Buying advice, a map of the Alexa app and a jargon glossary
APPLE WATCH
The command list on your wrist, handy when you are standing next to your Echo.
ONE-TIME PREMIUM, NO SUBSCRIPTION
More than 1,200 commands in 28 categories are free. One purchase unlocks the 23 premium categories and the complete All Commands list, and removes ads. Pay once: no weekly or monthly fees.

Make your photo move

bluejetty:00170171:ios.description:
At InBody, our goal is to bring evidence-based health and wellness data to more individuals so they can find health clarity that stretches far beyond a singular number on a scale. Using our mobile app in conjunction with one of our body composition analyzers or blood pressure monitors, users can directly measure muscle, fat, water, and blood pressure to see how these values, when combined with activity levels and nutritional habits, create a snapshot of whole body health. By regularly reviewing this information, individuals will be able to track progress over time and use this progress as momentum for continued, healthy improvement.
Use the InBody App to:
● Evaluate key summaries of recent InBody Tests, active minutes, and nutritional information from the new overview dashboard
● View historic data for body composition in up to one month increments
● Review accurate body composition testing results, graphs, and interpretations
● Monitor blood pressure levels by comparing test results over time
● Manage caloric outputs and monitor daily movement, such as step counts and active minutes, through our training log. Use values to see how they correlate with changes in body composition over time
● Record daily exercise and food intake using our digital tracking log
● See your national ranking and start healthy competitions with friends and family, based on your InBody Score and weekly step count
● Track sleep time by syncing the InBody BAND 2 with the app
What’s New
Hey there. You’re not alone during this transformative time. We’re currently undergoing some healthy composition changes to help further simplify your understanding of personal health and wellness.
Our new makeup looks a little something like:
- An improved app dashboard, which displays data on your latest InBody Tests, blood pressure outputs, daily activity levels, body composition goals, and nutritional progress.
- A blood pressure hub where you can review the history of your BP 170 and BP 250 test results.
- An updated Result Sheet that provides visual representations of changes in body composition analysis, including fluctuations in skeletal muscle, body fat, body water, and
more. *Please note: Output availability will vary depending on the InBody device used for testing.
- A graphic depiction of differences in segmental body composition that is available to testing facilities using LookinBody Web with an InBody 570 or 770 unit.
- A digital diet and exercise log that can be used to fit healthy changes into your current lifestyle. Within this section, you can also set attainable muscle and fat goals based on scientific data formulated by the InBody Clinical Research team. *Please note: The guide(s) are for reference purposes only and should not be taken as professional medical advice.
- An enhanced connection between your InBody wearable device and the app. By working together, these technologies can help you effectively track daily activity levels and sleep habits over time.
- An online training journal that you can use to record time spent exercising and analyze body composition changes in relation to activity type, time, and intensity.
- A way to see how you measure up. Use our national rankings board to start a friendly competition between peers at your testing facility, friends, or family members.
*InBody App provides that Users can sync steps / body composition data to the Apple Health app.
* This app is not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment. It provides health and wellness information for general reference only. Medical decisions should be made in consultation with healthcare professionals.

bluejetty:00042222:ios.summary: Taxi With Us is a leading provider of Taxi services in Chicago, IL suburbs in Cook, Lake DuPage, Kane and McHenry counties. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Taxi Hail
bluejetty:00042222:ios.description:
Taxi With Us is a leading provider of Taxi services in Chicago, IL suburbs in Cook, Lake DuPage, Kane and McHenry counties. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Taxi Hail application.
Key Features of the TWU Taxi Hail application include:
- Book a reservation in as few as 3 clicks
- Get a fare estimate by entering both pickup and destination addresses
- Receive a confirmation number for your reservation immediately on booking
- Receive notifications including vehicle number once your reservation has been dispatched
- Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
- Create a list of favorite addresses and assign a custom name for each
- Select an address from your list of telephone contacts
- Specify the number of passengers, vehicle type and preferred payment method
- Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
- Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
- Call 303 Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the Taxi application today:
- Download the free app
- Create an account (Email, Name, Phone # and Password)
- Validate your account (via the confirmation email you receive)
- Login to the app (Email & Password)
- Enter your pickup address
- Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
- Book your trip (reservations can be immediate or for a future time/date)
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations (up to 30 days) for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favorite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
You can also customize your orders by selecting the number of passengers, preferred vehicle type, and preferred method of payment. These preferences can be saved to your account profile for future bookings.
At Taxi With Us, your comfort and safety are our top priorities! Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Taxi application or by calling 847-303-0303.
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the TWU Taxi Hail application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00026570:ios.description:
All your health in one app: chronic stress & energy tracker
Trusted by over 20 million people, featured in the App Store under Apps We Love, and collaborating with 30+ universities, including Harvard Medical School, Arizona State University, and Johns Hopkins, to advance health science.
Welltory helps you understand your heart
Sometimes your body feels hard to decode. Welltory turns its signals into insights to help you manage chronic stress, track energy reserves, navigate fatigue, and take charge of your long-term health.
By analyzing heart rate variability, a proven health marker backed by 20,000+ studies, Welltory shows how your nervous system, sleep, and lifestyle impact how you.
Track and reverse chronic stress
Daily stress impacts your energy reserves, especially if you’re living with POTS, Long COVID, or ME/CFS. Turn your Apple Watch or wearable into a stress monitor. See how work, emotional pressure, and physical effort affect your baseline, and catch stress spikes before they take a toll or trigger a crash.
Get your energy back
Welltory tracks your body’s daily battery level in real time so you can pace your day, prevent sudden crashes, and know exactly when to push or pause.
Track sleep & recovery
Find out what’s disrupting your deep sleep, evaluate nighttime recovery, and access science-backed audio programs designed to help you fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed.
Decode your health patterns
Log flare-ups, crashes, and life events in your Journal. Connect your symptoms to HRV, stress, and recovery trends so you can spot hidden triggers and pace your energy with confidence.
Track your migraines
Log episodes, symptoms, and intensity alongside sleep and heart rate data to identify what triggers your migraines and map your patterns over time.
Turn data into insights
Stop juggling single-purpose health apps. Connect 1,000+ devices, wearables, and apps, including Apple Watch, Oura, Garmin, meditation tools, and lab results, into one smart health hub.
Monitor blood pressure & heart health
Keep tabs on hypertension, resting heart rate, and cardiovascular trends. Log readings manually or sync a blood pressure monitor to generate detailed PDF health reports you can share with your doctor.
Note: Welltory reads HRV via camera or wearable sensors; it does not measure blood pressure directly via phone camera or Apple Watch.
Track workouts & move without crashing
Balance exercise with proper recovery. Welltory tracks active movement, including daily chores, walking, and intense workouts, and sets personalized longevity targets to help you avoid burnout.
PRICING & TERMS
Welltory is free to download and use. Upgrade to Welltory Premium for unlimited HRV analysis, deep symptom tracking, and advanced health insights via auto-renewing subscriptions.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
Renewal charges occur within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited upon subscription purchase.
Family Sharing is not supported for this app.
Integrates with Apple Health.
Terms of service:
https://welltory.com/terms/
Privacy policy:
https://welltory.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Your health data is stored securely in the cloud with enterprise-grade privacy protection.
Support & Inquiries: contact@welltory.com
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Welltory measures heart rate variability and heartbeat to provide wellness insights. It cannot measure blood pressure or other vital signs directly via a smartphone camera or Apple Watch. Welltory is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider regarding any medical condition.

bluejetty:00183753:ios.description:
Your money shouldn’t stop where your country’s border starts - whether you find yourself in Nigeria, the US, or anywhere in the world. 
The Paga app gives you the opportunity to open and manage both a US Checking Account and a Nigerian Naira Account from anywhere. To open a Paga US bank account, proof of a valid residential address in the US is required. For the Nigerian bank account, you’ll need a NIN or BVN.
One login. One app. Two worlds, finally connected.
With Paga, you can:
Send, pay, and receive across both currencies 
Send directly from your Paga US account to any Naira account
Get paid by clients, pay vendors abroad, or manage your side gigs seamlessly
Connect to your financial life on apps like Chime, Robinhood, SoFi, or Venmo.
Physical & Virtual Visa Debit Cards
Shop, travel, and live life on your terms. You can:
Pay anywhere with your physical or virtual debit card
Link your Paga US card to Apple Pay for secure, contactless payments.
Tap and pay in-store or online.
Lock and unlock your card instantly.
Even choose a card design that fits your style.
Move Money Without Borders
Send US Dollars to Nigeria — fast and reliable.
Request or receive money with a tap, wherever you are.
Enjoy competitive exchange rates and fees that keep more money with you.
Link your external bank accounts to make better transaction moves.
Receive money via ACH, wire transfers, and Visa Direct card transfers
PayPal, Reimagined - Paga makes PayPal work for Nigerians- FINALLY!
 PayPal is now closer to home. With Paga, you can:
Top up, withdraw, and get paid in any currency, instantly in Naira.
Pay globally anywhere PayPal is accepted.
Send and receive money worldwide right from your phone
How we protect your money
Your security isn’t an afterthought — it’s built in.
Paga US account is protected up to $250,000 through our FDIC-insured partner bank To learn more about FDIC insurance, visit the FDIC website at www.fdic.gov/deposit/deposits
Paga Nigeria accounts are protected by NDIC.
Industry-grade security, fraud monitoring, and instant card controls keep your money safe.
Extensive identity verification keeps sign-ups secure.
Passcode and biometric login ensure only you can access your account.
Visit our Terms and Conditions website for more information (See links below). Peace of mind, every time you send or spend.
Always Here to Help
Money never sleeps, and neither do we. Get 24/7 customer support. 
Why Paga?
Over 30 million people trust Paga. Recognised by the Financial Times and Statista, Paga connects your two worlds: US and Nigeria. Home and abroad. Dollars and Naira.
Because your money should move as freely as you do.
Visit our Terms and Conditions for our Nigerian customers - mypaga.com/ngn-terms#tos
Visit our Terms and Conditions for our US customers - mypaga.com/usd-terms#tos
Download Paga today. Two wallets, one life, no borders.
Paga is a financial technology company, not a bank. US banking services are provided by Regent Bank, Member FDIC. FDIC insurance only covers the failure of insured depository institutions. Certain conditions must be satisfied for pass-through FDIC deposit insurance to apply.

Fill-In word puzzles, sometimes known as Word-Fit, Kris
bluejetty:00036202:ios.description:
Fill-in Word is a crossword-like puzzle, but with words instead of clues.
Welcome to the Fill-in Word crosswords puzzle, where you will improve your brain power and decision-making. 
Fill-In word puzzles, sometimes known as Word-Fit, Kriss Kross or Criss-Cross puzzles combine a love of words with a love of logic. 
The rules of kriss kross are simple, but solving them may not be! Given a list of words of different lengths, you must fit them all into the grid.
Match each of the words to the corresponding grid spaces, in order to form a valid crossword-style solution.However, some words can be placed in multiple positions in the grid when you first start, so you may need to cross-reference at times to complete the puzzle. 
Each kriss kross has a starting letter, which is a clue to solving the puzzle, however, you will have to test your logic and thinking ahead abilities.
Fill-in Word is a perfect crosswords game for adults. Start from easy puzzles and progress to the hard ones.Test your word puzzle skills or pick a difficulty that is just for you.
Play mini crosswords to relax, and huge ones to keep your brain active. 
Criss Cross categories will help you to enrich your vocabulary and get to know more words in a variety of topics. 
Have you ever tried the number kriss kross? They are a little bit harder, as there is a higher chance of multiple numbers fitting in the same place in the grid. 
This Kriss-Kross Puzzle Book is a fun and relaxing way for teens, adults or seniors to sharpen their minds and test their logic skills.
The game features:
● Discover new words daily, with our daily crossword challenge.
● Progress from easy to extreme puzzles with no given clues and master your solving skills.
● Use hints can help you out when stuck fitting all the words to continue a winning streak!
● Choose between dark and light mode for comfortable play anywhere anytime!
● Offline mode is available for free

listings.name: Fill-in Word: Crossword Puzzle
listings.description:
Fill-in Word is a crossword-like puzzle, but with words instead of clues.

Welcome to the Fill-in Word crosswords puzzle, where you will improve your brain power and decision-making. 

Fill-In word puzzles, sometimes known as Word-Fit, Kriss Kross or Criss-Cross puzzles combine a love of words with a love of logic. 
The rules of kriss kross are simple, but solving them may not be! Given a list of words of different lengths, you must fit them all into the grid.
Match each of the words to the corresponding grid spaces, in order to form a valid crossword-style solution.However, some words can be placed in multiple positions in the grid when you first start, so you may need to cross-reference at times to complete the puzzle. 

Each kriss kross has a starting letter, which is a clue to solving the puzzle, however, you will have to test your logic and thinking ahead abilities.

Fill-in Word is a perfect crosswords game for adults. Start from easy puzzles and progress to the hard ones.Test your word puzzle skills or pick a difficulty that is just for you.
Play mini crosswords to relax, and huge ones to keep your brain active. 
Criss Cross categories will help you to enrich your vocabulary and get to know more words in a variety of topics. 
Have you ever tried the number kriss kross? They are a little bit harder, as there is a higher chance of multiple numbers fitting in the same place in the grid. 

This Kriss-Kross Puzzle Book is a fun and relaxing way for teens, adults or seniors to sharpen their minds and test their logic skills.
The game features:

● Discover new words daily, with our daily crossword challenge.
● Progress from easy to extreme puzzles with no given clues and master your solving skills.
● Use hints can help you out when stuck fitting all the words to continue a winning streak!
● Choose between dark and light mode for comfortable play anywhere anytime!
● Offline mode is available for free

If you enjoy brain twisters and logic games, you'll appreciate fill-in puzzles as a stimulating daily mental workout, with varying levels of complexity.

We hope you enjoy playing the fill-in word puzzle and we are looking forward to your feedback on the game.

bluejetty:00087370:ios.name: N-Back Challenge
bluejetty:00087370:ios.summary: The N-Back Challenge provides a special type of cognitive training, “dual n-back,” that helps you raise your IQ in just a few minutes per day. Sounds implausible? The N-Back Challenge is based on a decade’s worth of scientific studies, publ
bluejetty:00087370:ios.description:
The N-Back Challenge provides a special type of cognitive training, “dual n-back,” that helps you raise your IQ in just a few minutes per day. Sounds implausible? The N-Back Challenge is based on a decade’s worth of scientific studies, published in top peer-reviewed journals, including Nature. (For more details, see https://nbackchallenge.com/science.)
The catch? It’s no fun at all! Indeed, the training is designed to be maximally exhausting. If you are determined enough to make it through 20 sessions, however, science suggests that you stand to reap powerful benefits.
Intelligence is the ultimate cognitive ability: You need it to learn, reason, solve novel problems, and see connections. Higher IQs have been linked to improved academic achievement, professional success, and even better health. Since it will take you just 7 hours, in total, to complete the N-Back Challenge, not much more than the length of a single school day, it may prove to be the best investment of time you’ve ever made!
------------------------------
SCIENTIFICALLY SOUND: Not only has the dual n-back paradigm been validated in top peer-reviewed journals, but our two founders – both PhDs, one with a focus on neuroscience, the other with a focus on higher education – have taken particular care to thoroughly align the app with the prevailing scientific research.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS: In order to help you stay motivated, the N-Back Challenge allows you to visually monitor your progress over time, build up “streaks,” and compare yourself against other learners across various stats.
COMPETE AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS: Perhaps the most powerful way of making sure you remain motivated to complete the Challenge is to tackle it together with friends or colleagues. To make it more fun, we’ve provided leaderboards that allow you to compete based on who has completed the most sessions, racked up the longest streak, and more.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE: The N-Back Challenge allows you to choose between different voices across multiple languages, turn on notifications, and customize their timing and style. There are advanced settings for turning on instant button feedback, controlling the n-back level, and tweaking the game speed. And if you are too busy to complete one session every day, you may switch to the Weekly Habit, which gives you a full week to complete each session.
------------------------------
ARE YOU…
… A PARENT? Give your children an edge at school or university by nudging them to complete the N-Back Challenge. Indeed, why not tackle the Challenge together as a family?
… A GRANDCHILD? Help your grandparents (and other older relatives) fight cognitive decline by introducing them to dual n-back. (See https://nbackchallenge.com/decline.)
… A KNOWLEDGE WORKER? Share the N-Back Challenge with your HR department. Dual n-back may well be the single most cost-effective way of making knowledge workers more productive. (See https://nbackchallenge.com/work.)
… A TEACHER? Use dual n-back to enhance students' problem-solving skills. You can have a big impact, with a minimal investment of time! (See https://nbackchallenge.com/class.)
------------------------------
HOW IT WORKS: The N-Back Challenge is free as long as you stick to the program. When you miss or delay a session, we ask you to support us with a “coffee,” which you can buy in-app or earn — for example, by using the Share link in the Settings to invite friends. (Each of you will receive a free coffee.) You can also unlock unlimited free breaks by becoming a premium subscriber.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT: Do you have any questions or suggestions? Like to say hello? We’re happy to hear from you! Just drop us a note at support@nbackchallenge.com.
ADDITIONAL RESOURCES: To learn more about dual n-back and the N-Back Challenge, browse our repository of articles at https://nbackchallenge.com/articles.
Privacy Policy: https://nbackchallenge.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://nbackchallenge.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00114574:ios.description:
An exciting casual puzzle game focused on word categorization is here! The gameplay is incredibly simple to master in seconds: just drag the provided words and sort different types of words into their designated areas to unlock levels, bringing you a satisfying sense of accomplishment! The intuitive, easy fingertip controls deliver a consistently enjoyable experience.
The core rules are straightforward with no steep learning curve, but clearing levels smoothly isn’t easy! You need to plan within a limited number of moves and consider each step carefully. Every choice tests your strategic thinking and quick reaction abilities—if you run out of moves, the challenge ends, putting your strategy and reflexes to the test!
The levels are thoughtfully designed for easy, fun play! Whether on your commute, during lunch breaks, or while relaxing before bed, you can open the game anytime to start a fun challenge. Waiting in line will no longer be boring, and your leisure time will be more fulfilling!
While dragging and quickly categorizing words, you can improve your logical thinking, strengthen your categorization skills, and enhance your quick decision-making abilities. You can exercise your brain while playing, blending entertainment and learning. Whether you’re new to puzzle games or a player looking for a challenge, you can find enjoyment in this game! Start your journey to become a skilled word categorization player and unlock more engaging levels step by step!

bluejetty:00078752:ios.description:
Welcome to Tuscany Garden!
Experience the serenity and beauty of Tuscany’s countryside in this all-new farm simulation game. Here, you can plant and harvest unique crops, raise adorable animals, and create your own garden-style farm and charming town. Immerse yourself in a truly delightful country life!
Features of Tuscany Garden:
Planting & Harvesting: Grow unique Tuscan crops, care for cute animals, and harvest fresh ingredients to craft delicious dishes! Enjoy the rewards of each harvest season as you build a thriving farm.
Building & Decoration: Choose from a wide variety of beautiful buildings and decorations to create a unique garden-style farm and scenic town. Design your dream countryside home!
Adventure & Exploration: Take your pets on adventures, solve fun puzzles, and collect precious treasures. From ancient artifacts to rare warrior medallions, bring these keepsakes back to enrich your farm’s collection!
Beautiful Scenery: Embark on journeys to breathtaking locations—from enchanting rose gardens and romantic lavender villages to sunny tropical islands and snow-
covered towns. Discover the beauty of each unique landscape!
Engaging Story: Olivia’s family farm is at risk! With the Count threatening to take it away, Olivia has returned from her travels to restore the farm. Along the way, she discovers her mother’s mysterious disappearance may be tied to a hidden treasure. Help Olivia solve these mysteries!
Love & Companionship: On her journey, Olivia encounters two intriguing characters—charming Vincenzo and the reserved yet kind-hearted Andre, the Count’s son. Who will win her heart?
Friends & Competition: Compete with players around the world to see who the true Farm Master is!
Tuscany Garden is a free-to-play farm simulation game, where all content is accessible for free, though some items can speed up your progress if you choose. If Olivia’s farm isn’t managed well, it risks falling into the Count’s hands. Step in to help her and begin your adventure today!

A fascinating castle with hidden candies will trigger your curiosity and immerse you in the magic world of match 3 games!

- Match 3 or more candies in a line to crush them.

- Combine 2 special candies together to create stunning effects.

bluejetty:00134953:ios.name: Voidpet Garden: Mental Health
bluejetty:00134953:ios.summary:
Enter Voidpet Garden: your mental health journal brought to life, where your emotions live as magical creatures!
Whether it is anxiety, depression, anger, or simply curiosity you experience, you will discover, befriend, and grow new parts
bluejetty:00134953:ios.description:
Enter Voidpet Garden: your mental health journal brought to life, where your emotions live as magical creatures!
Whether it is anxiety, depression, anger, or simply curiosity you experience, you will discover, befriend, and grow new parts of yourself as you fill your journal, embarking on your mental health adventure.
We’ve designed cute, digestible, and free journal prompts inspired by Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), and personalized recommendations from practicing therapists. Your journal can be your support through times of anxiety, depression, anger, and stress, or cheerleader that celebrates your good days, keeping your mental health going strong.
MOOD TRACKER
Track mood and see mental health progress over time. Notice patterns of anxiety, anger, or stress.
GRATITUDE JOURNALING
Journal for optimism and overall mental health.
GOAL SETTING
Journal for motivation, productivity, and self care. For depression, ADHD, and building a growth mindset.
EMOTIONAL NAMING
Practice mindfulness for one’s own mental health. Quick journal for anxiety, anger, and stress.
PRACTICING POSITIVITY
DBT inspired exercise to pair stressful situations with positive coping thoughts.
AFFIRMATIONS
Self-affirming and self-loving phrases to fill your journal with positivity. Face anxiety with confidence.
MINUTE MEDITATION
Simple soundtracks to encourage mental health as an active practice. A moment of calm to soothe anxiety.
FRIENDSHIP JOURNAL
Journal for healthy social relationships.
PHYSICAL CHECK INS
Journal for physical mindfulness about one’s own body. Track patterns between anxiety and physical stress.
NEGATIVE THOUGHT CHECK
CBT worksheet to help you identity and soothe negative thoughts. Journal for anxiety, depression, anger, or stress.
AFFIRMATIONS FOR ANXIETY AND PANIC ATTACKS
Soothing soundtrack underscoring positive sound bites of self love, safety, and understanding.
HOPE BOX
Journal to curate hopeful memories and resources. For episodes of depression, suicidal thoughts, and self harm.
OVERTHINK TIMER
Time-boxed journal for anxiety, depression, anger, intrusive thoughts, and more.
VENT RETREAT
Visualize a safe space to journal about anxiety, depression, or anger.
As you track your mood and journal daily, you’ll nourish a zen oasis that grows with you, attracting fantasy creatures who make your journal their home.
Experience the tried and true mental health benefits of journaling. When you build the habit of tracking emotions cognitively, your brain can take a step back from overwhelming sensations like anxiety, and focus on taking steps to improve wellbeing.
This mental health app takes your journal to the next level. When you not only verbalize and journal, but also visualize and interact with your feelings of anger, sadness, anxiety, and distress, you train your mind to build positive, imaginative, associations with itself, and develop a nuanced, more self-loving mindset for mental health.
--

Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
You can cancel anytime with your Apple account settings.

bluejetty:00024469:ios.summary: Want a free, powerful password manager? Norton Password Manager is a single solution to help manage your unique passwords in multiple ways. Memorizing complex passwords with symbols, numbers, capital letters, and more, is difficult but usin
bluejetty:00024469:ios.description:
Want a free, powerful password manager? Norton Password Manager is a single solution to help manage your unique passwords in multiple ways. Memorizing complex passwords with symbols, numbers, capital letters, and more, is difficult but using strong passwords is important to help keep your personal information secure. With Norton Password Manager, your information is encrypted, helping keep it secure, yet still available across your devices so you can access it anywhere. Best of all, it’s free!*
Why Norton Password Manager
• Passwords filled in a single tap
When you log in to websites and apps, it’s a smoother, quicker, and more convenient experience. Your passwords are stored in an online vault, which can be used to auto fill online login information with a single tap.¹ 
• Encrypted 
With zero knowledge encryption and two-factor authentication, only you control access to your password vault–not even Norton can access it. These security measures help keep your data safer from cybercriminals and hacking attempts. 
• Free*
Norton Password Manager is free and accessible to anyone and works on devices including computers, tablets, and phones.
• Sync passwords¹ 
Your entire password vault can be synced and accessed across your devices. Your logins and credit card credentials can be auto filled. 
• Biometric unlock²
There’s no need to even type in your vault password. Access your vault faster or recover your vault password³ using Apple’s Touch ID® or Face ID®.
• Password Assessment
Check if your passwords are strong and easily create new passwords or change weak passwords to strong ones that are more difficult to crack.
Your information stays private even from us because it’s encrypted using zero-knowledge encryption before being stored in your cloud-based vault. Your passwords and other personal information can be even more secure by enabling two-factor authentication, plus you can use Apple’s Touch ID® or Face ID® so you can access your vault even faster. 
Creating and remembering complex passwords doesn’t have to be difficult. Norton Password Manager helps you safeguard your personal information by making recommendations to strengthen passwords, adding more security to your online, digital life.
* With the free version of Norton Password Manager, we reserve the right to limit the number of entries (like passwords) at any time. This limitation won’t affect any existing entries in your vault.
¹ Requires your device to have an Internet/data plan and be turned on.
² Only available on iOS devices with Fingerprint Authentication or Touch ID/Face ID activated.
³ Vault Password Reset can only be initiated on an iOS smartphone. To work, your smartphone must have the Norton Password Manager mobile app installed, set up, and connected to your Norton account, plus the Biometric Authentication (fingerprint, or Touch ID/Face ID) activated, beforehand.
PRIVACY POLICY
Norton respects the privacy of our users and carefully safeguards personal data.
For more information: https://www.norton.com/privacy

bluejetty:00091646:ios.description:
PC Matic Mobile Security provides the latest in content blocking for Safari users. Fully configurable to filter Ads, Social, Privacy, and Security related items depending on your choices. The app is free to use but does offer additional management features for existing PC Matic customers.
Key Features
* Safari Ad Blocking: Keep pesky ads out of your web browsing. PC Matic brings together the best of EasyList to block ads which can also increase your browsing speeds and lower bandwidth use.
* Safari & PC Matic Security: PC Matic’s team of malware researchers are constantly updating our own security list to block URLs that are likely to contain malware and keep you safe while browsing the web.
* Safari Social Media Blocking: Looking to stay dark on social media and don’t want to be pestered with content, buttons, or widgets related to social media? Enable our social media blocking for some peace and quiet online.
* Safari Privacy Protection: The ultimate boost in privacy protection while using Safari, PC Matic blocks tracking scripts and web analytics tools to keep you a bit more anonymous online.
* PC Matic Account Management: PC Matic customers can use this application to monitor all of their devices that are secured by PC Matic. Easily browse through your active devices, and monitor notifications and protection status. With this app, it’s simple to monitor 5 devices at home or 5,000 devices at your business.
About PC Matic
Established in 1999, PC Matic is a minority owned small business that provides zero trust endpoint protection through application allowlisting for organizations of all sizes and made exclusively in America. PC Matic’s products provide our customers with essential security that enhances the zero-trust model and fills potential gaps left by other traditional endpoint security software. With a foundation in application allowlisting, PC Matic uses a default-deny approach that prevents all known bad and unknown applications from executing. 
Follow us at @pcmatic on Twitter and Facebook or @pcmaticusa on Instagram!

bluejetty:00136047:ios.description:
The Starbucks KSA App is the easiest way for you to order ahead for pickup and earn Stars every time you purchase your Starbucks favourites - beverage, food, coffee-at-home products, and merchandise at our stores or in-app*.
With every purchase in-app or in-store of your favourite Starbucks food, beverages and Starbucks® merchandise, watch Stars add up towards Free Drinks and special benefits. Get exclusive Rewards member offers sent directly to your inbox. Conveniently find your nearest Starbucks store and view your transaction history with just a tap.
Enhance your Starbucks experience, all on your Starbucks KSA app.
Getting rewarded with Stars is super easy. Here’s how you can get started:
• Download the Starbucks KSA app and register
• When in store, Scan the QR code on your app every time you make a purchase at any participating Starbucks store in KSA to collect Stars; you get 4 Stars for every 10 SAR spent!
• View your collected Stars on the home screen of your app
• Redeem Stars across 5 different tiers of Rewards, including drinks, food, and merchandise, starting from 150 Stars.
• More Stars unlock the world of Gold Membership, with free birthday drink and premium offers galore.
Skip the queues and order ahead directly from the App
• Select your store of choice
• Choose your menu items
• Customise to your liking
• Pay on the app and checkout
• Head on to your chosen store and pick up your order
• Collecting Stars? Don’t worry Rewards are built in, so you’ll earn Stars with every purchase
Don’t miss out, be a part of the Starbucks coffee club – Download the Starbucks KSA app now!
* Starbucks KSA app is available for use only at participating Starbucks Stores across KSA.

bluejetty:00134461:ios.description:
Introducing the On3 Sports App, your ultimate companion for all things college sports, football and basketball recruiting, NIL, Transfer Portal, and beyond. Get ready to immerse yourself in a world of trusted news, comprehensive data, and expert insights on your favorite teams, all conveniently accessible through this feature-rich app.
Stay on top of the latest developments in college sports with the On3 Sports App. We understand the importance of accurate and reliable information, which is why we've partnered with a network of local experts who are deeply connected to the world of collegiate athletics. These seasoned journalists and insiders bring you up-to-the-minute news, exclusive interviews, and in-depth analysis that go beyond the surface. With their unique perspectives and insider knowledge, you can trust that you're getting the most comprehensive coverage available.
Unlock the best of College Sports through our vast network of fansites: Auburn Live, BamaOnLine, BWI, Blue and Gold, CaneSport, DawgsHQ, GamecockCentral, Gators Online, Gold and Black, Hawkeye Report, HuskerOnline, Inside Texas, K-State Online, KSR, Lettermen Row, Maroon and White, OM Spirit, On The Pony Express, Scoop Duck, Sooner Scoop, SpartanMag, The Bengal Tiger, The Wolfpacker, The Wolverine, Volquest, Warchant, and WeAreSC.
The On3 Sports App goes beyond news and analysis; it empowers you with the data and insights you need to truly understand the game. Dive into detailed statistics, historical data, recruiting rankings, and much more. Whether you're a passionate fan or a coach looking for a competitive edge, our app provides the tools and information to satisfy your thirst for knowledge.
Recruiting is a crucial aspect of college sports, and the On3 Sports App ensures you stay ahead of the game. Get comprehensive coverage of football and basketball recruiting, including player profiles, rankings, commitments, and updates on the Transfer Portal. Stay informed about the future stars of your favorite teams and track the progress of recruiting classes with ease.
To enhance your experience, the On3 Sports App features push notifications, delivering real-time alerts straight to your device. Whether it's breaking news, game updates, roster changes, or recruiting developments, you'll never miss a beat. Customize your notification preferences to receive updates tailored specifically to your favorite teams and topics of interest. With push notifications, you can stay connected to the world of college sports anytime, anywhere.
The On3 Sports App is your gateway to a comprehensive and immersive college sports experience. From trusted news to expert analysis, from comprehensive data to real-time alerts, this app has it all. Download the On3 Sports App today and unlock a new level of engagement with the world of college sports. Whether you're a dedicated fan, a curious observer, or a student-athlete with dreams of playing at the next level, this app is your ultimate companion on your college sports journey.

Privacy Policy: https://www.on3.com/page/privacy-policy/
