bluejetty:00037007:ios.description:
AI Chat - Your Ultimate Conversational & Creative Sidekick
Transform the way you interact, learn, and create. From answering burning questions to generating mind-blowing content, experience a truly next-level AI companion that’s always ready to help. The power of AI at your fingertips!
◆ Key Features:
▶ Ask Anything - Need a quick fact check, personalized advice, or random trivia? Ask away! 
▶ Generate AI Videos - Get creative and produce unique videos with just a few taps.
▶ Generate AI Music - Compose captivating tunes in various styles. Whether you want background music for a video or just a fun soundtrack.
▶ Generate AI Photos - Turn your imaginations into artistic visuals. Watch AI Chat craft stunning imagery at your command.
▶ Image Analysis - Select a photo from your gallery, and AI Chat will detect objects, landmarks, or other details to help you understand it better.
▶ Speech to Text - Don’t feel like typing? Just record your voice! AI Chat accurately transcribes your speech.
▶ Characters & Roleplay - Have fun or learn from a pro! Ask historical figures, famous celebrities, or fictional characters anything you wish.
▶ Multilingual Support - Over 80 languages are supported, so you can converse, create, and learn in the language of your choice.
▶ Chat History - Keep track of all your interactions in one convenient place. Resume previous chats anytime and never lose important insights.
▶ Discover Prompts - Spark your creativity with curated prompts across categories like relationships, social media, tech, sports, productivity, and more.
◆ Subscription Terms:
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within AI Chat
- Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
- Payment will be charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and cost depends on your chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
◆ Customer Support:
You can reach us at ai+chat@videobakery.co and we will do our best to solve any issue you may encounter in our app.
Built using OpenAI’s API. This app is independently developed and not affiliated with or endorsed or sponsored by OpenAI.

bluejetty:00168951:ios.description:
FoodCheckr is your ultimate food analyzer! With just a quick barcode scan, the app gives you insights into what you're eating, helping you make healthier choices.
FoodCheckr uses a comprehensive and continually updated database to deliver accurate nutritional information and ingredient breakdowns. Understand what’s in your food, down to the last additive. Not just that, the app also indicates potentially harmful additives, keeping you informed and safe.
Now with advanced AI features, FoodCheckr can analyze products for bioengineered ingredients and detect traces of insects, ensuring you are fully aware of what you're consuming. Additionally, you can check the ingredients of each canned product for a complete understanding of its contents.
Key Features:
Quick Barcode Scanning: Instantly get detailed information about your food products.
Detailed Food Analysis: Learn about energy content, proteins, sugars, fats, and more.
Additive Insights: Find out if your food contains any potentially harmful additives.
AI-Powered Analysis: Identify bioengineered ingredients and insect traces in your food.
Ingredient Checking: Check the ingredients of each canned product.
History Tracking: FoodCheckr saves your scan history for offline quick reference in the future.
Food Product Images: View product images for better recognition.
Whether you're a health-conscious individual, someone with specific dietary needs, or simply curious about what you're consuming, FoodCheckr is your ideal food partner. Experience a new level of dietary awareness and embrace healthier eating habits with FoodCheckr.

bluejetty:00177773:ios.description:
Europe's #1 fitness app lets you work out anytime, anywhere with the most advanced digital personal trainer – no gym required. Whatever your fitness level, build healthy habits and achieve your goals faster than ever with a personalized fitness plan tailored to you. Add cardio workouts, weights, gym machines, mix in some running intervals, or keep it classic Freeletics with bodyweight HIIT or calisthenics-style workouts at home. Every training plan features fully personalized workouts, complete with warm-ups, cooldowns, mobility, and recovery workouts, all designed to help you recover faster and achieve your goals quicker.
WHY FREELETICS?
- Freeletics means freedom to work out where you want, when you want – on your terms. Join a community of 60 million athletes training together to stay motivated and on track.
- Develop strength, endurance, and flexibility with a fully holistic approach to fitness that helps you become a well-rounded athlete.
- Your AI Coach customizes each workout to your fitness level, adjusting in real time based on your feedback to create a perfect workout every time. No two people get the same workout plan – it's fully personalized fitness.
- Whether you want to build a six-pack, gain muscle, or lose weight, you’ll get a training plan with workouts to fit your needs.
- Easily customize your workouts in seconds to match your setup for home workouts, gym sessions, or wherever you are to stay on track, support consistency, and see long-term results.
The free version of the app contains 34 HIIT bodyweight workouts, 100+ exercises, and a community of millions. If you want to set yourself up for long-term success with the guidance of an expert personal trainer every step of the way, you can use the Freeletics Coach with a 14-day money-back guarantee.
What you get by upgrading to the Freeletics Coach:
TRAINING
- Your AI personal trainer in your pocket creates every workout based on your goals, fitness level, training preferences, and more.
- Travelling or short on time? Want to switch to an upper-body workout instead? No problem. Your digital personal trainer instantly adjusts your workout to match your needs.
- Your personalized workout plan is part of a "Training Journey." Choose from 30 fitness plans in the app, each with a different fitness focus.
- Pick your workout style. From cardio like running, cycling, and rowing, to classic Freeletics bodyweight HIIT workouts, calisthenics, weighted exercises, or gym machines – there’s a training plan for you.
- With 1 trillion workout combinations, 700+ exercises, hundreds of workouts on demand, and even a tool to create your own workout routines, you’ll always find the perfect workout for you.
- Control your workout from your Apple Watch and track your fitness data in the Apple Health app.
- Track your fitness progress, performance, and achievements using badges, streaks, and skill progressions designed to help you improve.
The Training Coach is included in the Training and Training & Nutrition Bundle.
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
We offer 6 auto-renewing subscription options:
• Training (3 / 6 / 12 months)
• Training & Nutrition (3 / 6 / 12 months)
The Nutrition Coach is part of the separate Freeletics Nutrition app.
Your subscription automatically renews if not cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You will be charged for the next subscription period up to 24 hours before the current subscription expires. Manage your subscription and disable automatic renewal anytime in your Apple account settings. You have the right to withdraw from your initial subscription within 14 days. By purchasing, you accept our Terms of Use (https://www.freeletics.com/en/pages/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.freeletics.com/en/pages/privacy).
Contact us at https://help.freeletics.com/hc/ or follow @Freeletics on social media for daily workout inspiration. Your personal trainer is ready.

bluejetty:00169806:ios.description:
Network Sniffer is an intelligent network activity analyzer that helps you understand what your apps are really doing online.
No technical skills required — easily identify: Which apps are secretly connecting to the internet? Are they sending requests frequently in the background? Is your privacy at risk or data being wasted? You're no longer a passive user — you're in control.
Core Features (not limited to):
1. Deep Network Analysis: Visual reports showing which apps are connecting, what they are sending, how often, and whether there’s abnormal or wasteful activity.
2. Network Sniffing: Capture HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket traffic on your iOS device, with full MITM support for encrypted traffic analysis.
3. External Proxy: Route device traffic through an external proxy server, enabling custom inspection, filtering, and debugging of network requests.
4. JavaScript Scripting: Create custom rules and behaviors using JavaScript to enhance and personalize your network inspection.
5. Request Replays: Resend captured requests to test app behavior under various conditions — ideal for debugging and performance testing.
6. Request/Response Rewrite: Modify headers and bodies of requests and responses on the fly, giving you unmatched control over data flows.
7. Client Proxy: Forward requests from other devices on your local network to this device for centralized debugging.
8. Upstream Proxy Support: Forward HTTP requests to a third-party proxy server for advanced testing or network routing scenarios.
9. Widgets & Dynamic Island Support: Monitor upload/download speeds and data usage in real time via homescreen widgets or the iPhone Dynamic Island.
Permissions
Network Sniffer requires VPN permission to function. This is only used for local traffic capture — no remote servers or proxying involved.
Privacy Notice
Network Sniffer does not upload any of your data and does not include any proxy, VPN bypass, or "scientific access" functions. Your data stays on your device.
If you have any feedback or questions, please feel free to contact us at miaozhi.ai@gmail.com

bluejetty:00092604:ios.description:
PA CDL Prep Test:
The Pennsylvania CDL Prep Test is a comprehensive study tool designed to help individuals prepare for the Pennsylvania Commercial Driver's License (CDL) exam. This app provides users with an interactive and engaging way to study for the CDL exam. The app covers all of the key topics, including:
* Vehicle inspection
* Vehicle control
* Air Brakes
* Hazardous Materials
* Transportation of passengers
The app includes a variety of practice questions for the PA CDL exam. These questions are based on the Pennsylvania CDL handbook Users can track their progress and identify areas where they need more practice, allowing them to focus their studying on the areas where they need the most improvement.
App tracks the users completed practice tests. The app tracks their progress, allowing them to identify areas for improvement and track their overall progress. 
You should be able to "bookmark" questions so that you can study them later.
In addition, the app provides a list of weak questions based on practice tests on CDL Prep Test.
In the Pennsylvania CDL Permit Practice Test, there are multiple-choice questions. You must correctly answer questions based on the passing marks or mistakes allowed for that particular test.
Features:
- Study and Practice tests
 - Driving rules
 - Knowledge test
 - Air Brakes
 - Combination
 - Bus Endorsement
 - Hazmat Endorsement
 - Double Endorsement
 - Tank Endorsement
 - Passenger Endorsement
- Bookmark questions
- Preview answers after the test is submitted.
- Resume and Restart the test
- Questions with explanation
- Keep Track of Your Progress
- List of Weak/Wrong Questions for Improvement
- Review Previous tests
- Appearance ( Auto / Light / Dark )
- Test
 - Result on-the-spot with score
 - Review test questions with answers and filter about right and wrong answers
The Pennsylvania PA CDL Prep Test app is user-friendly and accessible, allowing individuals to study and prepare for the DMV CDL exam.
The app aims to provide individuals with a comprehensive and convenient study resource to help them pass the CDL exam and obtain their commercial driver's license in Pennsylvania . Whether you are a first-time CDL candidate or a seasoned professional, this app is an essential tool for passing the Pennsylvania CDL exam and achieving your commercial driver's license.
Content Source
Our app includes a variety of practice questions for the Driver's license exam for Commercial Vehicles. These questions are based on the official handbook of different states.
Disclaimer: 
This app is simply a fantastic tool for self-study and exam preparation. It has no affiliation with or endorsement from any government organisation, certificate, test, name, or trademark.

bluejetty:00063177:ios.description:
Explore the universe and test your puzzle-solving skills in Connect One, a starry adventure where you connect the dots to form stunning constellations! In this mesmerizing puzzle game, your goal is to link the stars without crossing the same line twice. With each level, you'll unravel intricate constellations that become more challenging and beautiful as you progress.
Connect One offers a unique blend of strategy, relaxation, and challenge. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers, this star-themed game invites you to draw constellations by connecting stars along the right path. But be careful—you can’t go over the same line twice!
Connect the stars and form constellations without retracing your steps
Beautiful celestial-themed puzzles that range from easy to mind-bending
Hundreds of challenging levels to keep your brain engaged
Relaxing and atmospheric visuals inspired by the night sky and constellations
Simple yet strategic gameplay that grows more complex as you advance
Stunning cosmic graphics and animations that bring the stars to life
Let the stars guide you through this cosmic puzzle journey! Whether you're looking for a quick challenge or hours of brain-teasing fun, Connect One will light up your gaming experience. Download now and start connecting the stars to create your own constellations!

bluejetty:00129661:ios.description:
Welcome to the Top G Trivia game, where you can put your knowledge of the charismatic former kickboxing world champion to the test! Step into the spotlight and see if you have what it takes to achieve the jackpot.
Who Wants to Be a Millionaire Theme: Experience the thrill of the popular game show as you aim to answer 15 challenging questions correctly and claim the ultimate prize. Each question brings you closer to becoming a true Top G trivia expert.
Helpers at Your Disposal: If you find yourself stuck on a question, don't worry! You have four powerful helpers at your disposal:
The Real World(trw): Tap into the collective knowledge of the real world by asking the community for help. Get insights, and suggestions from others who can guide you towards the correct answer.
Tate Help: In a unique twist, you can seek direct assistance from the Top G himself. Benefit from his expertise as he shares valuable hints and insights to steer you in the right direction.
50:50: Feeling torn between multiple answers? Use the 50:50 lifeline to narrow down your options. This helper will eliminate two incorrect answers, leaving you with a better chance of selecting the correct one.
New Question: If you're unsure about the current question, take a risk and opt for a new question. However, be cautious, as the next question may present a whole new challenge.
Reach for the Top: Aim to conquer all 15 questions and prove that you're a true TOP G. Claim the jackpot and secure your spot as a Top G in the community.
Do you have what it takes to rise to the challenge and become the ultimate TOP G Trivia champion? Test your knowledge, use your helpers wisely, and show off your expertise. Download the TOP G Trivia game now and let the game show begin!

From South Park Digital Studios comes a real-time strategy battle game like nothing you’ve ever experienced before! Take on Cartman, Kenny, Stan and Kyle in all out mobile mayhem!

- Join a team and boost your decks by sharing cards with your teammates.
- Take part in weekly Team Wars, strategize with your team and rise to the top of the leaderboard.
- Customize your New Kid to be the baddest looking kid on the block.
- Witness Randy cross-dressing in new and exciting outfits.

bluejetty:00088183:ios.description:
二十四节气，是中国人通过观察太阳周年运动而形成的时间知识体系及其实践。中国人将太阳周年运动轨迹划分为24等份，每一份为一个节气，即，立春、雨水、惊蛰、春分、清明、谷雨、立夏、小满 、芒种、夏至、小暑、大暑、立秋、处暑、白露、秋分、寒露、霜降、立冬、小雪、大雪、冬至、小寒、大寒。
二十四节气形成于黄河流域，以观察该区域的天象、气温、降水和物候的时序变化为基准，作为农耕社会的生产生活的时间指南逐步为全国各地所采用。各农业社区依据节气安排传统农事日程，举办节令仪式和民俗活动；民众安排家庭和个人的衣食住行。
为了更细致地描述自然的变化，古人将每个节气进一步分为三个“物候”，一共有七十二物候。每个物候大约持续五天，代表着自然界的细微变化。比如立春，一候东风解冻：春风吹来，河流冰雪开始融化。二候蛰虫始振：冬眠的昆虫开始活动。三候鱼陟负冰：鱼儿开始浮上水面，在冰下游动。
十二时辰，是中国人根据一天之中太阳出没、天色变化的归纳总结。传统上把一昼夜等分成十二个时段，每一个时段叫一个时辰。
华夏先民早在西周时期，就开始使用十二时辰计时了。至汉代将其命名为夜半、鸡鸣、平旦、日出、食时、隅中、日中、日昳、晡时、日入、黄昏、人定。
二十四节气和十二时辰历史悠久，是中华民族对人类天文历法的杰出贡献，也是中华传统文化的瑰宝。
时历APP，是一款以古人因天之序的自然观和历法实践为基础，并汲取二十四节气、十二时辰的文化传统和生活习惯精心打造的产品。在时历中，我们不仅为每个时辰设计了不同的显示方案，同时还备注了每个时辰的活跃经络。以及二十四节气中，每个节气的天文、气象和物候、农事。让我们可以轻松体验古人与自然相和谐的生活方式！
时历APP，不仅拥有漂亮的手机桌面小组件，同时还支持苹果手表。
一起来体验华夏先民，因天之序「日出而作，日入而息」的诗意生活吧！
“日出而作，日入而息，逍遥于天地之间，而心意自得，吾何以天下为哉！” —— 庄子

bluejetty:00069470:ios.description:
Following the worldwide successes of Pro Snooker, Pro Pool and our other sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Darts 2026+; one of the most feature packed and playable darts games available for mobile devices.
With fully textured 3D game environments, specialist custom boards for standard and more obscure game types, and millions of possible dart component combinations, Pro Darts 2026+ is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple 'swipe to throw' interface combined with an innovative adjustable 'player assist' system allows everyone from novices to pros to pick up and play the game instantly at their own skill level.
Download Pro Darts 2026+ now, you will not be disappointed.
System Requirements:
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices
∙ Game Center compatible
Game Features:
∙ Localised to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, American English, Canadian English, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments.
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own.
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against a friend, family member or computer opponent.
∙ League: Participate in league events with 3, 5, 7 or 9 rounds where the highest points total wins.
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event.
∙ Configure up to 4 unique player profiles.
∙ Each profile holds 5 custom darts, comprehensive stats and progression history.
∙ Custom dart configuration system allows for millions of combinations of barrels, stems, stem colors, flight shapes and textures.
∙ Innovative 'player assist' system to help with getting those tricky doubles and trebles.
∙ 3 levels of Oche (throw line) camera to suit all playing styles.
∙ User controlled Orbit Camera and Snapshot system allows you to save close up images of your dart grouping.
∙ Ranking system from Rookie to Legend.
∙ 28 computer opponents with customizable names. Play against the pros!
∙ Over 10 unique dart boards including 'American', 'Par Darts', 'Hi Score', 'Quadro', 'Mini', 'Snooker', 'Yorkshire', 'Fives' and 'Target' boards, each with multiple color options.
∙ Play 301, 401, 501, 601, 701 and 1001 games on many of the custom boards.
∙ Play 'Round the Clock' including special 'doubles' and 'trebles' only variations.
∙ Play 'Snooker' darts on three custom boards and standard boards.
∙ Play 'Par Darts' (Golf) on three custom boards.
∙ Play 305, 405, 505, 605, 705 or 1005 'Fives' games on either the London 'narrow' fives board or the Ipswich 'wide' fives board.
∙ Play 'Cricket Darts'.
∙ Complete control over the numbers of Sets and Legs per match.
∙ Multiplayer game modes including ‘Online Play’, ‘Local Network’ and 'Pass and Play'.
∙ Over 25 achievements to collect locally or via Game Center.
∙ Track your game progress and achievement progress locally in the new 3D Trophy Room.

bluejetty:00160067:ios.description:
A história começou a ser construída em 1958 quando o nome Violeta surgiu pela primeira vez através do Café Violeta, onde o Sr José, ainda menino, ajudava seu pai nas tarefas do dia a dia e ao mesmo tempo incorporava a essência do negócio que anos mais tarde se tornaria o Restaurante e Pizzaria Violeta, que continua em atividade até os dias atuais.
Em 1996 chegou o momento de expandir ainda mais a história do Violeta e no bairro do Butantã, foi inaugurada a primeira loja do supermercado Violeta, que deu inicio a uma rede de lojas que completa 23 anos de existência, em 2019.
Hoje, ao todo são 7 lojas, 95 checkouts e mais de 1.200 funcionários que atendem cerca de 20.000 clientes atendidos por dia em nossas lojas.
Nosso objetivo é ser o seu melhor vizinho, todos os dias.

bluejetty:00033848:ios.description:
Iconboard allows you to create, manage, and apply icon configurations for your iOS homescreen:
- Add icons to your lock screen thanks to Widgets (requires iOS 16)
- Create consistent icon sets in seconds.
- Create custom icons from over 1,500 glyphs, applying custom background and border colors & gradients. 
- Import images to apply them as icons
- Save different setup configurations to quickly change your styles.
- Generate custom wallpapers as solid or gradient files.
- Customize the action to be performed when opening the icons.
- Invisible icons: Place your icons in any position on the screen with this feature. 
- Custom icon themes to take your customizations further. 
- Open App Store apps seamlessly thanks to Shortcuts.
WIDGETS
Iconboard lets you create lock screen and home screen widgets so you can open your favorite apps more quickly.
You can use it to open your calendar, reminders, settings, and even other favorite apps like TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, or Locket
MAKE ICONS WITH YOUR PHOTOS
With its unique image recognition capabilities, Iconboard can extract colors from your pictures and create a beautiful palette with your icons. 
It really looks like they belong together!
* System apps do not open without the shortcuts app because of operating system limitations. Notification badges are also unavailable for this same reason.
-- Subscription Details --
• Monthly and annual subscriptions are available.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account after the expiration of the free trial.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
• Subscriptions can be managed or canceled by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/iconboardios/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://zipoapps.com/iconboardios/terms/

bluejetty:00014514:ios.description:
With the Nusenda Credit Union Mobile Banking App, access your accounts and loans anytime, anywhere. You can check balances, view account activity and history, pay bills on-the-go, transfer funds to anyone with just an email address or phone number, make account and member-to-member transfers, deposit checks, and locate branches and ATMs. 
If you are concerned about a misplaced debit card, you can log into the app and lock your card to reduce the chances of unauthorized transactions to your account. Follow the same process to unlock your card when it is found. 
Accessing your account is even easier with Touch ID® and Face ID®! To use Touch ID, you will need an iPhone 5s or later, with iOS version 8 or higher. To use Face ID, you will need an iPhone X with iOS version 11 or higher. 
Mobile Banking, like Internet Banking, is protected by advanced technology. No private data, including your account information, is ever stored on your mobile device. 
For more information about Mobile Banking, visit nusenda.org/mobile. To learn how we protect your privacy, visit nusenda.org/privacy. 
Your mobile device carrier's standard charges may apply.

bluejetty:00119616:ios.description:
Verizon Connect’s Spotlight App puts the power of the Fleet & Reveal platform in the palm of your hand, helping to improve both the safety and efficiency of daily business operations. The mobile app lets you quickly identify crucial information about your vehicles, drivers, or assets, and take decisive action at any time from nearly anywhere.
Why use it:
Better visibility 
Whether you are in the office, on the road, or at home, Spotlight lets you quickly access near real-time information about your vehicles, assets, and drivers. 
Improved communication
Streamline your communication with your drivers with the ability to call or send messages directly from the Spotlight app with a single click. 
Easy Onboarding
Easily get up and running with Spotlight -- designed based on customer feedback. No experience or training required. 
What’s included:
Map
Quickly identify the location and status of all vehicles, assets, and places in near-real-time or review vehicle history via a single map, list, or detailed view with no limit on the number of vehicles/assets you can view at once. 
Drivers tab
Easily find a specific driver and get detailed information (i.e. name, vehicle, current location, contact information, and recent alerts).
Alerts tab
Manage your driver’s behavior with near real-time alerts (i.e. harsh driving, idling, and speeding) that are color-coded based on assigned priority and provide key details to give more context on the event. 
Search 
Easily find your vehicles, drivers, and places in the system by searching for a name (or even partial name).
Feedback
Want to tell us how you feel about Spotlight? Leave comments and feedback directly on the app to influence future enhancements. 
Not a Verizon Connect customer?
Contact the Verizon Connect team at 1 (866) 844 2235 to get started.

bluejetty:00091671:ios.description:
Looking to manage you Mississippi Power account anytime, anywhere? The Mississippi Power App is the easiest way to manage your energy account and stay connected. You can easily: 
• Pay your bill. Avoid late fees. You can pay with a credit card, debit card, or checking account.
• View your account history. See your past bills, payments, and usage data. This information can help you track your energy usage and identify ways to save money.
• Report an outage. Let us know if your power is out and view restoration efforts. MPC will work to restore service safely and efficiently.
• Compare and manage energy usage. View your daily and monthly usage and compare it to past months. This information can help you track your energy usage, and you can enroll to receive usage alerts. 
• Enroll in alerts and communications. Receive alerts when your bill is due, when there is an outage in your area, when your power is restored or when your usage is high. Sign up for paperless billing and get your bills delivered to your email. 
• Sign on with fingerprint/face ID. Set up either touch or face ID to easily access your account.
Download the app today and start saving energy and money!

bluejetty:00186930:ios.description:
Understand the human body from the inside out.
The Anatomy App by Muscle & Motion transforms your device into a powerful 3D learning platform focused entirely on muscles, joints, and movement mechanics. Watch which muscles activate, and learn exactly how the body moves, joint by joint.
Whether you’re a student, therapist, personal trainer, strength coach, or movement professional, this app helps you visualize functional anatomy in a way textbooks simply can’t
Why students, teachers & movement professionals love it
- Makes complex anatomy easy to understand through clear and accurate 3D animations
- Shows exactly how muscles, bones, and joints interact during movement
- Helps explain concepts to clients, patients, and students far better than static images or diagrams
- Strengthens understanding of biomechanics, improving both teaching and practice
Key Features:
• Interactive 3D Anatomy Model (Full Musculoskeletal System)
• 3D “Muscles in Motion” Animations
• Visual Explanations of Joint Movements & Mechanics
• Watch in 3D the origin, insertion, and action of each muscle
Who is this app for?
The Anatomy app is built for anyone who wants to master human movement, including:
- Anatomy & kinesiology students
- Sports-science and pre-med students
- Physiotherapists, chiropractors & rehab professionals
- Personal trainers & strength coaches
- Pilates, yoga & movement teachers
- University and college instructors
- Massage therapists
- Anyone who wants a deeper understanding of the human body
Use it to study, teach, diagnose, explain, or simply deepen your visual understanding of anatomy and biomechanics.
Free Access & Subscriptions
You can download the app and start learning with a free tier that unlocks a portion of the content so you can explore the 3D model and sample educational videos.
To access the full library of 3D anatomy content, videos, and advanced lessons, you can upgrade with an in-app subscription:
- Subscriptions give you full access to all 3D models, videos and content for the duration of your plan.
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID account settings.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your device.
For full details:
Privacy Policy: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/terms-of-use/
Support:
Have a question, feature request or need help with your subscription?
Our team is happy to help at info@muscleandmotion.com.

record-keeping.

bluejetty:00132093:ios.summary: Flip is a sample-based mobile music studio that was designed for a fast and intuitive work flow. Import your own sounds via AirDrop or the Files app, or record sounds directly with your device's microphone or a connected iOS interface. As s
bluejetty:00132093:ios.description:
Flip is a sample-based mobile music studio that was designed for a fast and intuitive work flow. Import your own sounds via AirDrop or the Files app, or record sounds directly with your device's microphone or a connected iOS interface. As soon as you record a sound it’s available to be played on drum pads as well as being mapped across a keyboard. Sounds can be subtly shaped or entirely transformed using the built-in effects and easy-to-use editing tools.
You can record a quantized or unquantized performance on the pads or keyboard. There is also a full piano roll where you can enter and edit notes and velocities.
Record knob movements or draw automation by hand to bring even more life to your sounds. Every automation lane can also have its own independent length, for polymetric and generative music possibilities.
Create up to 16 different sections for your song and drag and drop them into any order to create your arrangement.
Mixing and mastering tools allow you to finish a full track without ever leaving your phone. You can export your full track, or hit the tape icon and record the live output of the app while you tweak anything on the fly. Both options allow you to capture individual track stems as well!
A performance page lets you trigger your patterns live while controlling a global filter, assignable pitch bends and reverb sends, and a random fill generator.
Artist packs are available in-app at $3.99 or less, which include original sounds and projects from Andrew Huang, Cuckoo, Chuck Sutton, Kilamanzego, Pusher, and more on the way all the time.
Features:
- 9 track sampler
- 4 effects per track: Delay, Filter, Chorus, Bitcrush
- Graphic EQ per track
- Monophonic or up to 16-note polyphonic playback per sample
- Adjustable pitch, volume, playback direction, sample start and stop points
- Looping Envelope with forward, backward, both (ping pong) direction
- 19 automatable parameters per track
- Independent lengths for each automation lane
- Automation can be recorded via knob movements or drawn by hand
- Drum pad and keyboard input
- Full piano roll with 10 octaves, note velocity, editing tools
- Randomization over sample selection for quick inspiration
- Randomization over note position to create surprising variations
- Drag-and-drop song arrangement page
- Global reverb with individual track sends
- Mixing and mastering tools
- Powerful performance features for creating instant fills, pitch shifts, reverb sends, and global low or high pass filtering
- Export full track and stems
- Live recording of performances
- Metronome with tap tempo and swing/shuffle
- Ableton Link integration for easy syncing with other devices over WiFi 
- Share projects and sounds via AirDrop, email, etc.
- Undo and redo

bluejetty:00088062:ios.description:
Powering Every Match. Connecting Every Moment.
Powering more than 400,000 matches worldwide, IONSport is the leading live scoring and competition platform for racquet sports and the #1 app for college tennis scoring and stats. Trusted by 1,600+ college programs, IONSport powers competition from campus courts to international championships across 45 nations.
As the official mobile application for following Tennis Europe tournaments, IONSport provides access to tournament schedules, live matches, player rankings, draws, results, and real-time updates from one of the world's largest junior tennis networks.
More than a scoreboard, IONSport is your digital front-row seat to live scores, statistics, schedules, draws, rankings, standings, streaming, and tournament updates, all from one connected platform.
Whether you're a player, coach, parent, fan, official, or organizer, IONSport keeps you connected to every match and every moment.
TRUSTED WORLDWIDE
• 400,000+ matches powered
• Trusted by 1,600+ college programs
• Official Live Scoring and Data Partner of Tennis Europe
• Supporting 540+ Tennis Europe Junior Tour tournaments and team events annually
• Connected across 45 member nations and 300+ venues
• 1,000+ reviews with a 4.8-star rating
LIVE SCORING
Follow every point in real time with up-to-the-second scores and results.
MATCH SCORING AND STATS KEEPING
Score and track statistics for any match using official Chair Umpire Mode or Verified Crowd Scoring Mode, enabling real-time scoring across events of every size.
MULTI-SPORT SUPPORT
Follow and score matches across tennis, pickleball, padel, badminton, beach tennis, racquetball, squash, TYPTI, and table tennis.
LIVE STATISTICS
Access detailed match statistics and performance insights as the action unfolds.
SCORES, SCHEDULES & DRAWS
View schedules, draws, brackets, court assignments, and results in one place.
RANKINGS & STANDINGS
Track player rankings, team standings, tournament results, and season performance.
FOLLOW FAVORITES
Follow your favorite players, teams, schools, clubs, and tournaments.
TOURNAMENT HUBS
Access scores, standings, schedules, rankings, streaming, news, and event information from a single destination.
STREAMING INTEGRATION
Watch live matches and follow scores from one connected experience when streaming is available.
MATCH HISTORY
Review previous matches, results, and competition history anytime.
TOURNAMENT MANAGEMENT
Manage competitions from a single venue or across multiple sites with integrated scoring, scheduling, and tournament operations tools.
SOFTWARE INTEGRATIONS
Connect seamlessly with tournament management platforms to streamline event administration and reduce manual work.
BROADCAST & SCOREBOARD INTEGRATION
Deliver live scores and match data to broadcasts, websites, mobile apps, digital platforms, social media feeds, and in-venue scoreboards in real time.
SHAREABLE RESULTS
Easily share scores, results, and tournament updates with friends, family, and fans.
From local tournaments to international championships, IONSport powers competition and connects the global racquet sports community.
Download IONSport today and never miss a point.

bluejetty:00123797:ios.name: Complete Ear Trainer
bluejetty:00123797:ios.summary: The ultimate ear training app for musicians. Develop your relative pitch to the full by improving your aural skills and your music theory knowledge. This will better many aspects of your life as a musician, be it regarding improvisation, co
bluejetty:00123797:ios.description:
The ultimate ear training app for musicians. Develop your relative pitch to the full by improving your aural skills and your music theory knowledge. This will better many aspects of your life as a musician, be it regarding improvisation, composition, arrangement, interpretation, singing, or playing in a band. Designed like a video game and with strong pedagogical concepts in mind, this app will make you truly master each interval, chord, scale, etc. before taking you to the next one.
Features
• 150+ progressive drills arranged over 4 levels / 28 chapters
• 11 drill types, 24 intervals, 36 chord types, chord inversions, 28 scale types, melodic dictations, chord progressions
• Easy mode: 50+ progressive drills arranged over 12 chapters especially designed for beginners
• Play a selection of 21 drills in arcade mode
• 5 octaves of actual recorded grand piano sounds
• 7 additional sound banks are available, all with actual recorded sounds: vintage piano, Rhodes piano, electric guitar, harpsichord, concert harp, strings and pizzicato strings
• In each chapter, a theory card will introduce you to the concepts you will need to know
• No need to know how to read music on a staff
• Designed like a video game: earn 3 stars in each drill of a chapter to unlock the next one. Or will you be able to obtain perfect 5-star scores?
• Don't want to follow the preestablished path of progression? Create and save your own custom drills and rehearse them at your own convenience
• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards
• Never lose any progress: cloud sync across your various devices
• 25 achievements to unlock
• Worldwide leaderboards (global, per level, per chapter, easy mode, arcade mode)
• Global statistics to track your progress
• Nice and clean user interface with 2 display themes: light and dark
• Designed by a musician and music teacher with a Royal Conservatory master's degree
Full Version
• Download the app and try out the first chapter of each mode for free
• One-time in-app purchase to unlock the full version on all your devices
Having a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at hello@completeeartrainer.com
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00015590:ios.description:
Planner is an easy to use companion app for existing users of Platinum Planner. Students and preceptors can complete documentation from anywhere! Even offline without an internet connection!
Planner is for EMS, Allied Health and Nursing Professions, it provides online skill tracking, scheduling, reporting and much more!
Student Features:
Clinical Opportunities
- View, sign up for and create clinical opportunities.
- Document a clinical opportunity including entering time, notes, preceptor information, and patient information.
- Complete any associated forms.
- Upload images from your camera and attach them to an opportunity.
- Click on the PIN icon to open clinical sites in location aware applications like maps or driving apps.
- Ability for a preceptor to give a digital signature right from the app!
Labs
- View, sign up for and create labs.
- View upcoming labs, document current labs, or review documentation from completed labs.
- When documenting labs, students will be able to document their skills and complete any forms associated with the lab.
- Peer review other classmates labs.
- Upload images from your mobile devices camera.
Scenarios
- Peer review other classmates scenarios.
- Review completed scenarios.
Preceptor Features:
Training
- View and complete training in the app.
- Upload documents to your training.
Student Documentation Review
- Review and complete student documentation.
- Return student documentation.
- Upload additional documents/images to student documentation.
- Sign off using your signature on student documentation.
- Preview student documentation during the student's shift.
- Manage students from multiple schools.
Other Features:
- Option to work offline then sync data when you have an internet connection available.
- Sync upcoming opportunities and labs directly to your calendar.
- View current classes along with their details.
- Sign up for any additional classes available for your course.
- View your progress report and see your overall skill status of your course.
- Badge notifications showing the total number of labs, scenarios, opportunities, and items which need to be sync'd.

The term "law" often refers to a set of regulations that are established and upheld by social or governmental institutions in order to control conduct. However, its exact definition is still up for debate. Both a science and an art have been used to describe it. Statutes can be created by a group of legislators or a single lawmaker; the administration can issue decrees and regulations; or judges can set precedent, mainly in common law jurisdictions. Private individuals have the power to enact legally binding agreements, such as arbitration clauses that substitute alternative dispute resolution procedures for traditional court action. A constitution, whether written or implied, and the rights enshrined within may have an impact on the laws as they are being made. The law influences politics, economy, history, and society in a variety of ways and mediates interpersonal conflicts.

bluejetty:00074447:ios.description:
Justin Agustin workout videos and routines made for people who haven't exercised in a long time, or ever. It's a more realistic way to begin your journey. The routines are made for absolute beginners. The best part: do it from the comfort of your home.
Just press play and follow along!
Enjoy premium unlimited content from the comfort of your home. There’s something for every level and every goal.
-No fancy gym equipment required. 
-Workout from your living room.
-Watch, Listen, and Follow Along to full-length workout videos.
-Comprehensive schedule with rest days included.
-Modified exercises for beginners.
-Recipes and Beginner Nutrition guide included.
Your Coach :
Justin Agustin is a certified personal trainer and coach specialized in fitness for true beginners. He helps beginners start their fitness no matter their level of fitness. He's been featured by popular brands like Buzzfeed, TED, Nifty, Popsugar, Askmen, and Glam, and made television appearances on CityNews, and Global Morning News. Samples of his work can be found on Instagram and TikTok. With a combined following of over 2 Million across various platforms. Justin Agustin's courses are quickly becoming the new standard to beginner fitness.
Justin Agustin Fitness includes Apple Watch
- you can track your workouts and meet your fitness goals.
- Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player.
- HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app.
- FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats, share your activity, and get those Activity Rings!
- Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts.
- Install using iPhone: Install app on iPhone, open Watch app, select "Show on Apple Watch".
Justin Agustin Workout offers an auto-renewing Monthly Subscription.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
For information on our privacy policy or terms of service, you can go to:
https://justinagustinfitnesscourses.uscreen.io/pages/privacy-policy
https://justinagustinfitnesscourses.uscreen.io/pages/terms-and-conditions

Battle for the Galaxy is a real-time space MMO game in
bluejetty:00185896:ios.description:
Who will win this epic war to determine the fate of the galaxy? Take control of your forces, build bases and fight for your very survival in this real-time pvp military strategy game.
Battle for the Galaxy is a real-time space MMO game in which you have to build your base, create an army, attack enemies, earn medals (if you battle well), and steal enemy resources. The gameplay features futuristic robots and buildings and beautiful 3D graphics. 
To start with, you must build up your economy and create buildings to improve your resource generation. Once you have created resource gathering structures you can look to building an army and upgrading your tech.
Using the troops you build you can attack enemy bases to steal their resources an earn XP. Make sure you build a variety of different troops to take on the enemy walls, defences and structures. For example, standard foot soldiers can soak up damage whereas grenadiers need cover and are perfect for shooting at defence turrets. Continue to upgrade your buildings, gather resources and create an impressive and varied army. Can you conquer the galaxy?
Features
● PvP with elements of tower defense
● Participate in every imaginable kind of wars and get great prizes: win the Leagues, Tournaments, duels and Raids!
● Real-time base management, craft modules for defenses and technologies
● Gather resources and build a strong base with defences
● Research troops and create an impressive army of battle robots
● Fight against other enemies for supremacy
● Outstanding art and visuals of armies and world
● Use hacks and technology to breach through defenses
● Battle royale mode for 10 players

bluejetty:00083104:ios.description:
Would you like to exercise your brain? 
Challenge by guessing the word from simple emojis!
A fun puzzle word game that challenges you to guess the word. The only hint you have is the emojis. Sometimes it can be more challenging than you thought.
Welcome to our emoji puzzle game, where you can immerse yourself in the fun and addictive world of matching emojis to progress through levels. With over 1000 levels to play through, there is no shortage of puzzles to solve. And with regular updates and new content, there is always something new to discover.
Our game is optimized for mobile devices, so you can enjoy it on-the-go. Whether you are commuting to work, waiting in line at the grocery store, or just need a break from your daily routine, our emoji puzzle game is the perfect way to relax and unwind.
The game is easy to learn but challenging to master. To progress through levels, you will need to match up emojis of the same type. As you progress, the levels become more challenging, with new obstacles and objectives to overcome. But don't worry, you can earn power-ups and boosters to help you along the way.
One of the best things about our emoji puzzle game is that it is completely free to download and play. There are no hidden fees or in-app purchases, so you can enjoy the game without worrying about spending any money. However, if you do want to support us, we do offer a few optional purchases that can enhance your gameplay experience.
Our game is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels. Whether you are a casual player or a hardcore gamer, our game has something for everyone. And because it is a puzzle game, it is also a great way to exercise your brain. Studies have shown that playing puzzle games can improve cognitive function and memory, so you can feel good about playing our game.
In addition to being fun and addictive, our game is also visually appealing. The bright and colorful emojis are sure to bring a smile to your face, and the animations and sound effects add an extra layer of excitement to the game.
But that's not all! Our game also features a variety of gameplay modes to keep things fresh and exciting. In addition to the classic matching mode, we also have a time attack mode, where you race against the clock to complete puzzles as quickly as possible. And for players who want an extra challenge, we have a hard mode, where the levels are even more difficult.
Our game also has a social component. You can connect with friends and compete against each other for the highest scores. And if you are feeling particularly competitive, you can even participate in tournaments for a chance to win prizes.
So what are you waiting for? Download our emoji puzzle game today and start matching up those emojis! With endless levels, exciting gameplay modes, and a social component, you won't be able to put it down.

bluejetty:00013899:ios.name: ArcSite: Quick CAD Floor Plans
bluejetty:00013899:ios.summary: ArcSite is the perfect CAD sketch and design tool for all levels, from beginners sketching out floor plans to experienced professionals taking on complex projects. No matter your experience, ArcSite puts intuitive CAD within everyone's reac
bluejetty:00013899:ios.description:
ArcSite is the perfect CAD sketch and design tool for all levels, from beginners sketching out floor plans to experienced professionals taking on complex projects. No matter your experience, ArcSite puts intuitive CAD within everyone's reach.
ArcSite goes beyond design: start with a drawing to capture data, calculate material quantities, and instantly create estimates and job reports in one place.
Once you’re finished drawing with ArcSite’s floor plan creator, you can easily share and collaborate on projects, generate professional proposals, material lists, and estimates, and accept payments from anywhere.
INTUITIVE CAD SKETCH & DRAWING TOOLS FOR ROOM & HOUSE DESIGN
- *AI Trace: Sketch it, scan it, see your space. Turn a hand sketch, photo, or PDF into an editable, to-scale floor plan. *only available for iPad; iPhone features coming soon
- Advanced 2D CAD-level precision without the CAD learning curve.
- Create CAD floor plans from a map: Start a new drawing using a satellite image as your base. Enter an address to find a location, then zoom in or out to set boundaries; the scale will be set automatically.
- Designed for everyone: Easy for first-time users, precise enough for professionals.
- Export, Cloud sync, and collaborate: Your room design drawings export to PNG/PDF/DXF/DWG, save to the cloud, and (for professional users) flow directly into material takeoffs, estimates, and signed proposals.
- Send proposals: Access Proposal Generation (based on your drawing).
- Communicate visual context: Add location-based photos with markup to highlight project issues instantly for teams or customers.
WORK FASTER & STAY ORGANIZED WITH FIELD-LEVEL PRECISION
- Keep all of your project details in one place.
- Customize products, forms, material types, quantity calculations, and pricing to match your data requirements.
- Our mobile CAD app offers unmatched accuracy, whether with exact-to-scale drawings or quantities of materials and pricing.
- Draw to scale with confidence: Our mobile CAD app makes it easy to get accurate measurements and pricing, every time.
- Security - SOC 2 Type II compliant and ISO/IEC 27001 certified.
SMART FEATURES FOR CAD FLOOR PLANS
- *AR Room Scanner: Scan a room or space with your phone or iPad camera and get a scaled floor plan placed directly in the drawing canvas, no manual measuring. *only for Apple Pro devices
- Smart Shapes and parametric objects: Walls, doors, windows, and shapes can snap into place, auto-count, and adjust as you draw or resize.
- Quick-start template gallery: Pre-built templates save you time.
WHO USES ARCSITE?
- Sales Teams
- Residential Contractors
- Fencing Pros
- Foundation Repair Experts
- Designers, Architects
- Creative Homeowners
- Remodeling Pros
- Inspectors
- Auditors
- General Contractors
- And more
WHAT ARE PEOPLE SAYING ABOUT ARCSITE?
"I haven't found anything else that comes close to meeting my needs. With ArcSite I save hours on every estimate. Very easy to make accurate and professional-looking drawings, while on-site." - Colin, from JES Foundation Repair
"In my opinion, there is no better program for our line of work, we will be much more productive in the long term." - Paul from Johnson Controls
TERMS
Free 14-day trial on all plans
Terms of Service: https://www.arcsite.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/184541
To continue using ArcSite after your trial, purchase a monthly or annual subscription plan (Draw Basic, Draw Pro, Takeoff, or Estimate). Each tier offers different features; details are in-app.
AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION INFO
* Payment charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
* Subscription renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the current period ends
* Renewal charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period
* Manage subscriptions or turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase
* Unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon subscription purchase

bluejetty:00022690:ios.summary: Mockup helps you sketch, wireframe, and prototype apps and websites across iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Built specifically for UI/UX design and Apple Pencil, Mockup combines a flexible canvas with reusable UI elements and interactive prototypes i
bluejetty:00022690:ios.description:
Mockup helps you sketch, wireframe, and prototype apps and websites across iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Built specifically for UI/UX design and Apple Pencil, Mockup combines a flexible canvas with reusable UI elements and interactive prototypes in one seamless workflow.
Featured by Apple and recognized as App of the Day, Mockup is trusted by 500,000+ designers, developers, and product teams worldwide to sketch and wireframe interfaces faster.
Design interfaces for mobile, tablet, desktop, watch, TV, and the web.
- Sketch naturally with Apple Pencil using versatile drawing tools and a complete color palette.
- Work with 45+ device frames in portrait and landscape.
- Draw perfect shapes with Shape Detection and Snap to Grid for cleaner layouts.
- Write and edit text directly on the canvas using Scribble.
- Customize grids, frames, and backgrounds to match your workflow.
Build Better Wireframes
- Use ready-to-use UI elements or create, save, and reuse your own custom element sets.
- Add text, images, shapes, and over 4,000 SF Symbols.
- Save reusable text styles for a consistent design system.
- Drag and drop text or images directly from other apps.
Prototype User Flows
- Connect screens to create interactive flows.
- Preview prototypes in full-screen mode.
- Validate navigation and user experience before development.
Export, Share & Continue Anywhere
- Export high-quality PDF and PNG files.
- Share Mockup files with other users.
- Collaborate in real time using SharePlay.
- Sync sketches and projects across iPad, iPhone, and Mac with iCloud.
- Access recent sketches and preview your work from Home Screen widgets.
Optimized for Apple Pencil & iPad
- Use Apple Pencil Hover to preview and switch drawing tools with greater precision and control.
- Use Apple Pencil Pro squeeze to access canvas controls, adjust tools, select objects, or undo and redo actions.
- Enjoy a desktop-class experience with external keyboard and trackpad support.
- Work across multiple windows for greater productivity.
Start creating for free with unlimited sketches and projects, or unlock the complete Mockup experience with Mockup Studio.
Mockup Studio includes:
- All device frames
- Interactive prototypes
- Unlimited custom element sets
- Exclusive UI elements
- Shape Detection
- 4,000+ customizable SF Symbols
- Watermark-free PDF export
- PNG export
- Nested projects
- Priority support
Terms of Service:
https://apprime.studio/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy:
https://apprime.studio/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00141393:ios.description:
Compress and resize your photos in seconds — without losing quality.
With Image Compressor & Resizer, you can instantly reduce file sizes, adjust photo dimensions for any purpose, and keep your gallery organized. Perfect for saving storage space, sharing images online, and optimizing photos for the web.
Key Features:
- Compress Photos: Reduce the file size of your images while keeping them sharp and clear.
- Resize Pictures: Adjust photo dimensions to fit social media, websites, or any other requirement.
- Batch Processing: Save time by compressing and resizing multiple photos at once.
- Preview & Compare: See the results side by side before saving.
- Multiple Formats: Supports popular image formats like JPEG and PNG.
- Simple Interface: Designed for speed and ease of use, even for beginners.
Who Is It For?
Whether you’re a photographer optimizing your work, a content creator preparing visuals, or just someone who wants to free up space on your device, Image Compressor & Resizer makes managing your photos quick and effortless.

- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00163094:ios.description:
Con la aplicación de LA NACIÓN accedé a noticias confiables, investigación profunda y el análisis de nuestros columnistas para entender lo que pasa en la Argentina y el mundo.
La descarga de la aplicación es gratuita, pero para leer las notas y acceder a todas las funciones debes contar con una suscripción digital.
Siendo suscriptor digital disfruta de las siguientes funciones:
- Recibí las notificaciones de las noticias y acontecimientos más importantes al instante.
- Administrá tus newsletters, recibiendo los que más te interesen y accede a contenido exclusivo.
- Escuchá las notas de tu interés.
- Guardá artículos para leerlos más tarde.
- Seguí a los autores de LA NACION, para acceder a sus notas recientes de forma rápida.
- Comentá las notas y debatí con otros lectores.
- Elegí la apariencia de la app según tu preferencia (modo oscuro o claro).
- Ajustá el tamaño de las letras de las notas para una lectura más placentera.
- Enterate de eventos exclusivos para suscriptores y registrate para disfrutarlos.
- Escuchá las noticias interactuando con la app desde la pantalla de tu auto, gracias a la compatibilidad con Carplay.
- Agregá en la pantalla de tu celular un Widget de la LN, dónde encontrarás las notas principales de la sección que vos elijas (Hoy, Política, Economía y muchas más).

bluejetty:00184271:ios.name: BenefitPay
bluejetty:00184271:ios.summary:
BenefitPay is an app that allows users to pay and transfer funds only by using their smart devices in Bahrain in a fast, secure, and convenient manner. BenefitPay features include:
· Enrolling your payment instruments (Cards & Accounts).
bluejetty:00184271:ios.description:
BenefitPay is an app that allows users to pay and transfer funds only by using their smart devices in Bahrain in a fast, secure, and convenient manner. BenefitPay features include:
· Enrolling your payment instruments (Cards & Accounts).
· Transfer funds instantly from one bank account to another using Fawri+ service by either entering IBAN, or a registered mobile number, as well as by scanning QR Code.
· Paying using your mobile in Bahrain through scanning QR code generated by merchants within the app’s merchant network.
· Bill Payment through Fawateer service to hundreds of biller.
· Split Payment and request payment options that allows you to request payment from multiple payer, so it shall allow to split the dinner bill among friends and family.
· Review and track your transactions history.
· Manage your cards and Bank Accounts in the Application
· To pay for fuel at petrol stations using geo-location via Sadeem feature
. Transfer Internationally via Remittence feature through our partners
. Electronic Cheque (e-Cheque) issuance, deposit, and management
To register, download the application and enter a valid mobile number. Upon entry of the verification code that will be sent by SMS you will be enrolled and you can start adding your payment instruments.
For Any Inquires or Issues please contact us on:
customerservice@benefit.bh
or
13300300
This app is introduced to Bahrain by The BENEFIT Company. The BENEFIT company was established by 17 commercial banks in November 1997 as the national ATM and Point of Sale switch of Bahrain. Today, it foresees Bahrain’s global position in the future of banking in the region. BENEFIT is determined to provide the banking community with top-notch services that can compete on a global scale. The BENEFIT Company provides a wide array of services in the kingdom of Bahrain and in GCC region such as switch service, electronic funds transfer system EFTS, Credit Reference Bureau, Bahrain Cheque Truncation system, Payment Gateway and much more. Visit our website on benefit.bh for more information about our company

bluejetty:00082394:ios.description:
Wellframe helps you feel in control of your health by connecting you to care right on your iPhone or iPad. You can send a private message at any time to your care team - it's as easy as texting, but more secure. Your care team will create a personal daily checklist for you with helpful articles, videos, and things to do. The more tasks you check off, the more your care team can customize your program for you.
Set reminders to help remember your medications and appointments, and track your steps and progress over time. You’ll learn what to expect and feel better supported as you go.
Wellframe takes your privacy and security seriously and is fully HIPAA-compliant.
Wellframe is always free for users - just sign up with the access code you received from your sponsoring provider or company.
Wellframe works with Apple Health for certain care programs, such as those that provide a step count task.
Seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions. This app is designed for education and to provide support between provider visits. If you're enrolled in an eligible care program you may connect a glucometer to share readings with your care management team, but should continue to check with your doctor before making any changes to diet, exercise, or treatment plan.

bluejetty:00024213:ios.description:
• Authentic, lush, and organic chorus effect
• True analog-style bucket brigade circuitry
• A modern reissue of the most iconic hardware units
• Ranges from subtle doubling to rich, swirling modulation
• Versatile usage: Chorus, Flanger, or Vibrato
• Expanded controls with multiple characters and waveforms
• Feedback control for rich, flanger-like textures
• A favorite chorus in the iOS music community
• Advanced Responsive Design, portrait and landscape views
• Universal Purchase: AUv3 for iOS (iPad/iPhone), macOS and Vision Pro
FAC Chorus brings depth and movement to your sounds with an authentic, lush, and organic character. Built with true analog-style bucket brigade circuitry, this plugin is a modern reissue of some of the most iconic hardware units, faithfully capturing their distinctive tone.
The effect ranges from subtle doubling to rich, swirling modulation, covering different uses as a Chorus, Flanger, or Vibrato. The expanded modulation controls, multiple characters, and LFO waveforms allow precise shaping of your sound, giving you complete creative flexibility. In addition, the feedback control adds rich, flanger-like textures for dynamic sonic effects.
Under the hood, the plugin uses two individual delay line paths. Each path’s behavior is determined by the character parameter: Thick and BBD provide warm, classic BBD-style tones, while Clean delivers a more transparent tone with greater modulation.
This chorus has become a favorite in the iOS music community, combining vintage inspiration with modern control to deliver professional-quality sound in any production.
This is an AUv3 Effect and requires a compatible host to work
The in-app purchases are for tipping only, the app is fully functional without them
The documentation is available at fredantoncorvest.com/FAC_Chorus.html

Take control of your life with Sober Day, the ultimate app designed to help you quit or reduce your alcohol consumption. Whether you're aiming to stop drinking entirely or looking to cut back, Sober Day provides you with the tools, support, and motivation you need every step of the way.
Key Features:
• Daily Tasks: Engage in daily activities that support your goal to quit or reduce alcohol intake, helping you build healthier habits.
• Motivational Reminders: Receive inspiring messages and encouragement to keep you focused and motivated on your journey.
• Consumption Tracking: Easily log your daily alcohol intake and monitor your progress over time with intuitive tracking tools.
• Progress Counters and Trackers: Visualize your progress with counters that show how long you've been sober or how much you've reduced your drinking.
• Personal Insights and Statistics: Gain valuable insights into your drinking patterns and behaviors with detailed statistics and personal analytics.
• Goal Setting: Set and achieve personal goals tailored to your journey, whether it's reducing the number of drinks per week or extending your sober days.
• Relaxation and Coping Techniques: Access a variety of relaxation exercises and coping strategies to manage cravings and stress without alcohol.
• Educational Articles: Learn from a library of articles that provide tips, advice, and information on overcoming alcohol dependence and maintaining a healthier lifestyle.
• Customizable Notifications: Stay on track with customizable notifications that remind you of your goals and celebrate your milestones.

bluejetty:00136069:ios.description:
Spicer is a couples app designed to help partners discover new intimacy ideas and explore their desires together.
Through interactive questions, intimacy challenges, and shared matches, Spicer helps couples openly communicate about intimacy and discover what they both want to try.
If you want to bring more excitement, curiosity, and connection into your intimate life, Spicer makes it simple and fun.
• HOW DOES IT WORK?
- Both partners install Spicer and link with each other.
- Both partners answer same questions with "Yes", "Maybe", "No".
- When both partners answer Yes or Maybe, the idea becomes a Match.
Matches reveal ideas you both want to explore together.
Anything answered No by either partner stays hidden.
This makes it easy to discover new experiences while keeping everything comfortable and private.
Spicer also includes multiple choice and open ended questions.
• THOUSANDS OF QUESTIONS
Spicer includes a large collection of intimacy questions for couples designed to inspire new ideas and playful exploration.
Question packs are available in multiple languages:
English, German, Russian, French, Portuguese, Spanish, and Dutch.
• CHALLENGES
Turn your Matches into exciting intimacy challenges.
A challenge randomly selects a Match that both partners agreed to.
Once accepted, you have 24 hours to complete it together.
It's a fun way to bring spontaneity and excitement into your intimate life.
• PLAYFUL DARES
Send playful intimacy dares to your partner.
Choose from existing dares or create your own to keep things exciting and surprising.
• PRIVATE CHAT FOR COUPLES
Spicer includes private chat so you and your partner can discuss Matches and share photos.
There are no public chats and no strangers — only you and your partner.
• AI FEATURES 
Set any Match for the next AI surprise and receive safe and fun instructions for your couple from AI. 
• INTIMACY TRACKER & CALENDAR
Track your intimate moments with the Intimacy Tracker.
Add events to your calendar, view statistics, and share them with your partner.
• WISHLIST
Save ideas you’re curious about and share them with your partner through your Wishlist.
• ADD YOUR OWN QUESTIONS
Create custom questions or build your own question packs for a fully personalized experience.
• PRIVATE & ANONYMOUS
You don’t need to provide personal information to use Spicer.
You can optionally create an account to save your answers if you reinstall the app.
• FREE & PREMIUM FEATURES
Spicer is free to download and includes many free questions.
Spicer Plus unlocks additional features:
- Unlimited access to advanced packs
- New Plus packs
- Select any Match as your next challenge
- Customize or pause challenge timers
- Vote for your favorite packs
Subscription options:
• 1 Month
• 1 Year
• PLEASE NOTE
Spicer is free to download, and all users can access a wide variety of content from free packs. Subscribers get full access to the all advanced and plus packs and premium features with a monthly or yearly subscription.
You will be automatically charged 24-hours before the end of your trial period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period.
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month or year 24-hours before the end of the current period, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
For full Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service: https://spicer.app/terms.php 
If you are having technical issues or have any questions about packs, we're here to help. Please send us an email to: help@spicer.app

Aplikacja Empik gwarantuje
bluejetty:00069937:ios.description:
Pobierz aplikację i otrzymaj nawet 200 zł w postaci czterech kuponów, do wykorzystania na pierwsze zakupy w aplikacji. Ponadto skorzystaj z ponad 400 000 produktów z niższymi cenami dostępnymi tylko z aplikacją.
Aplikacja Empik gwarantuje szybki dostęp do ponad dwóch milionów produktów w Twoim telefonie. Są podzielone na kilkanaście kategorii produktowych, by możliwe było bezproblemowe odnalezienie interesującej pozycji. Kupuj, przeglądaj, sprawdzaj jednym kliknięciem! Z aplikacją Empik zawsze otrzymujesz specjalne oferty dedykowane dla Ciebie, atrakcyjne zniżki, możliwość dostawy zamówienia pod Twoje drzwi lub do wybranego salonu Empik.
Aplikacja Empik podsunie Ci najlepsze możliwe rozwiązania, wspierając zakupy offline! Jest intuicyjna w obsłudze, dlatego stanie się Twoim najlepszym możliwym doradcą, podczas przeszukiwania pozycji filmowych, muzycznych, książkowych. Śledź aktualne bestsellery, sprawdzaj zapowiedzi, nowości książkowe, wykorzystuj okazje i zdobywaj zniżki. Z aplikacją Empik masz to wszystko pod ręką w swoim telefonie!
Oszczędzaj czas i pieniądze! Przekonaj się o ogromie zalet, jakie daje kupowanie online. Dostęp do elektroniki, artykułów dla domu i ogrodu, zabawek, kosmetyków i wiele więcej, jeszcze nigdy nie był tak prosty! Z aplikacją Empik podejmiesz wyłącznie trafne decyzje, odnajdziesz wymarzone prezenty, będziesz na bieżąco z nowościami, a darmowa dostawa do salonu Empik pozwoli Ci dodatkowo zaoszczędzić.
Przeglądaj tysiące pozycji w dowolnym miejscu! Z aplikacją Empik możesz robić zakupy w niedziele, wybrać dostawę do punktów odbioru i w krótkim czasie cieszyć się wymarzoną pozycją. To coś więcej niż sklep online - Empik app to inspiracje zakupowe, Twój prywatny doradca, który przekazuje wyłącznie sprawdzone propozycje, dopasowane do Twojego indywidualnego gustu.
Program Empik Premium to kolejny plus posiadania aplikacji. Dzięki niemu otrzymujesz zniżki na wybrane produkty, oferty specjalne dopasowane do Twoich zainteresowań. Aplikacja zapamiętuje Twoje zakupy, nie musisz gromadzić paragonów - jeśli zechcesz zwrócić jakiś produkt, wystarczy przekazać kartę sprzedawcy. Empik Premium to także dostęp do najciekawszych wydarzeń, najgłośniejszych premier książkowych, muzycznych, filmowych i wiele więcej! Już żadne widowisko Cię nie ominie. Co więcej, możesz dowolnie układać listy prezentów zarówno dla siebie, jak i dla swoich bliskich, skanować telefonem książki, filmy, płyty, gry i tworzyć własne wirtualne biblioteczki, którymi możesz dzielić się w sieci.
Z aplikacją Empik bez problemu zamówisz interesujące Cię pozycje z dostawą do domu lub jednego z wybranych salonów Empik zupełnie za darmo! Nie trać czasu na szukanie książek, filmów, muzyki, gier stacjonarnie - rób zakupy online za pomocą kilku kliknięć w dowolnym miejscu i porze! Do wyboru masz setki punktów odbioru w całej Polsce, oferty Marketplace i miliony produktów - gry komputerowe, elektronika, książki, płyty, filmy, gry i wiele więcej!
Zyskasz:
- zniżki na specjalnie wybrane dla Ciebie produkty,
- bieżące informacje o nowościach i wydarzeniach kulturalnych - dopasowane do Twojego indywidualnego gustu,
- możliwość zwrotu produktów bez paragonu w ciągu 30 dni,
- możliwość sprawdzenia dostępności produktów w najbliższym salonie,
- opcje rezerwowania produktu i możliwość jego odbioru tego samego dnia,
- darmowa dostawa do salonu lub rezerwacja z odbiorem w salonie już po 2 godzinach.
- dostęp do oferty Marketplace z czołowymi sprzedawcami, jak Tagomago, Janshop, Meble Akord, B-Elektronik, Trena, Topeshop.
Dodatkowo, korzystając z aplikacji Empik, wspierasz biblioteki szkolne każdym zakupem!
Postaw na szybkość działania aplikacji, wygodę, intuicyjność obsługi, dostarczanie specjalnie wyselekcjonowanych, spersonalizowanych treści, które stuprocentowo trafią w Twój gust. Kupuj taniej z aplikacją Empik i ciesz się wyjątkowymi promocjami, jakie oferuje program Empik Premium!

bluejetty:00043812:ios.description:
Crie e gerencie sua loja virtual de qualquer lugar. A Bagy é uma plataforma de e-commerce com tudo o que você precisa para iniciar, gerenciar, crescer seu negócio e vender muito na internet. 
Com a Bagy você configura sua loja virtual em três passos simples:
1. Cadastre seus produtos. 
2. Escolha o tema e edite o visual da sua loja. 
3. Configure meios de pagamento e envio.
Seu e-commerce pronto para vender em poucos cliques e com design profissional. Confira todas as possibilidades que a Bagy te oferece:
PERFORMANCE E ESTABILIDADE NA PALMA DA SUA MÃO
- Plataforma com estrutura robusta que te garante ainda mais estabilidade.
- Tecnologia Elasticsearch que permite que os dados, produtos e páginas do seu site sejam processados em milissegundos.
- Checkout de alta conversão, sem necessidade de fazer login e com possibilidade de incluir gatilhos para o cliente fechar a compra.
PERSONALIZE O VISUAL DA SUA LOJA PELO CELULAR
- Tema gratuito e loja de temas exclusivos.
- Ajuste fontes, cores e inclua a logo da sua empresa.
- Configure a navegação, crie landing pages e blog. 
TENHA FERRAMENTAS DE MARKETING PARA VENDER EM DIVERSOS CANAIS
- Venda com a sacolinha do Instagram (Instagram Shopping) e com o Google Shopping.
- Ferramentas de marketing, como cupons, compre e ganhe, order bumper, frete grátis, brinde no carrinho e muito mais.
- Faça ações de marketing e promoções dentro da plataforma. 
- Integração com diversos marketplaces, como Mercado Livre e Shopee.
GERENCIE SEUS PRODUTOS DE FORMA FÁCIL
- Carregue as fotos 
- Inclua os preços e descrições com ajuda de inteligência virtual.
- Defina categorias e atributos. 
- Monitore o estoque. 
CONFIGURE MEIOS DE PAGAMENTO E ENVIO EM MINUTOS
- Taxa zero utilizando Vindi.
- Frete mais barato nos Correios e em várias transportadoras com o Melhor Envio.
- Ofereça formas seguras de pagamento para o cliente: cartão, boleto e pix.
- Recupere todas as suas vendas com ações de carrinho abandonado via e-mail, Messenger e WhatsApp.
FAÇA A GESTÃO DOS SEUS CLIENTES E MONITORE SUAS VENDAS
- Tenha acesso a diversas ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente. 
- Acompanhe seus pedidos em tempo real. 
- Diversos relatórios de vendas, marketing, clientes e produtos em um só lugar.
SOBRE A BAGY:
Com o app da Bagy é fácil começar a vender na internet apenas com o celular, de onde, como e quando você quiser. É o seu e-commerce na palma da mão. 
Desde 2017 a Bagy ajuda lojistas na criação e gerenciamento de suas lojas virtuais. Mais de 20 mil empreendedores já tiraram seus sonhos do papel com a Bagy. 
A Bagy é recomendada pelas maiores empresárias do Brasil! Sabrina Nunes, da Francisca Joias, maior e-commerce de acessórios do país, Lívia Vasconcellos, da Lojinha da Lívia, e-commerce de papelaria mais importante do segmento, e Júlia Galvão, da Ambrô, grande sucesso na categoria de moda, usam e recomendam a Bagy de olhos fechados. 
Com a Bagy é possível integrar a loja virtual a diversas ferramentas de atendimento, gestão, logística, pagamento e marketing para potencializar as vendas e levar novos clientes para o seu site, tudo do seu celular. Além disso, você conta com o melhor suporte do país, reconhecido e indicado pelo Prêmio Reclame Aqui.
A Bagy tem tudo o que você precisa para criar, gerenciar, crescer seu negócio e vender muito na internet.

The rules are simple, but the flow is mesmerizing.
Game Features:

So tap along, find your rhythm, and let the colors flow.
Rope Loop Puzzle!! will unwind your stress—one tap at a time.
