bluejetty:00120028:ios.name: Daily TSP
bluejetty:00120028:ios.summary: The latest TSP share price data is provided to you everyday! Daily TSP provides a beautiful set of interactive charts that automatically update each day and allow you to look through the entire TSP share price history for any fund. Daily TS
bluejetty:00120028:ios.description:
The latest TSP share price data is provided to you everyday! Daily TSP provides a beautiful set of interactive charts that automatically update each day and allow you to look through the entire TSP share price history for any fund. Daily TSP also aggregates tons of reference fund information in an easy to navigate and interactive manner.
Daily TSP offers a clean user experience and customization capability that result in a personalized way to interact with and analyze TSP data at your finger tips.
##############################
Frequently Asked Questions
##############################
Do I have to link my TSP account? 
Daily TSP DOES NOT REQUIRE you to link your TSP account in order to use the app. There is tons of data and capability that is available to all users to help track/analyze the TSP funds without linking. Further, users can even perform manual account balance entries if they prefer and still want a way to track their TSP account balance. Linking your account serves as a convenient and secure means of tracking your TSP account, but is entirely optional within Daily TSP.
Is Daily TSP secure?
Daily TSP takes security very seriously and therefore abides by the latest security standards and protocols. Further, Daily TSP also allows for a four-digit pin code or biometric authentication (face unlock/fingerprint) to be required each time the app is opened for enhanced security - optional feature. Linked account credentials for fetching your TSP account data are stored DIRECTLY on your phone using its secure storage protocol.
How does Daily TSP store app data?
100% of all personal user data generated in Daily TSP is stored directly on your phone's storage and is NEVER shared with any cloud services or stored anywhere on the cloud. This means that you and only you can see and access the data within Daily TSP.
Can I contact the developers directly?
Absolutely. We try to make this as easy as possible and allow you to contact us directly from within the app! Give it a try!
##############################
On top of all that, Daily TSP also provides a great alternative for monitoring your personal TSP account balance and history over time!
 - Users can track their account balance through manual entries
 - Users can also link their TSP.gov account and automatically perform these updates.
- User can track an unlimited number of accounts with Pro version which means you can track Uniformed Services and Civilian accounts in one place!
Daily TSP Linked Account:
 - One tap to begin account update - that's all it takes!
 - Full account balance history to date
 - Personal Investment Performance (PIP) computation
 - Account activity summary tables
 - Balance distribution graphs
 - Contribution allocation graphs
 - Future predicted growth
 - Capability to track general purpose and residential loans 
 - Capability to track TSP transactions
 - Calculation of rate of return, Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), PIP, and other helpful metrics for various date ranges
Daily TSP Capabilities:
- iOS home screen widgets to get live share prices and account balance estimate
- Browse through all full TSP fund historical data
- Create custom TSP balance goals
- Ability to show/hide certain funds
- Ability to export user data to a CSV
- Enhanced security with pin code access and biometric authorization
Daily TSP provides direct feedback access to the developer to do everything from report an issue, request a feature, to just say hello. Whatever it is, just drop a line!
##############################
Disclaimer:
The Daily TSP app is not affiliated with the United States Government, The Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board or the Thrift Savings Plan, and that the service being offered is not sanctioned by the United States Government, the Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board or the Thrift Savings Plan.

Whether you’re practicing movements, reviewing footage, creating seamless loops,
bluejetty:00071378:ios.description:
Looper is a powerful video utility designed to loop, organize, and export videos on iPhone and iPad — both on your device and on compatible external displays.
Whether you’re practicing movements, reviewing footage, creating seamless loops, or preparing video content for presentations or installations, Looper gives you precise control over how videos repeat and play.
Core Features
• Loop any video a specific number of times or infinitely
• Repeat videos smoothly for practice, training, or analysis
• Create video playlists with individual loop settings per video
• Continuous playback with precise loop control
• Play videos on your device or on supported external displays (AirPlay / adapters)
• Export single videos or full playlists with repetitions applied
• Export looping videos in reverse, slow motion, fast motion, or GIF format
• Import videos from Photos, Files, or iCloud Drive
Note: External display support depends on iOS limitations, compatible cables, adapters, or AirPlay. Some configurations may not be supported by Apple.
Designed for Real Use Cases
• Practice dance, sports, or workouts with precise video loops
• Analyze movements frame-by-frame with repeated playback
• Create looping videos for presentations, installations, or displays
• Play continuous video playlists on TVs or external screens
• Generate seamless loops or GIFs for content creation
Looper Pro Features
• Unlimited playlists
• Video folders for better organization
• Video filters
• Seamless loop matching (Looper Match)
• Multiple video selection and batch actions
• Background audio playback from other apps
• Backup and restore system (Looper Safe)
• Custom app icons
• Access to an in-app video library
• Optional logo display on external screens
• One-time Looper Coins bonus with Pro purchase
Access the Looper Plans section to see the full list!
Looper has been actively maintained and improved for over 10 years, trusted by users who need reliable video looping and export tools on iOS.
Questions or feedback?
support@barbapps.co
Privacy Policy & Terms:
https://www.barbapps.co/projects/looper/legal/ios/terms.pdf

bluejetty:00080554:ios.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled summer adventure with Summer Sports Mania! Compete in Archery, Trap, Run and many more disciplines and events against players worldwide. This thrilling sports manager game combines the excitement of athletics with RPG elements and realistic simulations. Your performance in each event will be meticulously tracked, pushing you to become the ultimate champion. Download now and reach the top to become the greatest athlete.
Summer Sports Mania is more than just a game; it's an immersive experience that allows you to improve your attributes, unlock new skills, and watch as your character evolves into a true legend. This captivating sport simulator lets you compete in a variety of thrilling disciplines, from the high-speed 100m sprint to the trap events.
But that's not all! Summer Sports Mania offers both single-player and multiplayer modes, so you can compete against friends and players from around the world or join forces to build clubs and compete in tournaments. Download Summer Sports Mania now and unleash your inner athlete!
The game contains:
Summer sport disciplines: 100m run, Archery, Trap and Keirin. Javelin Throw, Long Jump/Triple Jump, Speed Canoeing, Swimming, Weightlifting, and Skiff will be added soon.
Battle against thousands of players from around the world
- Multiplayer modes
- RPG elements
- Career mode with story
- Varied minigames
- Clubs and club competitions against real players
Summer Sports Mania is the ultimate athletics experience, featuring a wide array of sports that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a fan of track and field events, intense archery competitions, or strategic races, this game has something for everyone. Each discipline is meticulously designed to offer a realistic and thrilling experience. 
Engage in heart-pounding races that test your speed and endurance. From the 100m sprint to long-distance running events, you'll feel the rush of adrenaline as you push your limits and strive for victory. The archery events require precision and focus, challenging you to hit the bullseye and outscore your opponents.
The multiplayer modes in Summer Sports Mania let you race against real players, creating a dynamic and competitive environment. Form clubs with your friends and take on other teams in intense club competitions. Prove your skills in tournaments and rise through the ranks to become a celebrated champion.
With RPG elements integrated into the game, you can customize and enhance your athlete's attributes. Train hard to improve your speed, strength, and agility. Unlock new skills and abilities as you progress, making your character a formidable competitor in every event. The career mode offers a rich narrative experience, allowing you to guide your athlete from humble beginnings to international stardom.
Key Features:
- Athletics events: Participate in a wide range of track and field events, including sprints, jumps, and throws.
- Competitions: Test your precision and aim in challenging events.
- Race against the clock: Compete in high-speed races that push your limits.
- Battle real players: Engage in multiplayer battles and prove your dominance.
- Club competitions: Form clubs, join forces with friends, and compete in club tournaments.
- RPG progression: Customize your athlete, improve attributes, and unlock new skills.
- Career mode: Experience a compelling story as you guide your athlete to fame.
- Varied minigames: Enjoy fun and engaging minigames that enhance your skills.
Join the global community of athletes in Summer Sports Mania and experience the thrill of international competition. 
This app has received an IGRS rating of 3+.
Download now and start your journey to athletic greatness!

bluejetty:00043591:ios.description:
Granna is the best app for who want to save that money to get that new car or take that dream trip, but have never found an easy way to track your progress and keep track of your deposits and withdrawals.
All you need to do to get started is create a goal, set an target for that goal, and enter how much you already have. As you record your deposits, Granna will show you charts and information such as your current balance, how much you have left to complete, goal comparison charts, and other ways to track your progress.
Note: Granna is not a virtual bank or an investment broker.
Features:
- Recommendations: Set a target deadline date and visualize recommendations for monthly, weekly or daily deposit amounts to reach the target on time.
- Automatic Backup: Never lose your records if you need to switch devices or if something bad happens to it.
- Customization: Customize your goals with more than 950 icons and several themes.
- Progress Charts, Deposits, and Balances: Charts will give you that insight into how goals are progressing over the months, helping you decide on the priorities when making a deposit.
- Dark Mode: Dark mode helps to preserve your eyes' health by decreasing the clarity of your device's screen, and makes the app's appearance look much more elegant.

Dive into 'Dream Wedding!', your ultimate wedding planning adventure. Here, you get to pick every detail for your special day while walking down the aisle.


Start with choosing the bride's dress and the wedding theme. Opt for a classic look or dare to be different. Your choices in menu, entertainment, and decorations will set the stage for an unforgettable event.


Features:
Customizable Weddings: Select the dress, theme, furniture music, the cake and all the details.
Interactive Choices: Make instant decisions that shape your big day.
Memorable Moments: Create a wedding that's truly yours.
Design Your House: Earn money by designing weddings and spend it to decorate your house and your garden.


As you make decisions, watch your wedding come to life. From the elegant reception hall to the lively dance floor, every detail contributes to your dream day.


Enjoy the process of bringing your vision to life, styling everything from outfits to the overall theme. Take charge and plan a wedding that will be remembered forever!

• Rate images and explore all of the highest rated ones
• Read all the latest NASA news and feature articles

• Experience our rovers and rockets up close and personal with augmented reality.

bluejetty:00147117:ios.description:
The Purple Visits secure video calling system keeps you and your loved one connected with a fully secure and compliant platform used within secure establishments.
Feel closer than a phone call when you’re unable to visit with a fully immersive HD* video calling experience that has been designed to make family contact easier and more cost affective than visiting in person.
• Video calls, don’t settle for just hearing them, see them too with a purple visits video call, the whole family can get involved with up to 3 additional participants being verified to accompany you on your video call.
• Visit from home, The Purple Visits video calling system allows you to have a video calling option when visiting in person would simply be impossible.
• Call from work, the purple visits video calling system doesn’t limit you to one location, you can use the system to video call from anywhere with a reliable broadband or 4G** connection.
• Call from the grandma’s, Add Grandma as an additional participant and take your video call round there, if grandma has been verified (easily done through the app) then feel free to let her join in on call too!
• Cost affective, our users are saving hundreds of pounds in travel and childcare costs every time by video calling instead.
• Show them around, the purple visits platform has been designed for you to show your loved one around the home, go ahead and flip the camera and show them the family pet or your latest decorating masterpiece.
Visitor feedback:
“We have been using the purple visits system for three months now and are extremely grateful that it is available for our son”
“Before purple visits were introduced, I was unable to visit my son in Jersey, now we have visited virtually every week and its really lifted his spirits”
“Being able to video call during my lunch break has made things so much better. We video chat every Wednesday and Friday!”
*HD calling is limited by your device and your connectivity, in order to achieve HD quality video calls you must be connected to a good quality and reliable WIFI signal and have a HD quality camera within your device.
**Data charges may apply if connecting via mobile internet. Contact your provider for details
We're always excited to hear from you! If you have feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
help@purplevisits.com
or follow us on twitter:
https://twitter.com/purplevisits
@purplevisits

bluejetty:00127208:ios.description:
Military GPS Survival Kit includes 37 easy to use tools, 52 Army Survival Handbooks Field Manual PDFs, Global Conflicts Live News and technologies specifically designed for both professional and amateur military personnel bundled in an easy to use interface.
Why choose Military GPS Survival Kit? Each tool is developed with a unique and detail-oriented approach, and included together in one application.
See the detailed description of each application included in our 37 in 1 kit below:
1. GPS Status Data, Satellite Info
Satellite info app is for the orbital element sets and related full info Active Satellites table. Find information like name, latitude longitude, fly speed etc. It can also be used for GPS tests, status and diagnosis.
2. Digital Compass and GPS Info
- UTM (Universal Transverse Mercator)
- MGRS (Military Grid Reference System)
- Map 
- True heading and magnetic heading 
- Magnetic strength 
- Slope level meter
3. Altimeter Geotracker
Professional app for hiking and biking in mountainous terrain.
4. Magnetometer EMF Camera Metal Detector
5. GPS Stamp Camera
GPS Camera can help you to add the address, location coordinates direction, altitude, current date & time and note in the picture.There UTM, and MGRS
6. GPS Location Info
GPS Location Info shows your current location, date & time to the second along with a scrollable map. You can copy your coordinates & locate anything you can find on the map with accurate crosshairs.Drop pins and save where you want for quick access.
7. Street View Dual Map & All GPS Info
Dual Map is an easy way to view street-level images based on Google Street View Maps.
Double view with both a Map and Street View with full GPS info.Track your location on the map as you move around, drop and save pins with comments, save them in the library so you always have your favorite places with you!
8. Cell Phone Towers, Network Cell World Map, Wi-Fi Towers and Speed Test 
Includes:
The world Database of Cell Towers.
Locate devices without GPS, explore Mobile Operator coverage and more:
- Cell Tower Locator
- GPS Status GPS Test Data Tools
- Supports GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, SBAS, BEIDOU and QZSS satellites.
- Dilution of Precision
- HDOP (Horizontal), VDOP (Vertical), PDOP (Position)
With Military Survival GPS Toolkit you also get: 
9. World GPS Coordinates
10. Speedometer
11. Binoculars
12. Night Vision
13. Direction Navi Cam
14. Digital Compass, GPS Status, Sensor information
15. Health Care Index. Live Map
16. GPS waypoint navigation
17. Measure Map Area Calculator
18. Crime Index Live Map
19. Heart rate monitor
20. Military compass and MGRS live map
21. Fires Live Map Alerts
22. Police Stations World Map
23. Light Pollution World Map
24. Metro Stations World Map
25. Atomic Clock
and more apps always coming with the updates...
Global Conflicts Live News Section: Select the region of your interest and track the latest live news updated every 30 minutes from different sources. Available regions are Israel/Palestine, Syria, Middle East, Europe, Russia, USA and Iran.
52 Army Survival Handbooks Field Manual PDFs
All handbooks are Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited
Subscription Details:
• Payment will be charged to the iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription is automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Subscription can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in the user's account settings.
• Any unused time of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
• User Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Privacy policy: http://www.alfarays.com/privacy_en.html

bluejetty:00098442:android.name: Grow a Garden: Farm & Relax
bluejetty:00098442:android.summary:
🌱 Grow a Garden: Farm & Relax – The Ultimate Farming Simulator! 🌱
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a relaxing and fun farming simulator where you can build your dream garden, raise animals, and enjoy the peaceful life of a happy farmer! This game
bluejetty:00098442:android.description:
🌱 Grow a Garden: Farm & Relax – The Ultimate Farming Simulator! 🌱
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a relaxing and fun farming simulator where you can build your dream garden, raise animals, and enjoy the peaceful life of a happy farmer! This game brings you a colorful, casual mobile adventure full of charm and joy.
👨🌾 Start Your Garden, Grow Your Dream!
Become a farmer and begin your journey with a small plot of land. Plant seeds, water them, and watch them grow into beautiful flowers, fruits, and vegetables. From carrot patches to strawberry bushes, every crop you plant brings you closer to building your perfect farm.
As your crops grow, experience the joy of harvest — sell your fresh produce at the market, store it in your warehouse, or use it to feed your adorable animals. Farming has never been more fun!
🐄 Raise Cute Animals on Your Animal Farm
From fluffy sheep and cows to cheerful chickens and funny pigs, your animal farm is full of life! Take care of your animals, feed them, and collect useful resources like eggs, milk, and wool. You can even raise goats, rabbits, and a friendly dog or cat to keep you company!
The more you care for your animals, the more they’ll reward you. A happy farm means better productivity and faster growth!
🚜 Farming Fun for Everyone
Whether you enjoy farming games, casual games, or idle adventures, Grow a Garden is made for you. With casual, easy-to-learn gameplay, you can farm at your own pace. Decorate your garden, expand your town, and become one of the top farmers in the land.
There's always something to do:
Harvest and sell fruits like blueberries, corn, and apples
Decorate your garden with cute designs and creative layouts
Unlock new areas and expand your big farm
Complete daily harvest missions to earn coins and special gifts
🧸 Cute, Relaxing, and Wholesome
Love cute animals? Need to relax after a long day? This farming simulator is perfect for players of all ages. Enjoy adorable animals like a tiny bunny, sleepy snail, or even a playful monkey or panda nibbling on bamboo. It’s a calming and joyful experience every time you play.
🎨 Beautiful Graphics and Custom Design
Enjoy bright, cheerful visuals that bring your garden to life! Every plant, animal, and decoration is crafted with love. Customize your land the way you like — it's your garden, your rules!
💰 Grow, Sell, Upgrade, and Thrive
As your farming empire expands, manage your resources wisely. Sell your harvest at the market, upgrade your tools, and build new buildings to boost efficiency. Every step, from planting to selling, is part of your journey to becoming a successful farmer.
🌼 Play Daily – There’s Always Something New!
Check in daily to complete harvest tasks and earn bonus rewards. Get free daily gifts, unlock new crops, and discover new plants to grow.
⭐ Features:
Classic farming game mechanics with a relaxing twist
Raise animals like cows, sheep, chickens, and more
Enjoy idle income as your farm grows
Complete daily harvest goals for special rewards
Play offline or online – it’s always your farm, your way
🎯 For fans of cozy farm games
Whether you’re into casual games or deep farming simulations, Grow a Garden has something for everyone. With elements of gardenscapes, classic farming sims, and relaxing idle fun, this is your perfect farm escape.
🎁 No premium currency needed — just your love for gardens, animals, and peaceful farm life.
🌻 Download now and begin your journey in the cutest and most relaxing farming simulator today. Let’s grow your garden together! 🌻

bluejetty:00170347:ios.description:
Téléchargez gratuitement l’application L’Express et accédez à toute l’actualité en France et dans le monde. Retrouvez le meilleur du journal et du magazine L’Express : actualités, analyses, enquêtes, décryptages, politique, économie, société, culture, podcasts et vidéos réunis dans une seule application.
AU-DELÀ DE L'ACTUALITÉ, L'EXPERTISE EN CONTINU
Suivez toute l’actualité en France et dans le monde. Chaque jour, retrouvez des analyses, enquêtes, décryptages, entretiens et dossiers exclusifs pour comprendre les grands enjeux politiques, économiques, sociétaux et internationaux.
• Tous les articles disponibles en audio : écoutez l’actualité où que vous soyez grâce aux listes prêtes à l’écoute ou créez votre propre sélection.
• L’essentiel de l’information chaque jour : retrouvez les actualités incontournables avec la Une et démarrez votre journée avec les 7 infos essentielles du Sept.
• Podcasts, vidéos, enquêtes et décryptages : politique, économie, société, culture, science, Europe et monde, explorez toute la richesse éditoriale de L’Express dans une seule application.
DÉCOUVREZ LES FONCTIONNALITÉS DE NOTRE APPLICATION :
L’hebdo : Retrouvez chaque semaine l’intégralité du magazine numérique L’Express, disponible en avant-première avant sa sortie en kiosque. Feuilletez le journal en version PDF, consultez les archives des anciens numéros. L’hebdomadaire est également disponible en version audio grâce à une lecture continue de tous les articles.
Ma sélection : Ajoutez les articles, podcasts et vidéos que vous voulez retrouver plus tard en les ajoutant à votre liste. Epinglez les sujets et les auteurs que vous voulez suivre et retrouvez-les en accès rapide dans votre espace.
Mon compte : Personnalisez votre expérience de lecture et d’écoute en fonction de vos préférences : mode sombre, taille du texte, inscrivez-vous aux notifications pour recevoir des alertes sur les dernières analyses de l’actualité et modifiez vos informations personnelles.
Parcourir : Explorez toute la richesse éditoriale de L’Express grâce aux dossiers du moment, enquêtes, analyses, décryptages et grands formats de la rédaction. Retrouvez facilement les rubriques qui vous intéressent — politique, économie, société, culture, sciences, Europe ou international — et approfondissez les sujets qui font l’actualité. Utilisez la barre de recherche pour accéder en quelques secondes à un article, un auteur ou un thème spécifique.
POURQUOI S’ABONNER
• Tous nos articles en illimité, à lire ou à écouter. Accédez à tous les articles de nos journalistes et experts, y compris en version audio.
• Aucune publicité. Profitez d’une expérience améliorée sans aucune publicité.
• Le magazine en version numérique en exclusivité. Consultez l’hebdo en avant-première, à 18h la veille de sa parution en kiosque et accédez à toutes les anciennes parutions.
• Les newsletters abonnés. Recevez par mail les lettres d’information exclusives rédigées avec soin par nos journalistes.
• Le Cercle de L’Express. Bénéficiez d’avantages exceptionnels avec nos prestigieux partenaires.
Nos offres d’abonnement sans engagement :
14,99€ par mois + 7 jours offerts
119€ par an
VOTRE AVIS NOUS INTÉRESSE
Votre expérience est au cœur de nos priorités. Vos remarques, suggestions et retours nous permettent d’améliorer en continu l’application L’Express et de vous proposer une expérience de lecture et d’écoute toujours plus fluide.
Une question, une suggestion ou un problème avec votre abonnement ou l’application ? Notre équipe est à votre écoute. Écrivez-nous à serviceclient@lexpress.fr, nous serons ravis de vous accompagner.
Conditions Générales d’Utilisation :
https://www.lexpress.fr/outils/conditions-generales-utilisation.html
Merci de votre confiance et bonne lecture… ou bonne écoute sur L’Express !

bluejetty:00096648:ios.description:
Music Pad: Beat Maker Machine is your all-in-one rhythm playground — whether you’re a music lover, beginner, or just here to have fun with sound!
No need for musical knowledge — just tap, play, and feel the rhythm come alive.
This app makes beat creation simple and exciting for everyone. Start with easy lessons to learn the basics, or jump straight into freestyle mode and make your own rhythm right away. Discover new sounds, experiment with styles, and enjoy the pure fun of creating music with your fingertips.
Explore a massive library of music albums across every genre — from energetic dance tracks and chill lo-fi vibes to pop, trap, and more. Each album bursts with vibrant, high-quality sounds designed to inspire creativity and keep you grooving.
Experience a growing collection of presets and samples, making it easy to mix, layer, and craft your own sound in seconds. Whether you’re here to learn, jam, or just have fun, Music Pads turns every tap into music.
Music Pads: Beat Maker Machine is more than a beat app — it’s where creativity meets play.
[Features]
*** Beginner-friendly: No music experience needed — start tapping instantly
*** Dynamic drum pads: Play colorful pads and build your own beats
*** Learning mode: Step-by-step lessons to improve your rhythm skills
*** Genre albums: Explore vibrant collections from pop to lo-fi and beyond
*** Presets & samples: Mix and match sounds for instant creativity
*** Freestyle mode: Create and record your own unique sound anytime, anywhere
*** Regular updates: New albums, sound packs, and challenges added often
*** Feel the rhythm. Tap the beat. Create your vibe.

• You can subscribe to all features within Easy Draw for unlimited access.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or yearly at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• You can cancel your subscription via this URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00037810:ios.name: FitShow: Treadmill Workout
bluejetty:00037810:ios.summary: FitShow is an interactive indoor training application, perfect for activities like walking, running, cycling, and rowing. It is highly compatible with a variety of fitness equipment, including treadmills, exercise bikes, home trainers, elli
bluejetty:00037810:ios.description:
FitShow is an interactive indoor training application, perfect for activities like walking, running, cycling, and rowing. It is highly compatible with a variety of fitness equipment, including treadmills, exercise bikes, home trainers, ellipticals, and rowing machines.
This app offers a dynamic and immersive indoor training experience. Whether you're looking to maintain your fitness routine during inclement weather or simply prefer the convenience of home - based workouts, FitShow has got you covered. With its seamless integration with different fitness devices, it can adjust the parameters of your equipment according to your training needs and the virtual routes you choose. It provides access to a vast library of geolocated videos, allowing you to explore numerous routes around the world right from the comfort of your home.
In addition, FitShow is designed to keep you motivated throughout your fitness journey. It may offer features such as structured training programs, virtual challenges, and a community where you can interact with fellow fitness enthusiasts. So, no matter your fitness level or goal, FitShow is here to make your indoor training more engaging and effective.
Membership & Subscription:
Free Membership: Access the basic features without any cost.
Premium Membership: Unlimited access the exclusive features, and advanced customization. Flexible subscription plans
Monthly Plan: $9.99
Annual Plan: $59.99
Privacy Agreement: https://www.fitshow.com/article?key=privacy
User Agreement: https://www.fitshow.com/article?key=terms
Remarks:
--Voice prompt exercise status: start, pause, continue, end, etc.
--GPS: Use when using "map mode and outdoor sports", when the application is switched to the background, GPS will still remain connected, the use of GPS will affect the battery life.
- Apple Health: FitShow synchronizes the number of steps and distance in exercise data to Apple Health through the HealthKit if the user allows it.

Whether you're an aspiring artist or just want to have fun, Musicful, the ultimate AI song generator, makes your own music from just lyrics, an idea, or even an audio sample. – Make your own song or create full music tracks quickly.
– Ideal for social creators, songwriters, rappers, beat makers, and hobbyists.
– Explore a wide range of styles including Pop, Hip-Hop, Rap, Rock, Lo-fi, Phonk, Country, Jazz, and more.

bluejetty:00187568:ios.name: ImmoScout24 Switzerland
bluejetty:00187568:ios.summary: ImmoScout24 is an all-in-one marketplace for finding your ideal property in Switzerland. Buy your dream house or rent an apartment. With more than 84,000 houses and condominiums and rental apartments, you have a lot to choose from. From aff
bluejetty:00187568:ios.description:
ImmoScout24 is an all-in-one marketplace for finding your ideal property in Switzerland. Buy your dream house or rent an apartment. With more than 84,000 houses and condominiums and rental apartments, you have a lot to choose from. From affordable one-bedroom apartments in Lugano and terraced houses in Bern through to lofts in Zurich and duplex houses in Lucerne, there’s something to meet your every need. And you can, of course, also create listings for your own properties! Would you like to find out more? Here you’ll find detailed information about our app’s most important features.
► Advanced search tool
Search for a house or apartment and indicate whether you would like to rent or buy.
Filter your search results using relevant criteria such as number of rooms, living space and price. 
► A wide range of properties
Discover all kinds of houses and apartments in Switzerland – be it rental apartments in the suburbs, idyllic private homes in Fribourg or rooms in shared apartments in Basel.
In our real estate marketplace, you can also find houses and villas available for sale in prime locations such as Geneva, Zurich and the area surrounding Lake Thun.
In addition, you can purchase or rent commercial properties, vacant lots and parking spaces.
► Travel time calculator 
We can help you find properties near your workplace, sports club or children’s school. 
Simply enter the most important addresses that you visit regularly.
Our app shows you the commuting and travel time to these places in each of the search results – have the commuting time calculated for you!
► Draw in search areas
Draw in your own search area, regardless of postcode or local borders. 
► User-friendly map tool
Use a map of the area to search for interesting apartments in your local or favourite area.
► Comprehensive detailed views
Get an overview of the data and images for each property. 
Quickly and easily contact the property’s seller.
► Automated apartment search
Select the search criteria for your new home. You only have to do this once.
Don’t miss any relevant new listings with our push notifications.
You can also share matches on social media or by email.
► Favourites list on all your devices
Save interesting apartments and houses in your wish list.
Synchronise your list across all your devices.
► Online application folder
Upload the documents needed for your application and create a professional folder that you can send to landlords.
► Useful extra services
We provide helpful additional information for each property, such as the distance to various nearby shops, nurseries and public transportation. If you wish, we can also provide quotations for moving services in your area.
► Professional customer service
Contact our customer service team by email or phone
We are happy to assist you. Email us at helpdesk@immoscout24.ch or 
call us at +41 (0) 31 744 17 40
Find out more about ImmoScout24 Switzerland and our app at:
►ImmoScout24: https://www.immoscout24.ch/en 
►Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/immoscout24.ch 
►Twitter: https://twitter.com/ImmoScout24ch
►YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/ImmoScout24Schweiz 
Discover more Scout24 apps:
►AutoScout24 Switzerland
►MotoScout24 Switzerland
►FinanceScout24 Switzerland 
An SMG brand Swiss Marketplace Group

bluejetty:00139394:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling new and used aircraft in Oceania. Whether you're looking for jets, helicopters, turboprop or piston aircraft, aircraft parts, other aviation equipment, or even hangars, aviation services, and jobs, Aviation Trader makes it fast, easy, and secure to connect with buyers and sellers across Australia, New Zealand, and the South Pacific.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF AIRCRAFT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH 
Browse a wide inventory of listings for various types of aircraft, including single and multi-engine planes, jets, helicopters, experimental/homebuilt aircraft, floatplanes, aviation equipment, and parts.
Once you've narrowed your search, view detailed specifications, photos, and videos of your desired aircraft or parts. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal that matches your needs.
The Aviation Trader app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, manufacturer, year, price range, condition, number of seats, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters to find exactly what you need.
EASILY TRACK AIRCRAFT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite listings or post a "Want-to-Buy" ad to let sellers know what you're searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email while browsing category pages that are updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you're a dealer or an independent seller, Aviation Trader connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for aircraft across Oceania.
Consign your inventory with Aviation Trader to reach a regional audience. Click the “My Inventory” button in your Aviation Trader app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app—your trusted and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE AVIATION TRADER APP FOR ALL YOUR AIRCRAFT NEEDS 
Whether you're upgrading your air fleet or selling aircraft, Aviation Trader connects you with a vast inventory of planes, helicopters, and aviation equipment, along with a large buyer audience in Australia, New Zealand, and the South Pacific.
As part of Sandhills Global, Aviation Trader links you to a network of trusted equipment marketplaces, including Controller, Controller EMEA, Charter Hub, Aircraft Cost Calculator, and other trusted machinery marketplaces, catering to the broad list of industries from farming to mining.
GET THE AVIATIONTRADER APP NOW 
Thousands of aircraft operator companies and private sellers trust Aviation Trader to manage their business. Download the app today to find your next aircraft or sell it with ease!

bluejetty:00055933:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Embark on a dangerous quest through mysterious ruins and eerie woods in the second chapter of the Grim Legends series. Save the young queen from an enigmatic curse and change the fate of the entire kingdom!
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
Explore the 42 hand painted locations of the legendary realm! 
When a mysterious illness befalls the queen of Eagle Kingdom, a famous healer is summoned to breathtaking Eagle Castle to examine her.
32 challenging mini games and puzzles to solve! 
The healer’s quest takes a dark turn when the infant prince vanishes under mysterious circumstances. The queen is accused of practicing dark magic and thrown into the prison tower.
16 hidden object scenes to explore and investigate! 
According to the kingdom’s law, sorcery is a crime punishable by death. The desperate King, believing his wife is innocent, begs the healer to find a way to investigate and exonerate the queen.
29 classic achievements to unlock! 
The protagonist has only one day to reach the enigmatic ruins of Swan Kingdom and unravel the mystery behind the ruling family’s curse. Only then will she manage to find the young heir to the throne and save the queen from her execution.
Unravel the dark secret from the past to help the queen! 
Will the healer be successful in saving the queen? Will she rescue the little prince from the clutches of dark magic? The fate of two kingdoms lies in the healer’s hands.
More puzzles, mini games, and hidden objects in the bonus adventure! 
Learn an additional side to the story from a different perspective!
Bring all the hidden object games with you! 
Optimized for phones and tablets, filled with hidden objects, perfect for playing while traveling. No - wifi required for this offline game!
Sign up to our newsletter for new hidden object games every month! 
Captivating adventures, stories, tales, and eerie mysteries await in our selection of immersive hidden object games!
Look for “Artifex Mundi” to get more hidden object games like this! 
• A legendary realm imagined brilliantly in 42 hand-painted locations
• 3 fairy-tale sidekicks to help you in times of need
• 32 challenging mini-games and 16 hidden-object scenes
• 14 intriguing characters to meet on your journey
• An additional story told from two different perspectives!
• 29 achievements to unlock!

bluejetty:00123028:ios.description:
Take it easy with the Octopus App! Manage your everyday expenses – top up your Octopus cards, pay online, and reap additional rewards – all with your mobile!
Services include:
TOP UP YOUR OCTOPUS, CHECK EXPENSES AND COLLECT SUBSIDIES
Go cashless and top up your own Octopus cards and even your family’s via Faster Payment System (FPS); check your card’s remaining value and spending records, and collect Public Transport Fare Subsidies
GET MOBILE OCTOPUS FOR EXTRA EASE AND CONVENIENCE
Add an Octopus to your iPhone or Apple Watch and reload anytime anywhere; style it with your favourite card images!
PAY ONLINE WITH OCTOPUS, FOR TRANSPORT, RETAIL AND MORE
Purchase MTR, KMB or Sun Ferry monthly pass without queuing; buy at popular online merchants such as supermarkets and fast food restaurants; even pay Government and telecom bills
“DOOD REWARDS” PLATFORM – EVERYDAY REWARDS SUPERPOWER!
Link your Octopus to wallet to start Dood Rewards and earn rewards effortlessly through everyday spending. Take on Mission and collect eStamps to unlock personalized offers, flash grab, rebate vouchers, and more exciting rewards!
SHOP AROUND THE WORLD WITH OUR TWO PREPAID CARDS WITH EASE AND CONTROL
Get our prepaid Mastercard and UnionPay QR instantly with just a few clicks. Octopus Mastercard can be used at all online merchants that accept Mastercard; you can also add it to Apple Pay to tap your mobile to pay around the world. Octopus UnionPay QR lets you pay at over 30 million merchants on the Mainland and beyond. You can top up the prepaid cards via FPS to control how much you spend, set daily and per transaction limits, or even turn them off to prevent unauthorized transactions.
For more details, please visit www.octopus.com.hk/octopusapp

Take it easy with the Octopus App! Manage your everyday expenses – top up your Octopus cards, pay online, and reap additional rewards – all with your mobile!

Services include:


TOP UP YOUR OCTOPUS, CHECK EXPENSES AND COLLECT SUBSIDIES
Go cashless and top up your own Octopus cards and even your family’s via Faster Payment System (FPS); check your card’s remaining value and spending records, and collect Public Transport Fare Subsidies


GET MOBILE OCTOPUS FOR EXTRA EASE AND CONVENIENCE
Add an Octopus to your iPhone or Apple Watch and reload anytime anywhere; style it with your favourite card images!


PAY ONLINE WITH OCTOPUS, FOR TRANSPORT, RETAIL AND MORE
Purchase MTR, KMB or Sun Ferry monthly pass without queuing; buy at popular online merchants such as supermarkets and fast food restaurants; even pay Government and telecom bills


“DOOD REWARDS” PLATFORM – EVERYDAY REWARDS SUPERPOWER!
Link your Octopus to wallet to start Dood Rewards and earn rewards effortlessly through everyday spending. Take on Mission and collect eStamps to unlock personalized offers, flash grab, rebate vouchers, and more exciting rewards!


SHOP AROUND THE WORLD WITH OUR TWO PREPAID CARDS WITH EASE AND CONTROL
Get our prepaid Mastercard and UnionPay QR instantly with just a few clicks. Octopus Mastercard can be used at all online merchants that accept Mastercard; you can also add it to Apple Pay to tap your mobile to pay around the world. Octopus UnionPay QR lets you pay at over 30 million merchants on the Mainland and beyond. You can top up the prepaid cards via FPS to control how much you spend, set daily and per transaction limits, or even turn them off to prevent unauthorized transactions.


For more details, please visit www.octopus.com.hk/octopusapp

bluejetty:00182568:ios.name: SK26: Street Kart Racing Game
bluejetty:00182568:ios.summary:
NOT FOR WIMPS. New Multiplayer PvP RIVALS feature added. SK26 is an online kart racing simulator for F1, Nascar and real-racing fans who want proper competition. Download Now.
Race an inch from the track at speeds up to 80 mph (125 kph).
bluejetty:00182568:ios.description:
NOT FOR WIMPS. New Multiplayer PvP RIVALS feature added. SK26 is an online kart racing simulator for F1, Nascar and real-racing fans who want proper competition. Download Now.
Race an inch from the track at speeds up to 80 mph (125 kph). 4 Tiers of Weekly Championships. No. 1 paid racing game over 100 countries! (App Annie). 
"You’ll never find another game like it. So competitive..."
Marijn Kremers, FIA-CIK World and European Kart Champion (KZ)
“I stopped real racing 3 as soon as I found this game.”
Mika Francis. App Store Review.
"If you like f1 or nascar games such as Assoluto Racing you'll love this."
Similar karts, similar engines. Always close, fast, competitive. This is Street Kart Racing.
The road to f1 / nascar / indycar / all starts in a kart. 
BRING IT ON
The original real racing sim game, SK is it. 
 ⁃ The No.1 go kart game on mobile
 - Awesome physics.
 ⁃ Challenging, fun, rewarding.
 ⁃ No Assists. No Excuses. Real racing tiers up to 80 mph.
 ⁃ Tested for authenticity by hundreds of go kart - rally - stock car racing drivers including world champions. Even f1 drivers play it!
- YOUR GOAL -
Go Karts: All F1, nascar, indycar, rally drivers start in cadet Karts - and so do you:
 ⁃ Race Real People on Real Tracks
 ⁃ Beat EVERYONE to become world go kart champion
 ⁃ Single & multiplayer competition
- SK DISCORD COMMUNITY -
Sure we’re on the grid to win. In the pits we all help each other out. 
 ⁃ Tips, tricks, advice. 
 ⁃ Create rivalries, join the banter, and always have someone to race. 
The no.1 go kart game on iOS. Assoluto racing to go cart racers. Even F1 racing drivers play SK. 
www.facebook.com/groups/streetkartracing
- GO KARTING STRATEGY -
- WEATHER: If it is raining at the track in real life it is raining in the game. We simulate everything. Rain, drizzle, hot and cold temperatures affect tire choice and grip. Air pressure affects the power delivered by the engine, speed and your lap time. More thought than your average racing game.
- CHOICE: Like F1, Indycar, Gear Club or Nascar games - a range of tire compounds from different brands.
- RIVALRIES: Win personal battles
- UPGRADES: Make complex kart choices: exhaust, seats, brakes, fuel, engines, tyre pressures and setup.. 
----- KEY FEATURES -----
We’re the no.1 go kart game. Here’s why:
- Street Kart Racing is about epic rivalries against real people.
- Close: Race in closely matched go karts - none of this massive upgrade, automatic win! We race in tenths!
- Compete against pro racing drivers! Yes they play Street Kart Racing Game.
- Real Tracks. Our grid: PFI, Adria, Wackersdorf, Mariembourg, Las Vegas Todd Road, and many more. No F1 tracks here.
- KART RACING -
Like Assoluto Racing - practice in solo mode with the 2018 World Champions Rosberg Racing Academy. Improve set ups and racing skills with test real racing lines. Test out different physics setups. 
RACE PASS SUBSCRIPTION - SUPPORT THE DEVS
By joining as an SK Race Pass Member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing monthly subscription plan (unless auto-renew is turned off) that will automatically be charged every month through your iTunes account for $4.99 within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You will be charged $4.99 for the first month immediately after your purchase is confirmed. To manage this subscription, or turn auto-renewal off, go to Account Settings after purchase.
Development Team
Street Kart Racing has ambassadors who race at the highest level of professional go kart racing / car / rally racing - helping perfect the racing game simulator physics. You'll find them on race tracks worldwide aiming to reach F1, Nascar, Indycar.
About Us
We’re a small team but we don't believe that should mean average. Your experience playing Street Kart Racing Simulator should be the most fun driving game on mobile.
Link to terms of use:
https://www.streetkart.me/eula

bluejetty:00171183:ios.description:
**** Find your snow! ** Download for free today! ****
Colorado Snow Map lets you quickly view and compare snow report information for ski resorts across Colorado in a single glance by showing the information on a map. With Colorado Snow Map, you can: 
- View currently reported 24-hour snowfall totals, 3-day totals, and 7-day totals across all resorts. 
- View snow base statistics across all resorts.
- See the same statistics for past dates by swiping left or right on the map. This lets you see how much snow each resort received yesterday, two days ago, etc. 
- Review detailed snow history for each resort by clicking on the resort to view the resort-specific page within the app, letting you see many days of snowfall history. 
- Zoom in to your favorite part of Colorado to focus on the resorts you care most about. When you reopen the app, the Snow Map will take you right back to the region you were last viewing. 
- See how snowfall amounts can vary, even among neighboring resorts, letting you find the best snow for your days on the mountain. 
- See the last date each resort received snow by clicking on the "Last Snowfall" button.
*** Find Your Snow! ***
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * 
Colorado Snow Map Pro (Optional In-App Purchase)
***********************************************
Colorado Snow Map is free to use, but if you would like you can subscribe to Colorado Snow Map Pro, which removes advertisements.
Automatically renews once per year, cancel anytime. 
Additional Details:

bluejetty:00073640:ios.description:
Find and book your perfect campground — quick, easy, and all in one app.
Plan your next camping trip with the Good Sam Travel app. Search thousands of campgrounds and RV parks across the US and Canada, compare your options, and book in just a few taps — everything you need to hit the road, right at your fingertips.
PLAN YOUR TRIP
Search by destination, dates, or campground name to plan your next adventure. Explore nearby campgrounds on an interactive map, compare your options, and see prices at a glance. Browse by theme — waterfront, pet-friendly, snowbird destinations and more — or pick up right where you left off with your recently viewed campgrounds.
FIND THE RIGHT SITE
Browse photos, ratings, and reviews from fellow campers. Check the amenities that matter to you — electric, water & sewer connections, Wi-Fi, pet policies, open all year — and filter by site type, whether you need an RV site, a tent spot, a Good Sam Park, or a public park. See available site types with real pricing for your dates, check the availability calendar, and read the cancellation policy before you commit.
WORKS WITHOUT A SIGNAL
The best campgrounds are often where cell service isn't. Good Sam Travel arrives with thousands of campgrounds and RV parks already stored on your phone — the full US and Canada catalog, ready the moment you install the app.
Search them, filter them, see them on the map, and open full campground details with no connection at all. Addresses and phone numbers stay tappable, so you can start navigation or call ahead from a dead zone. Booking needs a connection — everything leading up to it doesn't. There's nothing to download and nothing to set up, and the catalog quietly keeps itself current whenever you're back online.
BOOK WITH CONFIDENCE
Reserve online at participating campgrounds, or send a booking request where the campground handles reservations directly — either way you never leave the app. Review your trip before you pay, check out securely with your card, and get clear reservation details right away. Good Sam members can verify their membership at checkout to receive member pricing.
MANAGE YOUR TRIP
Keep every reservation in one place. View upcoming and past trips, open full reservation details, make changes, or cancel with any fee shown up front — no surprises. Respond to alternative site or date suggestions from the campground, and retry a payment without re-entering your card details. Share a campground or a trip with whoever you're traveling with in a single tap.
BROWSE WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Explore campgrounds, run searches, and read full details without signing in. Sign in with your existing Good Sam account when you're ready to book.
Download the Good Sam Travel app today to find and book your next campground with ease.

Com o My Ahgora o colaborador tem acesso rápido a suas batidas de ponto e banco de horas, além de poder solicitar de forma ágil ajustes no seu espelho de ponto e abonos. 
Através do aplicativo também é possível acessar facilmente outros produtos da Ahgora, como por exemplo o Ahgora Multi, aplicativo para registro de ponto via reconhecimento facial.
Se a empresa em que você trabalha já é cliente da Ahgora, siga os passos abaixo para começar a usar o My Ahgora:
Baixe o APP
Digite o código da empresa (verifique com o seu RH) e acesse o app com número de matrícula e senha, ou via SSO.
Para utilização do aplicativo é preciso dar as seguintes permissões para os cenários específicos:
 *Permissões de câmera e de mídias: Para anexos em algumas funcionalidade como solicitação de abono
 *Permissão de Biometria: Para utilização de biometria para logar no app 
Pronto! Viu como é fácil? Agora você já pode aproveitar todos os benefícios do My Ahgora!
Estamos sempre em busca de novidades para os nossos produtos. Suas considerações e sugestões são importantes para a evolução do aplicativo My Ahgora. Acesse no app o seu Perfil, clique em Pesquisa de Satisfação e deixe seu feedback.

bluejetty:00128544:ios.summary: Pipe Calc Elite is the pipe trades calculator for pipefitters, plumbers, steamfitters, welders and sprinkler fitters. Solve simple and rolling offsets, take-outs and cut lengths in feet, inches and fractions, look up pipe data for seven mat
bluejetty:00128544:ios.description:
Pipe Calc Elite is the pipe trades calculator for pipefitters, plumbers, steamfitters, welders and sprinkler fitters. Solve simple and rolling offsets, take-outs and cut lengths in feet, inches and fractions, look up pipe data for seven materials, and work out pressure loss through pipe, valves and fittings.
One purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account, and no data collected. Everything, including the full user's manual, works with no signal on the job site. On the App Store since 2013.
OFFSETS AND FITTINGS
• Simple and rolling offsets: offset, run, travel, roll and advance
• Take-out and cut length for butt-weld long and short radius, field-cut, and threaded Class 150, 300, 3000 and 6000 elbows
• Thread make-up by pipe size, or enter your own
• Welder's gap, cutbacks, arc lengths and odd-angle fittings

bluejetty:00158491:ios.description:
Calculator
Easily type out math with the basic and scientific calculators for quick solutions. With the Math Notes calculator, solving expressions, creating and using variables, and even plotting equations on graphs is as simple as typing or writing them out.
Basic & Scientific Calculators
Type complete expressions with parentheses, and basic and scientific operations before hitting equal for the final answer. With history, you can keep track of previous calculations, and easily copy or switch back to previous results.
Unit Conversion
Unit conversions in the basic and scientific calculators help you quickly convert between hundreds of units including length, speed, temperature, weight and more. You can even get up-to-date conversions for currencies from around the world.
Math Notes
Type math or write it out using Apple Pencil on iPad, and Math Notes will solve your expressions inline as soon as you add an equal sign. Math Notes supports all the same functions as the basic and scientific calculators, unit conversions and even math written vertically.
Variables
Create variables by typing or writing their name, an equals sign and then their value. Name them with letters or words. Tap on a variable’s value to easily adjust the value up or down. And use your variables in expressions, and even graphed equations across a Math Note.
Graphing
Type or write an equation, and with a tap you can graph it in Math Notes. Zoom, pan around, or resize your graph to get it just right. You can even add multiple equations on the same graph to see how they’re related.

bluejetty:00082591:android.description:
🌟 Welcome to WozBox: Your Ultimate WA Companion!
Are you tired of downloading multiple apps just to save a status video, lock a private chat, or manage a second account? Meet WozBox - your complete, all-in-one toolkit for enhancing your chats, boosting your productivity, and getting the absolute best WA status download experience.
Whether you love downloading statuses 😍, securing your private conversations from prying eyes, or magically recovering deleted messages, WozBox puts everything you need into one incredibly sleek, easy-to-use app. Say goodbye to app clutter and hello to a seamless WA status saver! Every status you see can now be yours to keep.
⚡ Lightning Fast & Lightweight
🚀 Packed with 18+ Powerful Features
💯 100% Free to Use
🔥 Core Features Deep Dive
📲 The Ultimate WA Status Saver
Never miss a great status update or story again! WozBox is the fastest and most reliable tool for downloading WA statuses. Save status photos, GIFs, and status videos in crystal-clear HD quality directly to your phone's gallery. Keep, delete, and share your favorite status updates with a single tap.
💻 WA Web Scanner & Dual Accounts
Need to manage work and personal life on the same phone? Our fast and secure WA Web Scanner lets you easily link and manage dual accounts on a single device, or log into your account on multiple devices simultaneously.
💬 Chat Locker & Total Security
Keep your private conversations strictly private. Use our Chat Locker feature to secure specific chats with a PIN, pattern, or fingerprint. Hand your phone to friends without worrying about them snooping through your personal messages!
♻️ Recover Deleted WA Messages
We all know how frustrating it is when someone deletes a message before you can read it. WozBox automatically detects and recovers deleted messages, photos, and media so you never miss a thing.
🚀 Explore the 18+ Smart Tools
WozBox isn't just a status download app; it is a complete productivity powerhouse! Unlock additional smart tools designed to make your daily digital life easier:
Direct Chat: Send messages directly to any phone number without having to save them to your contacts first. Perfect for quick, one-time texts!
Auto Reply: Busy driving, working, or sleeping? Set up custom automated responses so your friends and clients know you will get back to them later.
Built-in Status Player: View statuses, zoom into status photos, and play status videos directly within WozBox before deciding to save them.
Custom Folders: Choose exactly where your downloaded status files go on your device for effortless organizing.
Text to Emoji: Turn your text into fun emoji art.
Text Repeater: Repeat any text hundreds of times with a single tap.
Blank Message: Send empty messages to prank your friends.
(And many more utility tools inside!)
💡 How to Use the Status Saver:
Open your WA and view the desired status or story.
Open the WozBox app and navigate to the Status Saver tool.
You will instantly see all your recently viewed status photos and status videos.
Tap the download icon to save that status permanently to your gallery!
⚠️ Important Notice
To ensure you get the best performance and avoid any potential bugs, please make sure WozBox is updated to the latest version before using the WA status saver feature.
🔐 Accessibility Service Usage
WozBox requires Accessibility Service permission to enable core security features, such as monitoring and locking your specified chats.
Privacy Guarantee: This permission does NOT allow us to read, store, or access your personal chats, messages, or private data. Your privacy is our top priority.
⚖️ Disclaimer
WozBox is an independently developed application. We are not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or officially connected to any third-party messaging apps or companies.

bluejetty:00078498:ios.description:
Effortlessly manage your medical information with my portal. by Dignity Health – your all-in-one care solution. 
Streamline your health management and access vital features such as: 
- View health records.
- Secure messaging with your doctor.
- Personal list of medications, immunizations, and test results.
Our secure network ensures data safety, enabling you to utilize all features with complete peace of mind. 
Accessing my portal. is simple:
1. Create Your Account: If you don’t already have a My Portal account, Dignity Health will send an email invitation upon booking or following a visit. You may also call your provider and ask them to send you an invitation. Simply follow the steps in the invitation to get started, then log in with your credentials. You must have a valid My Portal account to use the my portal. by Dignity Health app.
2. Download the App: Get the my portal. app by Dignity Health and sign in using your Dignity Health email and password.
3. Select your care region: Depending on where you received care, select the correct region for entry into your patient portal. If you receive a 400 error when attempting to log in:
 - Go “Back” to the log in page
 - Select “Change site”
 - Change your site and try logging in again.
4. Explore and Engage: Start messaging your provider, accessing lab results, and diving into your health records.
For computer access visit https://www.commonspirit.org/patient-resources/dignity-health-patient-portal/myportal
Experience effortless health management – download my portal. by Dignity Health today. Your care, simplified.
Note: The My Portal. app works best in portrait orientation.

bluejetty:00130646:ios.name: Block Master: Wood Blast
bluejetty:00130646:ios.summary: Block Master: Wood Blast is a classic and addictive wooden-style block puzzle game that challenges you to fit different shaped blocks into a 10x10 grid. This real classic offers an unlimited, no-time-limit gameplay experience focused solely
bluejetty:00130646:ios.description:
Block Master: Wood Blast is a classic and addictive wooden-style block puzzle game that challenges you to fit different shaped blocks into a 10x10 grid. This real classic offers an unlimited, no-time-limit gameplay experience focused solely on elimination, perfect for relaxing and honing your strategic skills.
Experience the joy of wood block puzzles with Block Master: Wood Blast. This Tetris-like game features a variety of wooden block shapes like T, L, J, and squares that you must rotate and place to clear rows and columns. The unlimited gameplay allows you to play for as long as you desire, making it a great time killer and brain training exercise.
Optimized for mobile devices, Block Master: Wood Blast boasts a clean, user-friendly interface that caters to all ages. The unique block holder section lets you strategically set aside pieces for later use, adding an extra layer of depth to the classic block puzzle gameplay.
Earn high scores by efficiently clearing rows and columns, and experience the satisfying sound effects of wood blocks falling into place. Challenge yourself to become the ultimate Wood Blast champion by aiming for record-breaking scores, all without the need for an internet connection.
Block Master Key Features:
• No time limits for a relaxed, uninterrupted puzzling experience
• Innovative block holder grid for strategic block placement
• When you remove blocks in more than one line at a time, you will get a combo reward of additional points and gold coins.
• When you remove blocks in every three moving steps, you will get a streak reward of additional points
• Collect pretty pictures in Daily Challenge mode
• Easy to learn with simple, intuitive controls
• Beautifully designed wooden-style interface
• Constantly updated with new, classic block shapes
• Simple yet addictive gameplay that's easy to pick up but hard to master
• Share your high scores with friends and compete for the top spot
Dive into the world of wooden block puzzles and experience the timeless challenge of Block Master: Wood Blast. Let your strategic thinking and puzzle-solving skills shine as you navigate this addictive, brain-training gameplay.

• Get your payroll up to 2 days early, or government benefits up to 4 days early with direct deposits⁴
• Free nationwide ATM network, including all PLS stores⁵
• Transfer money from your linked debit card or bank account⁶
• Send and receive money using the SendMoney feature
• Keep your money safe - lock and unlock your card⁷, contactless chip-enabled card, receive fraud text alerts⁸
• Free reloads at PLS when you load cash onto your Xpectations! Plus Debit Card⁹
Visit PLScard.com to learn more or stop into any PLS store to apply for an Xpectations! Plus Debit Card. Most stores open 24/7.
Online access and identity verification (including Social Security, TIN or select US ID type or Foreign ID types) is required for card activation and to open an account. Mobile number or email address verification and mobile app are required to access all features.
1. Monthly fee waived whenever you receive payroll or government benefits direct deposits of $500 or more in the previous monthly statement period. Otherwise, $5 per month.
2. There are no pay per use fees on purchase transactions when you use your Xpectations! Plus Debit Card.
3. Up to $300 overdraft protection with opt-in and eligible direct deposits. Fees, terms, & conditions apply
4. Early direct deposit availability depends on payor type, timing, payment instructions, and bank fraud prevention measures. As such, early direct deposit availability may vary from pay period to pay period. The name, Social Security, TIN or select US ID type or Foreign ID type number on fi­le with your employer or benefits provider must match your Xpectations! Plus Debit Card account to prevent fraud restrictions on the account.
5. See app or website for free ATM locations. $3 for out-of-network withdrawals, plus any additional fees the ATM owner or bank may charge. Limits apply.
6. Customer can transfer their funds from another debit card or bank account to their Xpectations! Plus Debit Card account in minutes for a small fee. Limits apply to bank transfers and are subject to your bank’s restrictions and fees. Bank account verification services provided by Plaid. Activated, personalized debit card required to make a bank transfer. See Deposit Account Agreement for terms and conditions.
7. Previously authorized transactions and deposits/transfers to your account will function with a locked card.
8. Message and data rates may apply.
9. There is no charge for cash reloads at PLS Check Cashers locations. Individual retailers other than PLS Check Cashers locations may charge a fee.
10. Activated personalized card, savings vault and enrollment are required. Purchases made using your debit card are rounded to the nearest dollar and the difference is automatically transferred to the designated savings vault. PLS may cancel or modify Savings Round Up at any time without prior notice. Transfers may be voided if the debit account does not possess sufficient funds.
11. Interest paid quarterly on the average daily balance of savings during the quarter up to a $10,000 average daily balance and if the account is in good standing.  Fees on your primary deposit account may reduce earnings on your savings account. 1.00% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) and 0.99% interest rate are accurate as of September 2025. APY and interest rate may change before or after you open an account. See Deposit Account Agreement for terms and conditions.

bluejetty:00186212:ios.description:
Simply Piano is a fast and fun way to learn piano, from beginner to pro. Works with any piano or keyboard. Chosen as one of the best iPhone apps.
- Tons of fun songs like Imagine, Chandelier, All Of Me and Counting Stars, also J.S. Bach
- Includes courses for different musical tastes and playing levels
- Learn the basics step-by-step from reading sheet music to playing with both hands
- Slow down library songs to choose your own pace for easy learning
- Personalized 5-Min Workouts ensuring you progress fast and always succeed
- Suitable for all ages, no previous knowledge required to learn piano
No Piano? Try the Touch Courses with 3D Touch to turn your device into an on-screen keyboard!
How it works:
- Place your device (iPhone/iPad/iPod) on your acoustic/MIDI piano or keyboard and play; the app will immediately recognize what you are playing
- Get instant feedback on your playing to quickly learn and improve your piano skills
- Discover the magic of music with fun songs in the Library and complete courses to start sounding like a pro
How the Subscription Works:
- All app users can play two free courses. Upgrade to a premium subscription package at any time.
- Subscribers will receive full access to ALL courses. New courses and songs added every month!
- All recurring subscriptions will auto-renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the cost of the chosen package.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Your subscription is for your iTunes account and can be used on your iOS device.
- Payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period.
Simply Piano is developed by Simply, creators of award-winning apps Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, Piano Maestro and Piano Dust Buster. Created by music educators, the apps are used by tens of thousands of music teachers worldwide with over 1 million songs learned every week. Simply are experts in creating educational and fun music apps for learning piano quickly and easily.
Awards & Recognition -
- ""EMI’s Innovation Challenge”
- ""World Summit Award"", by the United Nations
- “Best Tools for Beginners”, NAMM
- ""Best Tablet Game"", GameIS
- “Parents' Choice Award”
- “Golden App”, Apps for Homeschooling
Have questions, feedback or suggestions? Reach out to us via the in-app chat, just tap on Settings and ‘Have a Question’
Enjoy Playing!

bluejetty:00084803:ios.description:
Download the number one classified app in the UAE to buy, sell, and find anything online. Whether you’re in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, or any other emirate, with the Dubizzle app you can: 
• Buy or rent a room, apartment, or villa in any neighborhood in the UAE. 
• Sell your used car or buy a boat, a motorcycle, or a new number plate to match your ride.
• Buy and sell furniture, home appliances, electronics, mobile phones, and even baby items. 
• Upload your CV & apply for a job in Engineering, Hospitality, Sales, and many more in the UAE.
Decluttering your home? Sell furniture & electronics directly through your phone. Looking to buy a new car? Connect with sellers directly through our chat messaging feature. Can’t make up your mind on that apartment? Save your searches to stay in the know.
Don’t know where to start? Just log on with your Facebook account & start browsing, you can find anything on dubizzle. 
قم بتنزيل التطبيق الأول للإعلانات المبوبة في الإمارات لتتمكن من بيع أو شراء أو العثور على أي شيء تقريباً، سواء في دبي أو أبوظبي أو أي إمارة أخرى. بتنزيلك لتطبيق دوبيزل ستتمكن من القيام بالعديد من الأمور المفيدة في أي مكان وفي الوقت الذي يلائمك، مثلاً:
• يمكنك شراء أو استئجار غرف أو شقق أو فِلل في أي منطقة في الإمارات
• يمكنك بيع سيارتك أو شراء قارب أو دراجة نارية أو حتى أرقام لوحات مميزة لمركبتك
• يمكنك بيع وشراء الأثاث المستعمل والتجهيزات المنزلية والإلكترونيات والهواتف المتحركة وحتى لوازم الأطفال 
•يمكنك أيضاً تحميل سيرتك الذاتية والتقدم للعديد من الوظائف الشاغرة سواء في مجال الهندسة أو الضيافة أو حتى المبيعات في الإمارات 
هل تفكر بإعادة تأثيث منزلك؟ عبر دوبيزل، بإمكانك بيع أثاث منزلك والإلكترونيات المنزلية بسهولة وعبر هاتفك الذكي. هل تفكر بشراء سيارة جديدة؟ دوبيزل يمنحك فرصة التواصل المباشر مع العديد من بائعي السيارات عبر خاصية الدردشة. هل تفكر بالانتقال إلى شقة أو منطقة جديدة ولم تقرر بعد؟ بسيطة! دوبيزل يمنحك القدرة على حفظ البحث والبقاء على اطلاع بكل عقار جديد يطابق بحثك.
دوبيزل تطبيق مفيد، وفي حال عدم معرفتك كيف ستبدأ، فقط نزّل التطبيق وسجل الدخول باستخدام حسابك على فيسبوك، ثم كن على استعداد للعثور على العديد من الصفقات الجيدة.

bluejetty:00042213:ios.summary: This is the official app for Vancouver’s Best Car Share! Evo is car sharing made for you. It gets you from here to there with room for your friends - gas, insurance, parking and unlimited kms included. Plus, we’ve added e-bikes and e-scoote
bluejetty:00042213:ios.description:
This is the official app for Vancouver’s Best Car Share! Evo is car sharing made for you. It gets you from here to there with room for your friends - gas, insurance, parking and unlimited kms included. Plus, we’ve added e-bikes and e-scooters! The Evo app is your key to everything. Just reserve, unlock and hit the road. Yep, its that easy.
The app lets you:
• Sign up for car, e-bike and e-scooter sharing (have your driver’s license and a credit card on hand to join)
• Find a vehicle 24/7 by checking out the real-time map
• Make or cancel reservations (you can reserve a car up to 30 min in advance or 5 min in advance for e-bikes and e-scooters, all for free) or use Evo Return to make round-trip bookings up to 30 days in advance
• Start, pause, and end trips with the click of a button, or use our handy QR code to start your e-bike or e-scooter trip
• See how much time is left before your reservation expires with the countdown timer
• View all available vehicles on the map or view them in a list
• View vehicle info including location, fuel/charge level, license plate, and distance from you
• Check out parking locations and the Home Zone
• See billing and manage all things to do with your Evo account
• Give us a shout 24/7 for help. Day or night we are here for you!
• Easily refer your friends and earn driving credit
• Stay up to date with in-app and push notifications
• Use radar to set a location, time, and radius to search for an Evo
• View your Evo Extras points balance, challenges and exclusive partner discounts
Have a cool idea on how to make Evo even better? Send your questions and feedback to info@evo.ca

bluejetty:00073746:ios.description:
World’s Fastest Route Planner for Multi-Stop Deliveries. Save Time, Money, and Get Home Faster. The most intuitive route planner for multi-stop deliveries. Optimize for the shortest routes, avoid traffic and delays, and quickly deliver packages in your vehicle.
We help drivers save more than 30% of time spent on the road and 20% of their money on fuel. This translates into approximately 2 hours saved per day and $200 saved per month.
With over 100 million deliveries optimized and over 5 million drivers, Zeo Route Planner is the world's most trusted choice of route planner.
 Features provided by Zeo Route Planner:
 • Add Stops Manually by Searching or by Dropping Pin
 • Import Stops from Excel
 • Choose the length of time you want to spend at each stop
 • Scan your list of addresses to add Stops
 • Provide Real-time ETA updates to your customers
 • Collect Proof of Delivery within the App
 • With voice-enabled input - add stops by just speaking
 • Navigate the way you like with support from - Google Maps and Apple maps and the addition of many more maps ( TomTom, Here We go, Waze)
 • Get End Trip reports providing post-trip analysis with details
Every stop is unique and we understand that. Specify the details such as the type of stop-delivery or pickup. Specify the prioritization with ASAP or time slots and add a comment to add extra details. Share your location with the clients at the click of a button or call them from the app itself. Finally, with integrations with Shopify and Woo Commerce via our web interfaces, assign the trip to drivers on their ios devices easily.
For Multi-drop couriers:
Save over $200 each month in fuel and time saved.
With the ZEO Premium Subscription Plan, you get routes with unlimited stops each month in an auto-renewable in-app purchase subscription.
Subscription Plans:
Mobile FREE plan - FREE - 12 Routes per month / Unlimited Stops
Mobile Monthly plan - $15.99/Month - Unlimited Routes / Unlimited Stops
Mobile Weekly plan - $4.99/Week - Unlimited Routes / Unlimited Stops
Mobile Annual plan - $129/Year - Unlimited Routes / Unlimited Stops
You will be charged the amount to your iTunes account and rates vary by country. You’ll get the local price before completing the payment.
You must turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your subscription ends to avoid renewal.
You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.
Free 7-day trial
Try ZEO Premium for free with a 7-day trial to see how much time and fuel you can save.
Your free trial period will end when you buy a subscription.
